chapters.title: Chapter 3430 Campaign! IV
paragraphs: The moment they answered in affirmation that they were Pioneers, the golden armored man nodded as Taru could swear that a smile likely appeared under his gold helm.
"Good!"
A single word.
This being then turned towards the terrifying woman who had taken down this whole settlement while asking.
"Information about other Settlements?"
"Three that they routinely traded with. I've noted down their directions and distance based on their accounts, Master."
Ruination answered succinctly as her words caused Warlord Taru to look at her and the golden armored entity with a gaze that now seemed to understand.
They were going from Settlement to Settlement.
They were not the first, and they would certainly not be the last!
The only question was...what did these beings want with Pioneers in these forsaken lands with absolutely no authorities?
Warlord Taru and the others had no idea as the golden armored man nodded at this moment, pointing to them and beckoning them towards the Air Balloon calmly.
"You five can make your way into the vessel- your safety is guaranteed. Another Pioneer there will explain what you can expect."
Words that felt like a command more than anything were uttered out, and Taru and the others looked at each before they rose up- ignoring their injuries and walking towards the vessel.
At this time, the golden armored entity gazed at the masses of hundreds of other humanoid entities here.
All poor souls that were just dragged into this place, and others were even born bere as some children could be seen hiding behind others!
Noah looked at all of them calmly as he asked.
"Alright, who do you all implicitly trust in this place? Apart from those I will be taking away?"
WAA!
Who did they implicitly trust?

A heavy question, and many of those in the surroundings looked at each other before the majority of the eyes came to land on a woman with a graceful temperament who currently shielded a few kids behind her!
Someone they all knew well based on her actions in the Settlement.
Noah nodded at this as he motioned with his hands- and Ruination quickly moved to remove something from the Air Balloon.
A silver set of armor and sword!
She threw the silver set of armor and sword over to the woman many had looked towards- and this entity dazedly watched these armaments fall near her feet.

"You are now deemed a General under the banner of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian. Continue overseeing this place and take in any new entrants that fall into Hell Terra Firma nearby. If you confirm anyone is a Pioneer, keep tabs on them. I'll be back here routinely."
He spoke towards her succinctly as he began to move back towards the Air Balloon that now held Six total Pioneers of Existence.
A quick entrance, and an equally quick exit!
Once Ruination also came in and closed the latch of the Vessel, it began rising to the skies once more as it only left behind hundreds of dazed entities!
A woman stared at the silver armor on her feet with a stern expression, this past Existence Severing expert thinking of many things as a moment later, she adorned the armament and grasped the sword.
Those within Hell Terra Firma faced the sense of desolation and hopelessness every day.
But they were extremely rapid to adapt as each one normally held years of history and experience!

Like a well-oiled machine, the cogs would soon and very quickly start to move as Noah began moving around Hell Terra Firma- collecting powerful individuals and installing leadership positions while extending his own influence!
Omniverse X-999.
Within the Secondary Infiniverse Megalos Seed.
Above a vibrant multicolored sea surrounded by thousands of complex Runes of Existence, Ozymandias and the Infiniverse Megalos Body floated powerfully while the latter spoke out her intent.
|Master, your other self and Ruination have just returned with five more Pioneers from a second nearby Settlement, and-...!|

In the middle of her words, the multicolored Frequency Gateway began to seethe and roil as from its depths, radiant crimson drops of blood rose up that rapidly became filled with life and brilliance- each of these drops of blood radiating their own heart-shaking aura!
Some became crimson gold globules of brilliance.
Others became painted crimson purple or crimson white.

But ultimately...a total of 5 Globules of Blood of Pioneers floated before Ozymandias and the Infiniverse Megalos Body as the former smiled and waved his hands- these penultimate forms of loot coming forward as an illusory eye above him stared at them deeply.

[Globule of Blood of a Pioneer(Taru)]:: The scattered Severed weavings of existence and scattered path of a Pioneer have been determined to belong to the Great Pioneer that went a decade ago from an unknown frequency. On the 50th Cycle of his life, he severed all attachments and weavings that bound him, attaining a Severed State of Existence. On the 60th Cycle of his life, he finally Pioneered his own weavings above Severing. A drop of his blood has generated the capability for you to Sever a single, small aspect of your own weavings, including but not limited to Individual Concepts, Individual Values, Individual Techniques....

[Globule of Blood of a Pioneer(Orlo)]:: The scattered Severed weavings of existence and scattered path of a Pioneer have been determined to belong to the Great Pioneer that went missing years ago from an unknown frequency...
[Globule of Blood of a Pioneer(Sheila)]:: The scattered Severed weavings of existence and scattered path of a Pioneer...
One by one, he observed them all to have similar details as they spun around his body gloriously before moments later, he bellowed out and absorbed all five!
HUUM!
Intense complexity burst out as the hard work of Pioneers- their literal blood flowed into Ozymandias and was then directed towards a single place.
|Bathe the Weavings of Cheats utterly and completely.|

His commanding voice boomed out as the Blood of different Pioneers burned within him, a single Ordinance being focused on as instead of one Drop of Blood of a Pioneer going into it, five burned entirely for Cheats instead!
The result was bound to be a heavy one...

chapters.title: Chapter 3431 Deceive, Deceit, Cheat! I
paragraphs: Blood.
The Blood of a Pioneer was heavy.
It was the hard work of entities that had waded through cycles of weavings, and he was using it to prop himself up even higher!
Such Blood flowed through Ozymandias and bathed nothing else but Cheats.
|The Complexity of Cheats is being tested.|
|The light of Severing covers Cheats entirely, and it does so multiple times unlike any other parts of your weavings.|
Cheats.
A single part of what made Noah Osmont.
He was a man born of many things, and his power was the accumulation and convergence of a lot of factors.
At times, a part of him shone more than others and took center stage.
Infinity.
Quintessence.
Mana.
Protagonist.
Loot.
It varied over time which part of him took center stage, but each part was paramount to getting him where he needed to be.
Under the agreement of all other parts of him, Cheats was propelled to the spotlight at this time!
Cheats.
A concept that, when placed in comparison to the likes of Infinity or Quintessence, may be considered lesser. May not be taken as seriously.
But what exactly was Cheats? "I am..."
From Ozymandias, golden brilliance began to shine brightly as behind him, a golden robe fluttered into existence.
Cheats.
If one truly asked what it was, the answer was vast!
Ozymandias looked at the multicolored sea before him as he spoke out.
"Infinite Mana is a cheat."
WAA!
"The Infiniverse Megalos Seed is a cheat."
"Ruination is a cheat."
HUUM!
As he spoke, an unfathomable gold radiance emerged from his figure.
Yes! All the astounding things that Noah Osmont had that gave him an edge over others could be considered cheats.
An unfair advantage or special ability, history, or lineage that allowed one to undergo extremely rapid progression compared to others and overcome obstacles impossible for others!
This was the essence of Cheats!
And was this not what he continued to do again and again?
What others achieved in millions of years, in cycles, he achieved in days and weeks?
Even now, the Frequency of Hell Terra Firma that denied all authority- what was he doing within it?
He was violating everything it stood for- something impossible for others, and yet a reality for him.
Cheats...had innately coursed through and held a hand in many parts of what made him!
At this moment, it sought its recognition.
Its gravitas!
BOOOM!
Stellar rivers of golden radiance erupted around Ozymandias and whipped around madly.
|The Weavings of Cheats have been Severed from the commonality and normalcy of existence once, tremendously elevating the complexity.|
|The Weavings of Cheats gaze at the remnant power of the Globules of Blood of Pioneers and pose the question- who decided that one could only undergo Severing once?|
A simple question.
Yet it was one that caused the weavings of existence around Ozymandias to tremble left and right.
His body radiated a pulse of power as a moment later...
BOOM!
|The Ordinance of Cheats has undergone a Second Severing of Existence.|
A concept was severed and put alone on its own standing, outside the scope of other weavings of existence. This was existence severing.
Yet at this moment, Cheats Severed its existence not once, but twice!
And it didn't stop there.
|The Ordinance of Cheats has undergone a Third Severing of Existence.|
|The Ordinance of Cheats has undergone a Fourth Severing of Existence.|
|The Ordinance of Cheats has undergone a Fifth Severing of Existence!|
Not once. Not twice- but five times!
Five times, Cheats underwent cycles of five Severings as the golden brilliance around Ozymandias became unfathomably pure- its concentration reaching maddening levels.
Its complexity was stupendous as...Ozymandias felt like he could more freely gaze at what made the weavings of existence, and then theorize how to utterly violate their weavings!
This was the stage Cheats was going towards as while it began burning with the light of Existence Severing multiple times over, it felt its brand new complexity...and began to act.
|The Severed Ordinance of Cheats looks at the many possible ways to violate the weavings of Existence.|
It took but a moment after its multiple severings before it began!
|Cheats states that it stands in a League of its own.|
|It should not have to conform to the established weavings of Existence, and begins the establishment of the Quintessential League of Existence.|
|Its own set of rules and principles.|
Dazzling concentrations of golden brilliance were being used and burnt up.
And yet they never ended being produced as from the depths of Ozymandias, Cheats pulled on Mana freely.
Blue brilliance was converted to golden brilliance as never ending complex waves of power continued to spill out senselessly to design whatever Cheats had in mind!
The Quintessential League of Existence.
Its own set of rules and principles!
Such a fantastical weaving began to bloom at this moment as Ozymandias stared at the multicolored sea.
The coming change would be comprehensive.
The coming change would be deadly.
The coming change would violate far too many things!
|The guidelines of the Quintessential League of Existence under the banner of cheats are being defined.|
|The design of the Relegation Zone of Existence has begun to unfold.|
|The design of the Banner of Invictus has begun to unfold.|
One after another.
A ridiculous set of guidelines and principles began to unfold in a small corner of the Megalos Ynnere of a unique Spoke of the Wheel!
As this process began.
In transcended weavings of existence, within the Expanse.

A terrific light of golden brilliance erupted within the core area of the Primal Eldritch Palace of the Expanse, the visage of Ozymandias within this place rising as on his fully starry obsidian body, white gold wings erupted from behind his back.

The wings were gloriously laced with obsidian tentacles that further expressed their might and tyranny, his figure beginning to move away from the domain that the Great Segregator and Great Mother were in.
Such an action caused them to be dazed as the Great Mother asked cautiously.
|O Instrument of the Beyonder, where...are you going?!|

chapters.title: Chapter 3432 Decieve, Deceit, Cheat! II
paragraphs: The intent of the Great Mother was filled with instability as if she knew the answer to her question.
But it was all that unbelievable that she still had to ask!
Where exactly could he be going right now?
Without even looking back, the voice of Ozymandias echoed as he began to leave the Primal Eldritch Palace of the Expanse.
|To the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse, of course. I said that I would do it myself.|
To the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse!
The Great Segregator heard such an answer as she stared forth incredulously.
The Great Mother became silent as she stared at the back of the Instrument of the Beyonder that did not stop moving.
She had not known him for long, but she knew him not to be a fool. She didn't understand his reasons.
She didn't know how or why the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse had offended him!

Naturally, she wanted to repeat that such a place was guarded by multiple Pioneers of Existence and likely over a Hundred Existence Severing Palace Masters who all stemmed from different locations across the Expanse.
The Expanse was vast as within it, many terrifying Civilizations thrived.
Some transcended from the Megalos Ynnere, Megalos Beyond, and Megalos Nihilos as they made different domains within the Expanse their homes.
Others were already naturally within the Expanse, like the civilization known as Megalonians who thrived long ago within Megalos Mountains in the gaps of the Expanse!
Of course, such a civilization had long since perished in the eons of history, but there were others similar to them in terms of history.
Some of these powerful entities remained in their homes, and others sought opportunity elsewhere as they joined groups that had connections to terrifying connections and weavings.
Groups that for as long as Records were being written, they had existed.
Some had origins relating to Anti-Matter, others stemming from Dark Matter, and the most abstruse of all that stemmed from Matter!
The Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse was one such extension of a terrifying power stemming from the weavings of Matter.
Very rarely were there wars across different Palaces in the Expanse.
The times that wars did arise were due to irreconcilable differences between two parties that drew many parties in, and such conflicts caused heavy death tolls across the weavings of this Frequency!
An example of such war was the one where a single being had been in the center of- the Omnifather and what had occurred with the Megalonians of the Megalos Mountains.
That war had carried heavy consequences, with countless entities dying due to it as a portion of the terrifying lineage of Golden Titans were even taken prisoner by the Omnifather.
A terrifying time. A terrifying war!
Such wars were not in line with the purpose of all being to elevate their complexity for as long as they could, but they did occur.
At this moment in time, it would be laughable to even have the Primal Eldritch Palace of the Expanse attack the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse.
And yet even despite all of this, Ozymandias still moved.
Even while knowing about Pioneers of Existence occupying that place while he was merely a newborn that had just now seemingly undergone Severing, he still moved!
The tentacles that made the infinity symbol that was the Great Mother trembled subtly as...she laughed shrewdly thereafter.
|I have not been a good follower of the Beyonder.|
She felt all stress and worries leave her as on the next moment, she began to move towards the Instrument of the Beyonder.
As she did so, the shackles and weight that always held her back seemed to break, and her reservations regarding the next step broke as well!
Her tentacles moved towards the Instrument of the Beyonder as at the same time, she Severed all her worries.
She Severed her Existence!
BOOM!
A terrifying aura began to emerge from her as she voiced out.
|I should never have doubted the Instrument of the Beyonder. I should never have doubted the words of the Great Beyonder!|
She wholly followed the weavings of the Great Beyonder as if she was meant to be part of the weavings of the Instrument, she would not die from a mere Severing of Existence.

So she followed the Instrument while Severing her existence, the Great Segregator behind her gazing at the scene in a daze as two figures left the safe haven of the Primal Eldritch Palace of the Expanse!
In moments, the Great Mother caught up to Ozymandias as she asked with a jubilant tone.
|O Instrument, you know exactly where you need to go?|
Did he know the exact coordinates of the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse?
Towards such a question, Ozymandias just nodded as the vibrant wings behind his back fluttered.
Invictus Maximus!
They were incorporated into the terrifying weavings of Cheats at this moment as with them...
|All those entangled with me through any means of Causality cannot hide. No matter if it is in these Megalos or Expanse, or even another weaving of Existence entirely!|
HUUM!
His gaze radiated a terrifying gold light.

They left the weavings of the Primal Eldritch Palace of the Expanse as Ozymandias felt the unique strings of Existence around them, a dazzling eye opening up above him as he tugged on a certain string, tendrils of obsidian gold brilliance wrapping around him and the Great Mother as their figures turned into streaks of light that cruised on this string of existence!
Its pathway ran straight towards the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse!
The Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse.
Within its depths, Pioneer Heracles sat amidst a sea of vibrant complexity, Runes of Existence swirling around him as he continued to feel a sense of unease.
Unease!

Ever since they undertook that tremendous mission to send the Source Weavings of the Infiniverse Dowager and the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian to that terrifying Frequency, this unease had not faded!
In fact, it only intensified with every passing hour since that event.
The senses of a Pioneer were extremely sensitive as he didn't just push away this feeling.
He felt like something was coming, but he couldn't say what exactly!

An example of such war was the one where a single being had been in the center of- the Omnifather and what had occurred with the Megalonians of the Megalos Mountains.
That war had carried heavy consequences, with countless entities dying due to it as a portion of the terrifying lineage of Golden Titans were even taken prisoner by the Omnifather.
A terrifying time.
A terrifying war!
Such wars were not in line with the purpose of all being to elevate their complexity for as long as they could, but they did occur.
At this moment in time, it would be laughable to even have the Primal Eldritch Palace of the Expanse attack the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse.
And yet even despite all of this, Ozymandias still moved.
Even while knowing about Pioneers of Existence occupying that place while he was merely a newborn that had just now seemingly undergone Severing, he still moved!
The tentacles that made the infinity symbol that was the Great Mother trembled subtly as...she laughed shrewdly thereafter.
|I have not been a good follower of the Beyonder.|
She felt all stress and worries leave her as on the next moment, she began to move towards the Instrument of the Beyonder.
As she did so, the shackles and weight that always held her back seemed to break, and her reservations regarding the next step broke as well!
Her tentacles moved towards the Instrument of the Beyonder as at the same time, she Severed all her worries.
She Severed her Existence!
BOOM!
A terrifying aura began to emerge from her as she voiced out.
|I should never have doubted the Instrument of the Beyonder.
I should never have doubted the words of the Great Beyonder!|
She wholly followed the weavings of the Great Beyonder as if she was meant to be part of the weavings of the Instrument, she would not die from a mere Severing of Existence.

So she followed the Instrument while Severing her existence, the Great Segregator behind her gazing at the scene in a daze as two figures left the safe haven of the Primal Eldritch Palace of the Expanse!
In moments, the Great Mother caught up to Ozymandias as she asked with a jubilant tone.
|O Instrument, you know exactly where you need to go?|
Did he know the exact coordinates of the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse?
Towards such a question, Ozymandias just nodded as the vibrant wings behind his back fluttered.
Invictus Maximus!
They were incorporated into the terrifying weavings of Cheats at this moment as with them...
|All those entangled with me through any means of Causality cannot hide.
No matter if it is in these Megalos or Expanse, or even another weaving of Existence entirely!|
HUUM!
His gaze radiated a terrifying gold light.

They left the weavings of the Primal Eldritch Palace of the Expanse as Ozymandias felt the unique strings of Existence around them, a dazzling eye opening up above him as he tugged on a certain string, tendrils of obsidian gold brilliance wrapping around him and the Great Mother as their figures turned into streaks of light that cruised on this string of existence!
Its pathway ran straight towards the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse!
The Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse.
Within its depths, Pioneer Heracles sat amidst a sea of vibrant complexity, Runes of Existence swirling around him as he continued to feel a sense of unease.
Unease!

Ever since they undertook that tremendous mission to send the Source Weavings of the Infiniverse Dowager and the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian to that terrifying Frequency, this unease had not faded!
In fact, it only intensified with every passing hour since that event.
The senses of a Pioneer were extremely sensitive as he didn't just push away this feeling.
He felt like something was coming, but he couldn't say what exactly!

chapters.title: Chapter 3433 Deceive, Deceit, Cheat! III
paragraphs: He shouldn't have any viable worries.
He shouldn't be feeling like this when they had just locked away the Infiniverse Dowager and the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian!
So why?
Why was...!
HUUUM!
His head rose.
He felt something.
A ringing.
A signal- something new and foreign seemed to appear in a distant area as, at this moment, he heard a deep roar that seemed to be coming from the depths of the Megalos Beyond!
'Outerversal Authority?'
He raised his brows as he felt the source behind the roar- its complexity heavy, but should at most be at Existence Severing.
This shouldn't be something that even required someone like him to move as he remained seated where he was, only extending his Eye of Existence outwards to observe what was happening.
And a moment later, a piercing roar filled with interminable power and heaviness boomed out that caused Pioneer Heracles' gaze to change!
|O Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse, the Instrument of the Beyonder has come to pay a visit!|
The Instrument of the Beyonder?!
Pioneer Heracles couldn't help but rise up as this...was another Calamity that appeared in the future.
Something along the same lines as the Infiniverse Dowager and the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian, but the Instrument of the Beyonder was much more brutal!
He swept out with waves of obsidian Outerversal Authority and poisoned everything into his image, altering entire portions of the Megalos and the Expanse.
Why would he appear here?
First the Infiniverse Dowager and Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian, and now the Instrument of the Beyonder.
What the hell was going on with this Frequency of Existence to have all of these entities here? And it appearing just after two other Calamities were sent away...was this connected?!
Pioneer Heracles had a heavy gaze as moments later, Palace Master Antiope and Nisa appeared in his domain, their gazes also somber!
Outside of a dazzling Blancverse Domain that contained countless wonders.
Smaller Blancverse Domain could be seen around this general area, and with the golden Strings of Existence crossing through everything, this whole area looked like a gorgeous paradisiacal land.
Meanwhile, inside the largest Blancverse Domain.

Massive white and gold castles, towers, and monuments floated inside of this Blancverse Domain, its equivalent length being a few times larger than a normal Omniverse as it contained countless intricacies within it.
It also held a concentrated amount of powerful forces that nobody would dare to freely stand against.
Thousands of Ordinance Amalgamation entities, tens of thousands below them in other States of Existence.
Over a hundred Existence Severing Palace Masters!
And an unknown number of Pioneers of Existence.
Just thinking of these forces alone would fill one with trepidation and make them stay far away!
Yet Ozymandias arrived here with the Great Mother in tow, her tentacles shining with a glorious luster of severing as she bellowed out.
|O Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse, the Instrument of the Beyonder has come to pay a visit!|
|O Immovable Sacred Palace...!|
|O Immovable Sacred Palace...!|
It rang out, resonated, and boomed out multiple times over.
The reaction was swift as moments later, within the Blancverse Domain, the grandiose auras of a few dozen Existence Severing entities arose and came over.
Their bodies held heavy bursts of Complexity as a booming intent of Palace Master Evrin was among the first to echo out.

|And what might the so called Instrument of the Beyonder that is emanating mere shreds of Existence Severing so boisterously come here? Do you all not know of the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse? You are far from the dark lands tainted by Outerversal Authority!|
WAA!
The words were fearless and filled with animosity.
First, their power only stayed in Existence Severing.
Second, the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse was contained within a Blancverse.
No entity would even be able to affect those within this space.
So why would they ever worry?
As Palace Master Evrin appeared on the edges of the Blancverse, other Palace Masters also appeared as behind them, hundreds of Ordinance Amalgamation entities also showed themselves!
Their lives were cyclical as they all sought for greater complexity. Rarely did something like this happen as they were curious.
Among the arrivals.
The figures of Palace Master Antiope and Nisa also appeared as the moment they did so, Ozymandias honed in on them while the golden wings behind his back pulsed with majesty!
An eye above him unfurled with tremendous grandeur as he raised his hand and caused the appearance of multiple illusory figures.

|I came to the Immovable Sacred Palace for these three beings and these three beings alone. Give them to me, and there will be no karma between the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse and I. Give them to me, and this Palace of yours will still remain standing thereafter.|
Ridiculous words boomed out while the illusory figures of Pioneer Heracles, Palace Master Antiope, and Palace Master Nisa were shown as the targets he wanted.
But he stated that the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse either gives them up, or causality between them would start to be twisted as this Palace may not remain standing any longer after that!
It was so outlandish that nobody could even reply initially.
Even the Great Mother was surprised as she couldn't help but swell with excitement.
She didn't know what the Instrument of the Beyonder had in store, but she would follow him all the way!
At this moment, her tentacles moved.
An eye opened amidst all of them as she began to record everything occurring here- and she sent all of their weavings towards the Megalos Beyond, towards the Pantheon of Umbra they were still in.
She wanted to express to every single Morphon the grandeur of the Instrument of the Beyonder!
Within the Blancverse.
Many eyes looked at at the illusory images of Pioneer Heracles, and the Existence Severing Palace Masters Antiope and Nisa as they were incredulous.
These Existence Severing Outerversal Morphons actually came here to ask for a Pioneer of Existence to be given up along with two Palace Masters?!

chapters.title: Chapter 3434 Deceive, Deceit, Cheat! IV
paragraphs: A Palace Master clad in a crimson robe sneered from within the Blancverse Domain as her voice echoed out.
|You ridiculous buffoon, you actually came here to ask for a great Pioneer of Existence to be handed over to you? Even if he was gracious enough to grant you his presence, you would not be worthy!|
Unworthy!
Unworthy for even the grace of a great Pioneer of Existence!
The red-robbed Palace Master said this while internally sending messages to Antiope and Nisa, wondering what interactions they had that would cause this being to appear here.
She was surprised to find the faces of the two Palace Masters visibly somber and stern as if they were looking at a great enemy!
Was there something the rest of them were missing here?
There would not need to be any worries at all as first, they were inside a Blancverse.
Second, this was their base filled with over a hundred Existence Severing Palace Masters and even Pioneers of Existence!
What were two Existence Severing enemies before such a force?
Another Palace Master spoke up at this time, his voice cold.

|Whatever Palace of the Expanse you stem from, you'd best scram back to it before you perish here. I've heard of the little dreams and rumors from Outerversal Morphons regarding a promised champion of theirs before. The Instrument of the Great Beyonder you all look up to. Are you supposed to be it? A little thing whose complexity barely matches one of us here? Fuck off.|
Complete disregard was all they received.
Ozymandias looked at this as his gaze was locked onto the somber expressions of Palace Master Antiope and Nisa.
He began to float towards the Blancverse while keeping his gaze on them.
|You two know what you did. Today, I've come to collect.|
WAA!
|Is the Pioneer behind you both still hiding? Even he will not be able to escape today.|
His words and power truly didn't match.
If it was a terrifying Pioneer of Existence saying these words, they would hold weight and make sense.
But an Existence Severing entity...what basis did he have to stand on for him to even say this?
He reached the outer boundary of the dazzling white Blancverse that would stop anyone, even a Pioneer!
And...
He floated forward.
He floated through the dazzling white ring of the Blancverse as it didn't pulse, reject, or even act like any sort of barrier- he simply floated right through!
HUUUM!
Instantly, the whole atmosphere changed.
All Palace Masters here gazed forward with shock!
The Ordinance Amalgamation and Ordinance of Existence entities behind them had their jaws opened wide.
The atmosphere instantly turned heavy and serious as Ozymandias acted like he didn't do much, his gaze still locked onto Antiope and Nisa as he voiced out!

|I will say it again. I come here for the lives of these two here... let us see, Antiope and Nisa? As well as the Pioneer behind them. If you all do not interfere, the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse would not be entangled with me. If you all interfere...I cannot promise that the entire Immovable Sacred Palace will not disappear today.|
Immense shock and silence settled in.
A Blancverse.
It was inviolable!
But that being just violated it so simply!
What was this?
What was this?!
None of them knew.
But of course, this was the violation of Existence itself that Cheats had envisioned.
The violation of the norms of Existence that Cheats was actively altering!
Boundless deceit unfolded. Boundless deception against existence itself unfolded!
At this moment, the newly designed Quintessential League of Existence expressed itself.
But what exactly was the Quintessential League of Existence?
The guidelines that Cheats had enacted with its terrifying authority that was severed five times flashed before the eyes of Ozymandias!
The guidelines violated and denied reality as they were simple ones.
First and foremost.

[The distance of an Omniverse around Cheats falls under the influence of the Quintessential League of Existence, and the influence of the Quintessential League of Existence is applied wherever a body of the holder of Cheats is.]
[The First Guidelines of the Quintessential League of Existence are active.]
[The Relegation Zone of Existence is active.]
[The Banner of Invictus is active.]

[Relegation Zone of Existence]:: Under the area affected by the Influence of the Quintessential League of Existence, the Realm of Power that can be expressed can only be as high as the owner of the Quintessential League of Existence.

[Banner of Invictus]:: Any Existence entangled and with a causal relationship with the holder of Cheats will have no barriers or obstacles between the two sides, regardless of distance or even different weavings of existence. If under the influence of the Quintessential League of Existence, one can never leave the Relegation Zone deployed unless the Causality between two sides is settled by any means necessary. The design of Cheats.
The deceit and deception of existence itself.
Cheats...had chosen to go above and beyond as it established a League of its own.
A League of Existence where the rules of reality, the rules of Existence themselves...were entirely different when Cheats was present!
This...was the Quintessential League of Existence.
A league of his own.
Rules of his own!
|You motherfucker!|
At the moment he intruded into the Blancverse Domain, the Palace Masters instantly reacted and blazed with horrifying bursts of authority!
And yet...Ozymandias remained unfettered as he bellowed out.
|Can you all not see what the ones I came here for are doing while the rest of you throw yourselves into the fire?!|
His words caused the eyes of all to briefly glance towards Palace Masters Antiope and Nisa.
Unlike other Palace Masters, they did not erupt with authority or move forward.
In fact, they even showed a trace of fear on their faces as they moved back!
Such a scene caused many to flash with caution.
Just...what was happening here?
Hesitation bloomed.
All eyes turned to stare at Ozymandias who had just freely breached the Blancverse Domain as they wondered.
Just who the hell was this being?
His humanoid body.
His stellar obsidian makeup. The golden wings behind him that were laced with black tentacles.
His astral face that had two blinding gold singularities!
At this moment, he gave off a menacing feel that made him look like an ancient Morphon unphased by anything.
He looked at every single entity here as his voice remained low and full of confidence.
|Today is a decisive day for the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse.|
WAA!
|Either three Entities die, or the whole Immovable Palace falls. What will it be?|

chapters.title: Chapter 3435 Merely Pioneers of Existence! I
paragraphs: Either three entities die, or all of the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse perishes!
These heavy words buzzed out as in response...
|What a pompous being. The whole Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse may perish? Do you even know what holds it up? Has something like you ever tasted the power of a Pioneer?|
Along with the booming voice, an utterly existence-altering authority manifested as space distorted to reveal an entity with white wings of light flowing graciously behind him!
Near this entity, Pioneer Heracles could also be seen as his eyes showed calmness and seriousness.
Dark hair, blue eyes, and currently adorned in a light blue robe inscribed with stars.
Undoubtedly radiating an air of power far exceeding Existence Severing.
Pioneers.
Two Pioneers had actually appeared!
The moment they did so.
The visage of Ozymandias stopped in place as he locked his gaze on the visage of Pioneer Heracles.
On his stellar obsidian face that only held singularities for pupils, a deep, devilish smile formed- a smile filled with astonishingly impure thoughts to violate the very order of existence itself!
|Heracles is your name, huh? Now that all three of you are present, I can stop talking and start thrashing!|
DUM!
DUM!
DUM!
It was unknown from where.
But in the surroundings, the sound of drums began to ring.
Akin to a symphony. Akin to a melody foretelling what was to come!
The Severed Ordinances of Existence of all Palace Masters were buzzing and ready to erupt as they made their stance clear!
They would defend their own.
In the middle of the Palace Masters, Antiope recalled the terror she had heard of this Calamity in the future as she grit her teeth and called out a message to all others.
|Do not underestimate him! Treat him as dangerous as even a Pione-...!|
CRACK!
Ozymandias had disappeared where he stood.

Even before Palace Master Antiope could finish her words, her eyelids only flickered with warning innately as in the next moment, a stellar black fist filled with dense and heavy severed authority of existence made contact with her cheek, her innate defenses melting and deforming from the tainting of Outerversal Authority as she was hit with so much force that her body shot sideways like a ragdoll, smashing onto Palace Master Nisa as both continued on for miles!
Many eyes nearly bulged out.
Fast.
It was far too fast!
In the distance, Palace Master Antiope held a bloodied jaw with multiple teeth knocked out, her gaze ferocious and filled with alarm while Nisa held onto her.
The scene was a terrific one!
But would such a being truly be allowed to run rampant when the Pioneers of the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse were right here?!
|Before the grandeur of a Pioneer, do you truly think an Existence Severing entity can run rampant?!|
Even as this thought arose, the Pioneer with white wings and his whole body radiating a terrific while luster of radiance swung his hand down.
|The path I pioneered is the path of Chi. A boorish creature like you cannot even begin to understand it, much less withstand it! This...is the power of a Pioneer!|
BOOM!
His hand had merely swung down.
Yet from above Ozymandias and below him two white palms made from a shockingly complex amalgamation of authorities descended and threatened to make him into a pancake!
At the center of each palm, the Rune of Existence reading [CHI] was utterly radiant and carrying wonders of undeniability!
And yet...
HOOONG!
A golden wheel manifested around Ozymandias and spun.
Kuklos!

The intricate wheel spun with heavy majesty as when the palms came down and up, it was akin to two metals grating against each other as the two white palms never even broke past the wheel to reach Ozymandias!
A simple scene.
But it was one that instantly caused the surroundings to turn eerily quiet.
Palace Masters and Pioneers alike gazed on with blank eyes.
What was this? Not a single person could fathom what they were seeing at this moment as only a single voice echoed out.
|Was this the great power of a Pioneer?|
DUM! DUM! DUM!
The booming drums picked up the frequency.
The hearts of many beings began to feel unsettled.
Outside of the Blancverse, the Great Mother's tentacles squealed and trembled in sheer excitement as she watched what was happening here and even displayed it on the Pantheon of Umbra!
The grandeur of the Instrument of the Beyonder.
The majesty he displayed as shockingly, at this moment, he withstood the attack of a Pioneer!
How was this possible? How?!
The power he expressed was still that of Existence Severing as it should not be able to do what it was currently doing!
It was an utter violation of existence as in all this fervor...the visage of Ozymandias surrounded by a dazzling spinning Wheel looked towards the Piooner as his intent weaved out.

|If that is the power of a Pioneer, it seems that I can run rampant freely. Do not believe yourself to be something great with the stage of power you have achieved...you are merely a Pioneer- and I already have multiple entities like you at my beck and call.|

Horrific words echoed out as who could believe them? But it mattered not to Ozymandias as while keeping at bay the dazzling grandeur of a Pioneers Path, the golden wings behind him flickered with unfathomable obsidian radiance as in the next moment, his back gushed out dense waves of Outerversal Authority.

Alongside these waves of Outerversal Authority, thousands of stellar obsidian gold tentacles unfurled and stretched out all around, turning this nearby region into a scene of eldritch horror as these tentacles went towards anything nearby.
They latched on and gripped the dazzling white illusory hands simmering with flames of CHI from the white winged Pioneer.
They went towards any nearby Palace Masters as they roared out and erupted with their severed Ordinances.
Behind them was the backing of Infinite Mana as at this moment, it was poured out freely.
He was a single being, yes.
But if he expressed infinite waves of mana and altered them to become his source of power for Kuklos, Outerversal, and Cheats, did the number of enemies really matter?

sentences.text: Either three entities die, or all of the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse perishes!
These heavy words buzzed out as in response...
|What a pompous being.
The whole Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse may perish?
Do you even know what holds it up?
Has something like you ever tasted the power of a Pioneer?|
Along with the booming voice, an utterly existence-altering authority manifested as space distorted to reveal an entity with white wings of light flowing graciously behind him!
Near this entity, Pioneer Heracles could also be seen as his eyes showed calmness and seriousness.
Dark hair, blue eyes, and currently adorned in a light blue robe inscribed with stars.
Undoubtedly radiating an air of power far exceeding Existence Severing.
Pioneers.
Two Pioneers had actually appeared!
The moment they did so.
The visage of Ozymandias stopped in place as he locked his gaze on the visage of Pioneer Heracles.
On his stellar obsidian face that only held singularities for pupils, a deep, devilish smile formed- a smile filled with astonishingly impure thoughts to violate the very order of existence itself!
|Heracles is your name, huh?
Now that all three of you are present, I can stop talking and start thrashing!|
DUM!
DUM!
DUM!
It was unknown from where.
But in the surroundings, the sound of drums began to ring.
Akin to a symphony.
Akin to a melody foretelling what was to come!
The Severed Ordinances of Existence of all Palace Masters were buzzing and ready to erupt as they made their stance clear!
They would defend their own.
In the middle of the Palace Masters, Antiope recalled the terror she had heard of this Calamity in the future as she grit her teeth and called out a message to all others.
|Do not underestimate him!
Treat him as dangerous as even a Pione-...!|
CRACK!
Ozymandias had disappeared where he stood.

Many eyes nearly bulged out.
Fast.
It was far too fast!

chapters.title: Chapter 3436 Merely Pioneers of Existence! II
paragraphs: |In one's life, a critical choice is made that entirely changes the landscape and direction of existence.|
As a sea of Outerversal Authority leaked out and altered the very landscape nearby, the Instrument of the Beyonder made a grand declaration.
|Today, the Immovable Sacred Palace has made a choice, and must now bear the consequences of this choice.|
[Fatalities.]
HUUUM!
A single word was uttered out. A single word, and yet it was filled with ancient vicissitude and wonder.
The radiance of Invictus Maximus blared.
Causality twisted and distorted as it was brought forward, a senseless amount of Mana being utilized for it.

If any entity would eventually die at the hands of Ozymandias, this causality was brought forward and carried out right away as, at this moment, he focused on the Ordinance Amalgamation and Ordinance of Existence entities nearby.
All those nearby.
It was cruel.
It was senseless.
It was the start of the brutal reign of the Instrument of the Beyonder, Ozymandias!
[Singularity Implosion.]

The name of the fatality was uttered as many entities felt a sense of trepidation, multiple other terrifying auras of Pioneers rising and coming over from the depths of the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse as booming voices arose!
|How daring!|
|HOLD!|
Voices filled with authority.
But what the Instrument of the Beyonder had uttered out was already set in stone.

In the next instant, the Ordinance Amalgamation and Ordinance of Existence stage entities in the surroundings suddenly felt a sense of unfathomable ease, and their very weavings of existence shook as from the center of their bodies, terrific gravitational forces of a singularity being born and dying at the same time bloomed.
Their Ordinances were only able to resist it for a fraction of an instant.
And right after, their body crumpled like paper before they exploded into a bloody mess of ground down bones, musculature, and blood!
POP!
POP!
POP!
As if thousands of balloons were popping.
It was a heavy and deafening burst of existence that seemed like the very lifeblood of the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse was being burst under the gazes of all.
|YOU!|
|ABHORRENT!|
|IRRECONCILABLE!|
Three more auras of Pioneers bloomed as blinding bursts of radiance appeared, each of them with dominating waves of existence that all crushed down to extinguish Ozymandias!
In the far distance, the visage of Palace Master Antiope shifted her jaw back in place as her eyes shook from Trauma.
Trauma!
As if she was reliving the nightmare from a long time ago, the brutality and dominance of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian showed itself off once more!
Wait...no.
This was another Calamity entirely. Why did her terror of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian flash when she looked at the Instrument of the Beyonder?
As she asked herself this, she recalled the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian before he disappeared under the blinding brilliance of that gray light!
There, she could swear that she saw the same dazzling golden wheel that was also rotating around the Instrument of the Beyonder at this moment!
This realization was akin to a thunderbolt crashing in her mind, her existence being woken up completely as she felt like she had fallen into many layers of hell.
The Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian and the Instrument of the Beyonder...may just be one and the same.
And even though they had forever locked away the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian and the Infiniverse Dowager, the Instrument of the Beyonder was still here.
Their nightmare was still here as this was the reason they were currently targeted!
Her skin began to crawl as she trembled, recalling the qualities of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian.
Defied Existence freely. Overcame countless difficulties to wage war and decimate others. And if one ever underestimated him...it would be their death!
She didn't underestimate him. They did all they could to even send him away!
And yet...
And yet...!
Her fear made way to madness.
She felt her fractured jaw as her intent maddeningly roared out, remembering what had been an initiating event that many said was the reason for a cascade of events.
Something that had occurred that caused many to come after the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian!
It was...in his name.
With a shrill voice, she pointed towards Ozymandias while Pioneers moved against him, her intent booming out!
|That is not just the Instrument of the Beyonder! That is the inheritor of the Lineage of the Megalonians! That is THE Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian, resurrected after all these eons!|
Her words spread out far and wide.
Across the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse.
Across all the Pioneers making their entrance here and those who had yet to make a move!
The words and distinction of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian spread out as many memories instantly flashed within the eyes of those who heard them.
Megalonian.
This was a very unique term and word that was locked away through history- a type of bloodline that many had gone crazy over as multiple forces had joined in to eradicate and devour them!
Their weavings...could tremendously and ridiculously aid one in the elevation of their own as many powerhouses rose from their downfall.
Now, they heard this term again.
The eyes of all Pioneers flashed with indeterminate light of brilliance while even the knowledgeable Existence Severing Palace Masters were shocked!
Outside of the Blancverse, the visage of the Great Mother trembled with anger as she roared out.
|Blasphemous!|
WAA!
How dare they blaspheme the Instrument of the Beyonder and grant him some lineage of a long-destroyed race?!
This was simply to incur the interest of all others as it was entirely false!
Far from the Expanse.
In the Megalos Beyond.
The Pantheon of Umbra!

The gazes of millions of Outerversal Morphons were observing the shocking dominance of the Instrument of the Beyonder against even Pioneers of Existence, their eyes burning with incredulity and fervor when these booming intent of Palace Master Antiope even reached them.
The moment they did hear it, clamor and chaos erupted!

chapters.title: Chapter 3437 The Fragility of Existence! I
paragraphs: To the Outerversal Morphons, the idea of the Instrument of the Beyonder was something that held together their core beliefs.
Even the Heretical Morphons who did not want to risk the end of the Megalos Beyond on a single being also held that core belief.
Of his identity as a pure Outerversal Morphon spoken about by the Great Beyonder.

To be talked about differently by another- for him to even be called the reincarnation of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian...this offended every ounce of belief of the Outerversal Morphons as Outerversal Authority chaotically surged about the entire Pantheon of Umbra.
It seemed as if a giant beast that had laid dormant this entire time was waking.

Towards the center of the Pantheon of Umbra, the visage of the Instrument of the Beyonder lay protected by the Observer of Old and Young along with the Great Mother whose tentacles radiated a livid light at this moment.
The Great Wheel was watching their grandiose statures with a stern expression as he steadily began to rise to the stellar black skies of the Pantheon of Umbra, his voice booming out.

|On this day, we see the Instrument of the Beyonder wage war against a Palace of the Expanse by himself- against those stemming from Matter without so much as doubt or hesitation. He fights for us until he is maliciously labeled with names as I ask you all...why are we not fighting beside him? Where is our support to the Instrument of the Beyonder?!|
Such a resonant intent boomed out far and wide, crossing the tall valleys of the Pantheon of Umbra and the sordid mountain that hid millions of Outerversal Morphons.
He asked, where was their support of the Instrument of the Beyonder?
And before they could even answer, the Great Wheel continued.

|We have played back and forth with those stemming from Matter, inserting our tendrils into their Omniverses and simply biding our time and lying in wait. I say enough is enough. To support the campaign of the Instrument of the Beyonder, I will use every ounce of force I have gathered in the Megalos Ynnere and begin a campaign against the very roots of the beings that dare to blaspheme the grandeur of the Instrument of the Beyonder! Who shall move with me?!|
It was a booming intent that was followed by a stark silence.
But an instant later...
|OOOOH!|
|OOOOH!|
|WUUU!|

Horrifying bellows and shrills of Outerversal Morphons from the depths of the worst nightmares boomed out, Outerversal Authority whipping about the Pantheon of Umbra and beginning to spill out like an endless sea.
Out there, there were many beings who would make a move based on their own ideals.
At this moment, some opportunistic beings moved to ignite a war.
A single opportunistic being moved to ignite a Megalos War!
In the depths of the Pantheon of Umbra, the livid tentacles of the Great Mother watched all of this while she stared at the body of Ozymandias brimming with silent power.
How she wished she could at least aid him within that Blancverse where he currently faced multiple Pioneers of Existence and over a hundred Existence Severing Palace Masters!
In the dazzling cluster of power that represented the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse.
As the shocking declaration from Palance Master Antiope spread out, it had different implications for many beings.

In die distance, Pioneer Heracles had an ashen gaze as he affirmed this as well, the reality that the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian and the Instrument of the Beyonder being the same person...came with too many heavy implications!
One was that their efforts had failed.
They had done all they could to call upon the weavings of that place to take away this being, and yet a part of him still remained and even came to take revenge today!
The other was that somehow, three of the terrifying Calamities to appear in the future were connected.
And the reason that nothing changed even after everything they had done...meant that these Calamites would still unfold in the future!
|Ah...| At this point, the eyes of Pioneer Heracles bloomed with dim radiance as he thought of something.

One of the reasons for the heavy conflicts between the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian and other forces in the Expanse that caused such a widespread war and destruction was because he was hunted by all of these groups for his lineage.
For his blood.
What followed after that was a sequence of events that only led to wars and cataclysm!
He tried to remember.
Where...had the identity of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian first identified that caused many Palaces of the Expanse to chase after him?
A tinge of pain crossed through his head at this question as he found...that he couldn't remember.

Their weavings of existence were scrambled with some lost when they crossed Frequencies of Existence to arrive here, and he seemed to have this lost memory as his gaze only became more ashen when he thought of it!
His blue eyes reflected their endless allure within as he found himself asking.
|Was it...us?|
Beside him, the maddened Pioneer shining with white wings, Pioneer Lightsun gazing towards him with confusion as he wondered what he could be mumbling about in a situation such as this!
'Heracles, is it true? What is the history between you three and this being? Is he truly the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian?!'
The voice of Pioneer Lightsun boomed in his mind as Heracles didn't answer.
He found himself dazed while questioning...whether they were actually the initiators of a terrifying future.

The Calamity that was the Infiniverse Dowager, Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian, and the Instrument of the Beyonder...were they actually the root cause for the progression of events that led to all this?!
But they only moved and made the choices they made due to these Calamities themselves!
Uncertainty circled around his weavings of existence as he didn't know how to think about this, but he found himself questioning many things.
He found himself thinking about the Calamities he heard of or saw from a distance.
The Calamity that was the Nine Pointed Star!
The Calamity that was the Great Usurper!
The Calamity that was the Queen of Matter!
All of them...would not be connected in some way, right?

A tinge of pain crossed through his head at this question as he found...that he couldn't remember.

Their weavings of existence were scrambled with some lost when they crossed Frequencies of Existence to arrive here, and he seemed to have this lost memory as his gaze only became more ashen when he thought of it!
His blue eyes reflected their endless allure within as he found himself asking.
|Was it...us?|
Beside him, the maddened Pioneer shining with white wings, Pioneer Lightsun gazing towards him with confusion as he wondered what he could be mumbling about in a situation such as this!
'Heracles, is it true?
What is the history between you three and this being?
Is he truly the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian?!'
The voice of Pioneer Lightsun boomed in his mind as Heracles didn't answer.
He found himself dazed while questioning...whether they were actually the initiators of a terrifying future.

The Calamity that was the Infiniverse Dowager, Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian, and the Instrument of the Beyonder...were they actually the root cause for the progression of events that led to all this?!
But they only moved and made the choices they made due to these Calamities themselves!
Uncertainty circled around his weavings of existence as he didn't know how to think about this, but he found himself questioning many things.
He found himself thinking about the Calamities he heard of or saw from a distance.
The Calamity that was the Nine Pointed Star!
The Calamity that was the Great Usurper!
The Calamity that was the Queen of Matter!
All of them...would not be connected in some way, right?

chapters.title: Chapter 3438 The Fragility of Existence! II
paragraphs: As one man wondered what was and what could be.
As he wondered of the ages past and the ages to come, and how everything was connected, he wondered of many possibilities to the point that he felt like he was going in circles!
As he did all this.
His cerulean pupils reflected the scene around him as terrific power bloomed all around.

A second Pioneer of Existence had appeared far above others here, his visage similar to the one floating right beside him as he had white wings gloriously flowing behind him, a white robe adorning his visage as glorious white flames burned around him.

On the right, a Silver Feathered Phoenix cried out with valor and regality, and lastly, a calm looking man in green robes and a bamboo hat who was gazing at everything with a serene gaze also appeared!
It was all the Pioneers who were called to observe the snapping of the Strings of Existence and report to those above them.
The Silver Feathered Phoenix moved first as she bellowed out.
|Apprehend him!|
WAA!
Not kill him. No collapse of his weavings of existence.
But apprehend.
This single word already showed the stance that these Pioneers were taking after hearing the screeches of Palace Master Antiope!

They wanted to confirm by locking down and apprehend this Instrument of the Beyonder as if he was actually a Megalonian- a resurgence of that ancient race of beings whose destruction paved the way for the birth of many of the current Pioneers and Source Complexity Entities...there were too many possibilities!
SKAA!
The screech of the Phoenix boomed out as her Path was also laid out.

Inviolable in nature, a silver brilliance flashed over everything and everyone here as it was so pristine it seemed like a mirror had appeared and layered itself over everything, and in the next moment...
WAP!
Everything covered by this light disappeared.
Everything the equivalent length of a quarter of an Omniverse nearby!
The other Pioneers. The Palace Masters nearby.
And the Instrument of the Beyonder as well!
It was the brief flash of the Pioneered Path of Dimensionality of the Silver Feathered Phoenix of the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse!
In the depths of the Immovable Palace of the Expanse, others watched such a scene with somber eyes as there were still Pioneers hidden who had yet to make a move.

Outside of the Blancverse domain, the Great Mother became grave at the disappearance of the Instrument of the Beyonder, but she remained right where she stood even under the possible threat of being killed if any of those remaining hidden Pioneers that always stood guard over the Expanse moved!
She had tremendous belief as she remained where she was, gazing deeply into the Blancverse where it seemed like the whole battlefield was moved to a place where none of them could see.
At a corner of the Blancverse where the Great Mother was not looking towards.
There was a figure of a Palace Master who just so happened to have stayed far enough away, and a veil of shadows covered his figure as his pupils shone with a golden glow.
Unbeknownst to all others, this being crushed a jewel in the depths of his heart that sent out a message.
|Weavings of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian have been discovered. Current position in the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse- awaiting further orders.|
Nobody else was privy to the message this being sent.
Nobody else would even know where it was headed!
But at this moment, this message flashed across multiple strings of existence, bouncing between some and coursing through others as it took exactly 5 seconds.
Five total seconds, and it arrived at an extremely distant place in a corner of the Expanse.
Here, there were Blancverses that didn't actually have the allure of white, and they were fantastically colored gold as at least a dozen were floating serenely in a formation.
Towards the central Blancverse, a gold light flashed and disappeared towards a starry purple gold sea that covered over half of this domain.
Inside this sea, thousands of massive humanoid bodies of titans could be seen, their skin gold in color as their bodies expressed tremendous regality and power!
This regality was truly hard to imitate or ever fake as it was born within them- carried by their very lineage.

All of these thousands of massive golden titans that seemed to be as big as cosmos if not larger emanated terrific aura of Existence Severing Entities as just in this region, at least above a hundred Pioneers could also be observed.
They were all quiet, and they were all silent as if they were cultivating a grandiose weaving of existence!

At the center of all of these Golden Titans, there was one who opened his eyes with a boom at this moment as silent fluctuations spread out, his weavings accepting a burst of information as his eyes flashed brightly!
|Origin...Sacred Primal...Megalonian...|
His intent was deep as if it had not spoken in quite a long time, and it reverberated out and woke up some of the Golden Titans near him!
His intent was filled with a deep sense of Complexity- as if this being had already grasped a Source.
A low hum reverberated from him as his golden eyes looked around, his bald head filled with visible gold veins turning as he looked at a few Golden Titans before he spoke out.
|I cannot move currently, but go and check the veracity of these rumors regarding the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian. If there is any truth to them...hmm...|
The Golden Titan hummed as he gave the order.
And from the purple gold sea, at least 20 Golden Titans radiating horrific grandeur of Pioneers arose, their gold eyes flashing with brilliant callous light.
They held a deep history with the weavings of Megalonians.
The power they had gained, the war that followed, and the current structure of the Expanse all held some relation to that past event!

chapters.title: Chapter 3439 The Fragility of Existence! III
paragraphs: From a unique point in the Expanse, 20 Golden Titans rose up and followed a command.
Verify the veracity and truth of the reappearance of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian.
After all, they couldn't just go on the word of someone who may just be using this as a tactic to wipe out their enemy!
And yet the weavings of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian were important enough for 20 Pioneers to be deployed for confirmation!
Their orders were simple ones.
Contain, apprehend, and verify.
If it truly was the resurgence of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian, they would be going about things differently than before!
In the past, due to how shockingly effective the effects of Megalonians were on elevating the existence of those who devoured them, they were quickly and entirely wiped out.
|But not this time...|
The Source Complexity Golden Titan smiled with a cold expression as he remembered the weavings passed down to him by the most important personage of the Golden Titans.
The personage had stated how he had dreamed of events long past and remembered the Megalonians they destroyed in the Megalos Mountains.
He had especially dreamed of a defiant Megalonian that slipped through his hands.
From the devoured memories of other Megalonians, he found out the identity of that Megalonian to be...Pyrrhus!
The only Megalonian who was not devoured back then.
The one who dissipated his own existence defiantly!
From this recent dream of that important personage, word was passed down to all their forces to pay attention to any news regarding Megalonians.
It was why based on rumors alone, he deployed 20 Pioneers of Existence!
Because the weavings of that important personage were never wrong, and he may have already discovered something way before others even began to live it.
But no.
There would be no swift death of the Megalonian this time around, if they really did exist.
There would be...a cultivation of more Megalonians. To raise more of them! To have an endless source of Megalonians that reproduce over time!

|A Farm raising Megalonians...how glorious would such a thing be? Would we still be limited to a single Frequency of Existence after that? Having to listen to the snobbish Watchers of the Wheelomachy, or choose between following the orders of the Logos of the Wheel? No, no, no....at such a time, our influence would be entrenched across different Frequencies of Existence, different Spokes of the Wheel!|
His eyes portrayed shocking greed amidst their calmness.
Advancing their complexity even past a Pioneer of Existence alone was far too extreme of a difficulty.
For the vast majority who arrived at the stage of Pioneers alone, they were stuck there.
Pioneering a path alone was hard enough as at this point, one had severed themselves from Existence as they were walking on an untrodden path.
As if they could only see a few inches ahead of them, and were blind of everything all around.
Even the most exceptional geniuses could simply only continue to reinforce their path. Very few would be able to find the Source!
And for those who did find the Source...they didn't even need to have their difficulties mentioned.
They needed something to spur them.
A catalyst!
Over the eons, the Megalonians...were known to be a perfect Catalyst.
Many Pioneers were born from their massacre. Multiple Source Complexity entities arose from their ashes!
So this time around...expectations were high.
|Let us see...let us see!|
Almost as if this unfathomably powerful was giddy, he waited!
From the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse, there wasn't only a single spy who observed the happenings and spread the word.
There were many others as word spread quickly- word of the rumor of the resurgence of the weavings of Megalonians!
Whether others believed they were true or not, they had to investigate.
And all of it...stemmed from a single Palace Master who in her fear of what was to come, linked two Calamities together.

For them to be visited by another Calamity hours after they dispatched two of them? For the Instrument of the Beyonder, an Outerversal Morphon, to display a similar golden Wheel just like the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian, and then for him to come specifically for the three of them?!

A Palace Master whose head was already filled with fear of brutality regarding Calamities they had met like the Infiniverse Dowager and the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian, or Calamities they had only heard records of like the Instrument of the Beyonder, the Nine Pointed Star, the Great Usurper, or the Queen of Matter.
They took a shot in the dark- a gamble, and the results would forever be etched in stone. Whether they were right in their assumption or not!
|What are you, really?!|
Under the unique isolated space brought to fruition by the Pioneer of Dimensionality.
Five Pioneers of Existence were locked in this space that currently seemed to be the size of half an Omniverse, along with a few dozen Palace Masters!
The Silver Feathered Phoenix radiated waves of brilliance that seemed capable of cutting apart everything as she continued.

|Your weavings are those of an Existence Severing entity, but I've noticed that the level of complexity directed towards you from even Pioneers...is capped to be at a maximum level comparable to Existence Severing! Is this your power? How long does such a thing last? Did you believe that just because others cannot momentarily attack you with complexity above your current stage, you could safely taunt and stand against Pioneers?!|
Her words were sharp as her power bubbled, a million silver mirror-like needles forming all around as her body burned with silver flames!
She looked at Ozymandias.
And Ozymandias looked at her along with all other entities locked with him in this isolated space.
He thought of the words of this Pioneer who tried to break down the workings of his Quintessential League of Existence as he nodded with a smile.

|Almost right about a few things. I will let you know that currently, you all stand in a different league of Existence entirely. To survive in this league, one had to be...Quintessential. Unrivaled at the same stage. If not, then many of you are about to understand something that many entities untouched by mana feel on a daily basis. You will feel...the fragility of your existence!|
WAA!

chapters.title: Chapter 3440 The Fragility of Existence! IV
paragraphs: Cheats had designed and put into place something to ensure fairness and unfairness at the same time.
A league of existence where all others were restricted to the same level of strength as him!

It was applicable to Pioneers to an extent, but if an entity even higher in complexity than this appeared within the periphery of the Quintessential League of Existence, this effect would be much lower.
It wouldn't be as absolutely carried out for entities such as those, which for example would be someone like Barbatos.
A Source Complexity entity!
Because of this, the backer behind the Quintessential League of Existence that was being designed, refined, and extrapolated more even at this time had to get more powerful.
If Cheats had undergone five Severings and became able to do this, it needed to undergo even more!
After all, unlike others, nothing stopped him from continuing to Sever his weavings of existence multiple times over.

If greater and greater amounts of complexity were the goal, why not continue severing his Ordinances another 10 times? Another 30 times? With every Severing, there would be an increase in complexity while it became further and further away from the weavings of existence themselves.
As he thought of this, the number buzzing within the weavings of cheats was a simple one.
This was the number of Severings he thought was obscene yet viable enough to do for every concept.
While others severed their singular weavings of Existence once, his goal would be to sever his over 100 different weavings 81 times each- with Cheats being the first!
It was a grand undertaking as to do this, more Blood of Pioneers was needed.
That's why...
|Come!|
BOOM!
Cheats bloomed out in exuberance as he ignored the other Pioneers, instead going towards his target here and the only dazed Pioneer who seemed to be thinking of too many things.
But...Pioneers were Pioneers even if they were being restricted to lower level weavings of Complexities.
|Answer me!|
WAA!
The Silver Feathered Phoenix cried out with regality as a silver mirror appeared in front of Pioneer Heracles, his body flashing and disappearing as her body flashed to appear where he was instead.

Her demeanor was dominating as her eyes flashed out, the weavings of existence in front of Ozymandias turning into shards of sharp silver shattered weavings of existence that surged towards him dangerously!
A golden Wheel appeared around his body and spun, the sea of Outerversal Authority and tentacles leaking out from him also seeking to taint as a booming impact echoed out.
The attack was heavy, and Ozymandias was stopped in place without being able to advance.
The scaling of power of these Pioneers was still far too high even after it was brought down in complexity!
|Boy, will you not answer?!|
The white winged Pioneers now appeared together, the white flames burning around them seething as they gazed out coldly.
Both Pioneered similar paths, but with slight variations.
One Pioneered the path of CHI, while the other pioneered the path of QI!
At this moment, their bodies pulsed with heaviness as akin to Haki being spread all around and putting pressure on everything nearby, their complexities descended all around!
Even the other Palace Masters felt stifled as they stayed to the side, and the Pioneer of QI made a move this time as he called out calmly.
|True QI Convergence Sword Art- Cut!|
TING!
His body moved like countless sharp blades.
Milky white sword lights shot out like a volcanic eruption as they were far too fast, every single one converging onto the rotating golden Wheel around Ozymandias as...
BOOM!

The Wheel was forcefully shattered, the hand of the Pioneer of QI being inches away from Ozymandias himself as a cutting force caused faint marks to appear on his body, a heavy force smashing him backwards!
|Hmph!|
The Pioneer of QI harrumphed domineeringly.
|Just because of a little imposition of a domain, you think you can reach the heights of a Pione-...!|
His words stopped.
Where his hand had struck out against Ozymandias, he saw that somehow, at a certain point in time, a cut had appeared.
And around this cut, silent, translucent tentacles that he only just noticed now were sucking out his Blood!
|Impudent!|
A burst of QI erupted from him as all invisible tentacles were crushed, his surroundings revealed to have thousands of such tentacles just waiting for someone to come near Ozymandias!
They eerily waved around as the mass of Black tentacles shooting from behind were merely a distraction.
|I told you.|
WUU!

In the distance, the visage of Ozymandias stopped after receiving the impact from the Pioneer of QI, tentacles converging towards his palm and releasing droplets of crimson gold blood that formed into a single Globule of Blood of a Pioneer.
|I will truly show you the Fragility of Existence today.|
The dazzling crimson gold Globule disappeared into his palm right after, and it was directed towards a single thing alone as at this moment, Cheats began to undergo its Sixth Severing!
OOOH!
Opposite him, the Pioneer of QI was enraged as he bellowed out, stellar white rivers erupting around him commandingly before he surged out again!
In the midst of all this.
Pioneer Heracles was now near Palace Master Antiope and Nisa, their expressions all different as Antiope healed herself while breathing haggardly.
Near them, the calm looking Pioneer in green robes and a bamboo hat had a gaze of serenity as he smiled while looking at them.

|So, Heracles, Antiope, Nisa. What's the backstory here? We accepted you all into our folds because of your uniqueness and power, but you didn't tell us anything regarding this. Instrument of the Beyonder? Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian? What is all this about?|
Unlike other Pioneers, this calm looking man radiated a silent and harmless air, but he was also known as the Immovable Sacred Guard!
His harmless air was something many had fallen to before as Heracles himself did not let his guard down around this being as he frowned.
What could they say? What could they even reveal?
When it came to different Frequencies of Existence, Entanglements and many other intricacies made things very difficult.
As he pondered how to navigate this, someone else didn't do as much pondering as Palace Master Antiope began to speak.
|That is a vile creature that only knows and seeks destruction. He is going to become a @%$&$-...!|
Palace Master Antiope stopped as it looked like she had begun speaking gibberish.
She was about to reveal his future status as a Calamity and what many others would come across, but she found herself unable to do so as if her words were being filtered!
