With every Severing, there would be an increase in complexity while it became further and further away from the weavings of existence themselves.
As he thought of this, the number buzzing within the weavings of cheats was a simple one.
This was the number of Severings he thought was obscene yet viable enough to do for every concept.
While others severed their singular weavings of Existence once, his goal would be to sever his over 100 different weavings 81 times each- with Cheats being the first!
It was a grand undertaking as to do this, more Blood of Pioneers was needed.
That's why...
|Come!|
BOOM!
Cheats bloomed out in exuberance as he ignored the other Pioneers, instead going towards his target here and the only dazed Pioneer who seemed to be thinking of too many things.
But...Pioneers were Pioneers even if they were being restricted to lower level weavings of Complexities.
|Answer me!|
WAA!
The Silver Feathered Phoenix cried out with regality as a silver mirror appeared in front of Pioneer Heracles, his body flashing and disappearing as her body flashed to appear where he was instead.

Her demeanor was dominating as her eyes flashed out, the weavings of existence in front of Ozymandias turning into shards of sharp silver shattered weavings of existence that surged towards him dangerously!
A golden Wheel appeared around his body and spun, the sea of Outerversal Authority and tentacles leaking out from him also seeking to taint as a booming impact echoed out.
The attack was heavy, and Ozymandias was stopped in place without being able to advance.
The scaling of power of these Pioneers was still far too high even after it was brought down in complexity!
|Boy, will you not answer?!|
The white winged Pioneers now appeared together, the white flames burning around them seething as they gazed out coldly.
Both Pioneered similar paths, but with slight variations.
One Pioneered the path of CHI, while the other pioneered the path of QI!
At this moment, their bodies pulsed with heaviness as akin to Haki being spread all around and putting pressure on everything nearby, their complexities descended all around!
Even the other Palace Masters felt stifled as they stayed to the side, and the Pioneer of QI made a move this time as he called out calmly.
|True QI Convergence Sword Art- Cut!|
TING!
His body moved like countless sharp blades.
Milky white sword lights shot out like a volcanic eruption as they were far too fast, every single one converging onto the rotating golden Wheel around Ozymandias as...
BOOM!

The Wheel was forcefully shattered, the hand of the Pioneer of QI being inches away from Ozymandias himself as a cutting force caused faint marks to appear on his body, a heavy force smashing him backwards!
|Hmph!|
The Pioneer of QI harrumphed domineeringly.
|Just because of a little imposition of a domain, you think you can reach the heights of a Pione-...!|
His words stopped.
Where his hand had struck out against Ozymandias, he saw that somehow, at a certain point in time, a cut had appeared.
And around this cut, silent, translucent tentacles that he only just noticed now were sucking out his Blood!
|Impudent!|
A burst of QI erupted from him as all invisible tentacles were crushed, his surroundings revealed to have thousands of such tentacles just waiting for someone to come near Ozymandias!
They eerily waved around as the mass of Black tentacles shooting from behind were merely a distraction.
|I told you.|
WUU!

In the distance, the visage of Ozymandias stopped after receiving the impact from the Pioneer of QI, tentacles converging towards his palm and releasing droplets of crimson gold blood that formed into a single Globule of Blood of a Pioneer.
|I will truly show you the Fragility of Existence today.|
The dazzling crimson gold Globule disappeared into his palm right after, and it was directed towards a single thing alone as at this moment, Cheats began to undergo its Sixth Severing!
OOOH!
Opposite him, the Pioneer of QI was enraged as he bellowed out, stellar white rivers erupting around him commandingly before he surged out again!
In the midst of all this.
Pioneer Heracles was now near Palace Master Antiope and Nisa, their expressions all different as Antiope healed herself while breathing haggardly.
Near them, the calm looking Pioneer in green robes and a bamboo hat had a gaze of serenity as he smiled while looking at them.
|So, Heracles, Antiope, Nisa.
What's the backstory here?
We accepted you all into our folds because of your uniqueness and power, but you didn't tell us anything regarding this.
Instrument of the Beyonder?
Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian?
What is all this about?|
Unlike other Pioneers, this calm looking man radiated a silent and harmless air, but he was also known as the Immovable Sacred Guard!
His harmless air was something many had fallen to before as Heracles himself did not let his guard down around this being as he frowned.
What could they say?
What could they even reveal?
When it came to different Frequencies of Existence, Entanglements and many other intricacies made things very difficult.
As he pondered how to navigate this, someone else didn't do as much pondering as Palace Master Antiope began to speak.
|That is a vile creature that only knows and seeks destruction.
He is going to become a @%$&$-...!|
Palace Master Antiope stopped as it looked like she had begun speaking gibberish.
She was about to reveal his future status as a Calamity and what many others would come across, but she found herself unable to do so as if her words were being filtered!

chapters.title: Chapter 3441 The Fragility of Existence! V
paragraphs: Filtered.
This was exactly the feeling that Palace Master Antiope felt as when she tried to speak about events and things that she had experienced herself, they seemed like a distant memory.
Ever since they came into this unique frequency, escaping from the violence and decimation carried out by calamities like the Infiniverse Dowager, part of their memories were already fractured.
And now she couldn't even speak about it?
She looked at the man in the bamboo hat as she tried to open her mouth again.
|The Instrument of the Beyonder is a @$&$#...!|
Once more, filtered.
She became terrified at such a reality as she looked up all around her, as if there was an unseen force that even she did not understand playing a hand in everything.
The Immovable Sacred Guard looked at this scene as his eyes lit up with understanding and recognition.
|I see, you three are not from this frequency of existence.|
Words that caused their expressions to rapidly change echoed out from the Immovable Sacred Guard.
This entity who remained calm without a change in expression as he nodded and looked towards Ozymandias.
|When it comes to dealing with intrusions and entanglements in different Spokes of the Wheel, a lot of people don't know just what truly goes into play.|
He seemed to speak from experience and knowledge as if this was something that he knew of to an extent.

|The Wheel of Existence is something that we know frighteningly little about. The Wheel spins as the Wheel spins, its workings unknown to our eyes. If it is something that goes against the weavings of the Wheel, one will come to find that no matter how much you try to go against it, it is as if you're going against the Wheel itself. Words will fail you. Information that should not be spread will not be spread unless your complexity is extremely high. Even you cannot escape this. You all likely come from a Frequency of the Wheel that has experienced a few things. You think that you came here or arrived here out of your own volition or understanding- I'll be the first to tell you that you are where you are because that is where you need to be.|

|You only came to this Frequency of the Wheel because that was what you were supposed to do. Palace Master Antiope here spoke about the Instrument of the Beyonder possibly being the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian, because she was supposed to. And now, here we all are- just as we are supposed to. I have found out about your indiscretion, and after this, I will report it to the Watchers who observe and ensure that the right people are in the right Frequencies of the Wheel. You three would likely be returned right here you came from, so do not despair and just hang tight.|
Terrifying words left the mouth of the Immovable Sacred Guard as the last sentence caused even Pioneer Heracles to shiver. They could not go back. Never!
BOOM!

With an eruption of magnificence, Pioneer Heracles shot upwards- crossing through the silver brilliance that the Pioneer of Dimensionality laid down. His purpose was singular: to leave everything behind!
At such a scene, the Immovable Sacred Guard only shook his head as a terrifying aura erupted from him.
In the far distance, the weavings of Ozymandias became even more complex as from behind- tens of thousands more obsidian tentacles erupted out!
The Quintessential League of Existence only became more potent under the additional severing of cheats- its effects applied even more thoroughly.
But much more was required.
He gazed at the pioneers of CHI and QI who now stayed side by side as they bellowed out.
|Move together!|

The Pioneers were not easy targets as at this point in time, Ozymandias could only injure them. The Paths they Pioneered were still distinct and far too complex even under the effect of the Quintessential League of Existence!
So he needed something even more unique than what they held to handle them while snipping away at their blood.
|The weavings of Cheats call upon the ever-silent deadly weavings of Plot.|
His mind buzzed with ideas and possibilities as after the Sixth Severing, Cheats proceeded to add another clause under the quintessential league of existence.
|The feature of the Plot of Tragedy has been incorporated into the Relegation Zone of Existence.|

|Under the Relegation Zone of Existence, a single Ordinance or Path of both the enemy combatants and yourself can be momentarily nullified by the alteration of the ongoing Plot. Both sides must be made aware of this weaving before it is carried out, and the Ordinance or Path that is the source of the Quintessential League of Existence is an exception. Once nullified, the selected Ordinances or Paths will remain in this state unless either side has their weavings and complexity perish.|
A glorious new ruling under the banner of a Quintessential League of Existence!
A ruling of sacrifice on both sides.
And Ozymandias deployed it right away as at this moment, a bright fluctuation of intent echoed out for every single entity in this space.
Now, this intent was easy to understand and every single entity was told exactly how they worked.
The Pioneers were enraged at it as it seemed infallible, and so they moved quickly.
|Your weavings of Outerversal Authority are null and void!|
The Pioneer of CHI bellowed out as shockingly, every single tentacle and the budding black sea of obsidian majesty disappeared in an instant.
All Outerversal authority was gone!
Ozymandias smiled at this and nodded.
|Understandable.|
And he disappeared right after.
When his massive figure reappeared, he was far above this Domain of Dimensionality as his figure appeared in front of Pioneer Heracles.
Someone who was currently trying to leave this place after hearing the words of the Immovable Sacred Guard.
His eyes turned livid with power and a sense of madness as he raised his hand up, the brilliance of purple blue majesty seeking to erupt as his Pioneered Path of Time was about to reverse everything.
But...
His purple blue radiance flickered and did not unfold.
Above him, Ozymandias looked down coldly as his intent weaved out.
|Your path was never active this whole time.|

chapters.title: Chapter 3442 The Fragility of Existence! VI
paragraphs: Plot deemed it so.
Thereafter, a heavy glow of gold erupted out as an intricate golden wheel moved from the body of Ozymandias and descended unto Pioneer Heracles as if it were a cutting disk.
ZING!
It was far too quick.
In the span of an instant, the golden wheel passed from the head of a pioneer and cleaved all the way through.
The eyes of Pioneer Heracles irradiated a tremendous blue light as he could only watch without understanding exactly what was unfolding.
Thereafter, his body was cleaved in half as gushes of blood erupted out!
|You should not have done what you did, O Pioneer Heracles.|
The only thing he heard was the voice of a calamity that he only heard about, but he could swear that it held the musings of a calamity that he had previously met!

The scene was a terrifying one as right after, the geysers of erupting crimson gold blood of Pioneer Heracles were pulled up by a terrific suction force from the visage of the Instrument of the Beyonder. Without the protection of his path, Pioneer Heracles still observed everything occurring in a daze!
The calamities that he ran away from in a long distant past and future. The Calamities that he told Palace Masters Antiope and Nisa to never underestimate.

He told them again and again that these entities defied existence itself to the point that when you thought they were dead, they somehow weren't, and even if they were actually dead, somehow- there was another part of them that came to haunt them!
This was exactly what they were.
Calamities.
And if the words of the Immovable Sacred Guard were to be believed, everything was playing out exactly as it should have.
Was it truly so? Was he and Palace Masters Antiope and Nisa just pawns to initiate everything?
Was he...supposed to have the complexity that he had worked hard to raise up again collapse right here?

Who got to decide this? What should happen and should not happen? Even though he had Severed himself from Existence itself and Pioneered his own Path of Time, he still couldn't carve out his own future?!
He wanted to say that he did not accept this.
He wanted to do many things.
But all he saw was the dominating visage of the Instrument of the Beyonder as only regrets remained.
'Maybe...we should have left the calamities alone...'
This thought passed through his mind as he wondered how things would have played out differently.
As he saw his blood being gathered by the Instrument of the Beyonder, he couldn't help but utter out his intent.
|You...are just a pawn in all this as well, you know?|
A pawn.
If things were playing out as they should have always played out, then weren't even the Calamities mere pawns of something larger? The Wheel? Or something else entirely?
Yet towards his words, Ozymandias only smiled and shook his head.
BOOM!
Between them, a bamboo hat appeared that obscured the gaze of Pioneer Heracles, a multicolored brilliance flashing between him and the Instrument of the Beyonder as they were pulled apart.
The Immovable Sacred Guard floated there, gazing straight towards Ozymandias calmly as he watched the dazzling globules of blood disappearing into his body.
|You seem to really like devouring the Blood of others. Of course, I can't allow you to freely do so.|
The blood of others. The globules of the blood of Pioneers of Existence!
Ozymandias was about to decimate the core Entity responsible for sending his other half into Hell Terra Firma as the major thing he did was collect his blood and weavings!
And oh, did he gain a lot!
|18 Globules of the Blood of the Pioneer of Time, Heracles, have been obtained.|
The prompt flashed in his mind as right away...
'11 to continue Severing Cheats. One to Quintessence, one to Ingeniare, one to Plot, one to Loot, one to Infinity, one to Mana, one to Runes.'
HUUM!
His surroundings trembled tumultuously.
His already radiant figure began to emanate an astounding allure of magnificence.
His complexity began to shoot up exponentially!
ZIING! ZIING!
As if multiple different things were being cut within the depths of his existence, as if multiple sources were being severed.
He extended this severing from just Cheats alone as he also elevated and granted a huge jump onto a few key concepts. Since he had many, let him use many!
Since Mana made it possible to transform and change every single ordinance into one and allowed the declaration of his many ordinances, let it also be raised ever higher!
|The Weavings of Quintessence have undergone their first Severing of Existence!|
|The Weavings of Mana have undergone their first Severing of Existence!|
|The Weavings of Infinity have undergone their first Severing of Existence!|
|The Weavings of Runes have undergone their first Severing of Existence...!|
One by one, seven more Ordinances were severed.
BOOM!
His own body erupted with multicolored radiance as he stared at the man in the bamboo hat down below.
He stared at the bisected body of Pioneer Heracles as he was caught by the Pioneers of CHI and QI, their faces livid while gazing in his direction.
As the very density and complexity of his existence surged up, Ozymandias looked at the many changes blooming within this isolated Dimensionality as his intent weaved out.

|Look at how fragile existence is. At the nullification of a single Path of a Pioneer, and that was it. His whole complexity, all of his weavings...reduced to absolutely nothing- a mere fraction of what it was before.|
WAA!
The figure of Pioneer Heracles was nearly decimated, but his weavings were still there.
|If a Pioneer of Existence can be this fragile, what about mere Existence Severing entities? What about these oh-so-prideful Palace Masters of the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse?|
He looked around at the distant figures of Palace Masters- especially Palace Master Antiope and Nisa, who trembled with visible fear while gazing at the nearly decimated visage of Heracles!

chapters.title: Chapter 3443 Pawns! I
paragraphs: Fear was a curious thing.
In many people, fear gave way to recklessness, weakness, and madness. Fear was a gateway for many, many bad choices.
Three entities, in particular, feared the identity and very being of what they knew to be a Calamity.
So as they watched with their own eyes as one of them- the most powerful among them, almost decimated by one of the calamities they escaped from, their fear reached unprecedented levels!
|We must leave!|
Palace Master Nisa bellowed out.
At the same time, the bloodied figure of Palace Master Antiope looked towards the Silver Feathered Phoenix as she pleaded.
|O Pioneer of Dimensionality, please release us from this domain. If you all must stay, that is more than okay, but please let us return to the Immovable Sacred Palace!| ...!
They plead.
Existence Severing Palace Masters pleaded to be taken out of the same enclosed domain as the instrument of the Beyonder!
The silver eyes of the Pioneer of Dimensionality flashed with disdain and distaste as she harrumphed with her intent booming out.
|You all sit on the sidelines as you will be questioned later, and we will get to the bottom of whatever intricacies of connections there are between you and this invader!|
The faces of Palace Masters Antiope and Nisa became ashen as they realized their pleading would get them nowhere.
They wanted to say that for all of them here, there may not be a later. When it came to calamities that defied existence, a future was never guaranteed!
The situation had rapidly changed as at this moment, the Pioneer of Dimensionality was moving alongside the Pioneer of QI and the Pioneer of CHI.
The Pioneer of CHI burned with white flames as a dazzling white Rune began to bloom on his chest, the circulation of his weavings reaching unprecedented levels as he called out heavily.

|This invader has laid down a fairly powerful domain that seems to be moving alongside him. A domain capable of even affecting Pioneers as entire paths can be nullified within this domain. But as always, for something so powerful, there is a cost. As we have seen, we were able to seal his usage of Outerversal Authority for him to choose the seal of the Pioneered Path of Time under Heracles. Theoretically, he should now be powerless, and yet he isn't- meaning that this entity is an anomaly that may have another one or two Severed Ordinances. An impossibility, but they may appear from time to time. All that we need to do is to ensure that we seal his remaining paths, and this fight will no longer be a fight!|
A terrifying white eye of existence was burning on top of the Pioneer of CHI as he analyzed many things and laid out a plan.
Ahead of them, the Immovable Sacred Guard remained calm with the same expression on his face as he stared towards Ozymandias carefully.
He stared at the seemingly increased level of complexity around him, his gaze a pondering one as he spoke out.

|The Instrument of the Beyonder, yes? If I can express anything before there is more bloodshed to be carried out, it is that all of this is meaningless in the grand scheme of things. What you do here will not change much. Whether you manage to kill the three that you came to kill- these intruders from different Frequencies of Existence. Whether you are an intruder yourself that has chased them here. Whether you manage to hurt me or any of the other Pioneers of the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse who are currently here...it will change nothing in the grand scheme of the Wheel of Existence.|
His gaze was utterly serene. His eyes pulsed with a verdant light of brilliance as he seemed to gaze at everything with apathy and interest at the same time!
He smiled towards Ozymandias and continued.

|Do you know of the countless records just in our Frequencies of Existence? Of the powerful entities within this frequency that are more powerful than me or you? Do you know what they have managed to change in regard to the Wheel of Existence over the eons? Absolutely nothing. The Wheel turns as the Wheel turns, all of us being mere pawns in the grand scheme of things as the most that we can do is sit back, relax, and enjoy.|
His words even caused the other Pioneers and Palace Masters to change.

Ozymandias stared at this unique being with calm eyes as he analyzed the rapid change of his complexity with all of the newly Severed weavings of existence in addition to Cheats continuing its Severings.
He looked at this being as a colorless light of Quintessence and Loot began to burn around him, his intent echoing out in reply.

|Of the few things I dislike in all of existence, the idea of being a pawn or someone that merely has to fall in line in some grand destiny... I dislike this the most. I make my choices, then my choices affect the outcomes around me. Just like I gave you all the choice to not get involved and simply give me the three that I came here for- you all made a choice, and now here we are.|
Choices.
Causality!
His words rang out and caused many gazes to change, but the Immovable Sacred Guard actually let out a light chuckle at this moment and nodded.

|Choices, huh? In that regard, you are right. So let me make a choice right here and now. You wanted those three right? I can give you Antiope and Nisa, but I have to keep Heracles for myself. Someone to question when the Watcher gets here. He is half dead anyway with a major part of his weavings taken by you. How does this sound?|
An unexpected proposition came that shocked everyone, cries ringing out from even the Pioneers of QI and CHI!
|O Pioneer of Teleology!|
|Sir, we cannot!|

chapters.title: Chapter 3444 Pawns! II
paragraphs: Vehement cries echoed out as the other Pioneers of the Immovable Sacred Palace found the words of the Immovable Sacred Guard to be drastic.
To give the Instrument of the Beyonder exactly what he wanted after all that had happened so far?
The thousands upon thousands of Ordinance of Existence and Ordinance Amalgamation entities that had perished within the Prime Immovable Blancverse?!
They couldn't possibly just move past all of this!
And yet the figure of the Immovable Sacred Guard did not falter.
He even waved his hands right after as the shocked figures of Palace Master Antiope and Nisa were pulled by an undeniable force and flung towards Ozymandias!
BOOM!
His thick arms moved as they grabbed at the necks of the two gorgeous women, their hair dazzlingly falling on his stellar obsidian skin.
Comparing his complexity to them right now was akin to a comparison between a normal human being and an Olympic athlete.

He did not even have to impose the Plot of Tragedy on these beings as his profound weavings of complexity pressed down on them from all around and stopped the eruption of their Severed weavings of Existence.

After all, apart from Cheats, Kuklos, and the currently inactive Outerversal, there were now the Severed Weavings of Quintessence, Mana, Loot, Runes, Ingeniare, Plot, and Infinity cycling through him!

He grabbed and contained their weavings of existence as he saw the waves of fear and terror in their eyes, their figures trying to turn around to look at the Pioneers and even the Palace Masters behind as they wanted to beg.
Ozymandias stared at the entity that had made a different choice as he hummed and thought to himself.
|Different choices were made. Does this change the outcome?|
The bamboo hat of the Immovable Sacred Guard shone with a dim luster as he raised his hands towards the angry Pioneers behind him and stopped any eruption of authority.

And behind him, the Pioneer of CHI wanted to say that they could play along and utilize the rules of the unique domain that the Instrument of the Beyonder had laid down. They would only have to nullify one or two more Ordinances of this being and he would not be able to even fight against them anymore!
And yet he saw that the Immovable Sacred Guard remained staunch in his position as if he knew something that they did not.
|Interesting.|

Ozymandias voiced out as from his hands, colorless chains of severed Quintessence flowed out freely and wrapped around the figures of Palace Master Antiope and Nisa, their bodies becoming entirely covered by this silver light before they disappeared right after!
He had many questions.
Their weavings and records would have some answers.
As for Pioneer Heracles...his weakening Pioneered Path of Time was continuing to collapse as even if he didn't die, Ozymandias would regain the nullified cost of Outerversal soon!

He looked at the Immovable Sacred Guard as this entity had made an entirely different choice. He looked at the figure of Pioneer Heracles who was barely hanging on to life as he gauged how much time it would take and nodded.
|The entanglement between us is not one that is irredeemable. We can stop here.|

He didn't crave baseless violence. He came for what he wanted, and he got it. But even with all of this, he didn't doubt that even if he was not looking for any enemies, many more than those who were here would come to find him. After all, the shrewd woman who was the Palace Master Antiope had called to everyone that he was the resurgence of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian!
Cause and effect.

With just that alone, there could be a stream of enemies that came for him. The only thing he had to do was to ensure his survival as he needed to empower the Quintessential League of Existence so that entities with extremely complex weavings of existence would not be able to ignore or mitigate the effects.
At this unfolding of reality, the Immovable Sacred Guard nodded and smiled as he spoke out to the Pioneer of Dimensionality.
|Let us return to our original location. The fight here has ended.|
His voice was inviolable.

The other Pioneers were frustrated as they looked with glaring eyes towards Ozymandias, but they could not do anything to go against the words of this man before them. Was he not curious to affirm the veracity of whether this being truly had connections to the Megalonians?
They had many questions, but they moved to do what they were told as the silver brilliance of mirrors pulsed all around the surroundings.
In an instant, weavings distorted as everyone found themselves back on the Prime Immovable Blancverse.
And yet... the weavings of the surroundings were unfathomably heavy.
The members of the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse could be seen within as three more veiled Pioneers were now floating within the Prime Immovable Blancverse and staring outwards.
Their appearance also caused many eyes to land on them as the surrounding reality gradually became clear.
Outside of the Blancverse, the figure of the Great Mother was trembling as a man with a muscular visage floated above her- bronze chains emanating from him and piercing her tentacled figure!
He radiated the aura of the Pioneer as he looked into the Prime Immovable Blancverse with curiosity.

He wasn't the only one here as in the surroundings of the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse, the auras of multiple different weavings of existence could be felt ranging from Ordinance Amalgamation all the way to Pioneers.
The word that was spread by Palace Master Antiope had gone far and wide.
Ozymandias looked outside of the Blancverse Domain of the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse and felt the many auras dangling out there as he hummed and smiled.
His wings, Invictus Maximus, vibrated behind him with the allure of Causality.
Cause and effect!
It all went hand in hand as he would never have a shortage of those throwing themselves at his feet as enemies!
|My oh my, we seem to have gained a great deal of guests in our very short absence.|
The intent of the Immovable Sacred Guard echoed out as he looked around with a smile.
Around the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse, he could already pinpoint Entities from ancient forces stretched out across the Expanse- their history deep and their complexity immeasurable!

chapters.title: Chapter 3445 Identity! I
paragraphs: The scene was one that could be etched down in history!
Rarely did the glorious factions stretched out across the Expanse gather together, such a thing only occurring for truly momentous occasions or when gathered by a truly complex force.
A terrifying war.
A banquet hosted by utterly terrifying Source Complexity entities.
A complex force.

At this moment, there was a single complex force that gathered every single entity here. He looked around him- at the myriad of entities that he had never met before nor had he ever envisioned, and yet at this moment they stood and gazed towards his direction.
As if they all knew exactly who their target here was- as if his very image had been plastered all around!
In such a situation, the Immovable Sacred Guard gazed at everyone as if he was welcoming gracious guests.
|I would invite you all into our little Blancverse, if only I knew the cause of why everyone is gathered here. I wonder what it could be?|
His eyes were smiling dangerously, and at the same time, they seemed cold and callous as they affirmed there were truly too many spies in his Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse!
For all of these forces to have been gathered here after the mere mention of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian?

|Do not play games O Pioneer of Teleology. Were you able to confirm the words of your Palace Master? That this man is indeed connected to the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian? And how is it that your people came to know of such a thing?|
A booming voice that caused the outer ring of the Blancverse to tremble from its sheer complexity alone echoed out.
It belonged to an entity that looked like a massive tree the size of the cosmos- with a radiant and majestic face present on the center of the trunk of this tree!
It was an Elder Eonic Ent of the End!
It radiated the aura of a Pioneer as behind it, three other Pioneers and over twenty-five Existence Severing Eonic Ents of the End could be seen, each one shimmering with gold-green radiance.
The Immovable Sacred Guard looked towards this extremely complex being as he shrugged.

|How am I to know the answers to such questions? I find it odd that none of you direct these questions to the man himself. He is right here- the so called Instrument of the Beyonder. The entity that the Outerversal Morphons have been waiting for. Apparently, from the words of a single Existence Severing entity, he also happens to be the Reincarnated Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian. I do not know whether this holds any merit.|
A silent smile remained on the face of the Immovable Sacred Guard as he stated this.
And the gazes of many entities came to lock onto Ozymandias' figure as an immense silence settled in.
Within this silence...
HOONG!

A deep horn resounded as if it was amplifying the arrival of a truly complex form of life. The gases of many changed at the blaring of this horn as they also turned their eyes in the distance to observe the procession of twenty dazzling Golden Titans.
Each one radiated a horrific aura of a Pioneer of Existence, but there was one Golden Titan in particular who seemed to excel all others.
This Golden Titan had a single eye pulsing with crimson gold light, a flaming gold crown swirling above him as he wielded a pillar made of trillions of golden suns in his hands.
His mere arrival expressed shocking dominance as he looked into the depths of the Blancverse and honed in on the visage of the Instrument of the Beyonder, his intent booming out.
|It is stated that you are the resurgence of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian, do you deny it?|
WUU!
His intent alone, what's so powerful, that his last few words hung in the air and repeated themselves again and again.
Do you deny it?! DO YOU DENY IT?!
Yes.
A simple way for many to ascertain was for this being to say that it was all nonsense.
That it was merely a ruse from his enemy.
And yet...
Ozymandias smiled.
He didn't gaze at the Golden Titan that had just spoken, nor did he gaze at the myriad of other forces that had arrived here.
His gaze landed on the Pioneer who currently bound down the Great Mother. The only follower who came with him to wage what seemed to be like the pointless war not too long ago.

Who said a Pioneer could bully her and hold her life in his hands? His weavings began to burn as he did not give anyone an answer. He did not deny the assertions that he was the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian, nor did he bellow out in affirmation that he indeed was what he was accused of being!
|When it comes to such an issue, why would one remain silent? The cleanest way is to obtain and secure his weavings of existence! No more of this back and forth!|
In the distance, the visage of a Nine-Headed Omnivodragon bellowed out as behind it, variations of the regal lineage of Dragons were present.
Different weavings of existence held different views on how things should unfold.
And those who held the most complexity would decide exactly how things unfolded!
|Now, now...|
In this already chaotic situation, another voice rose to prominence as from a corner of the Expanse; golden strings became tainted black as a sea of Outerversal Authority surged forth.

Millions of tentacles flowed out freely as the auras of multiple Pioneers filled with horror inducing power bloomed, a titanic Outerversal Morphons with the face of a squid and a humanoid body floating forward while the tentacles on his face twisted into a smile!
|Do none of you think the Eldritch Palaces of the Expanse will have no say as to what happens to one of our own?|
Weavings of Matter were already involved.
Now, weavings of Dark Matter also began to intertwine as an already chaotic situation deteriorated at a rapid pace!

chapters.title: Chapter 3446 Identity! II
paragraphs: Noah did not actively seek out trouble or enemies.
But they always seemed to have a way of finding him.
He had only arrived in the expanse as he focused on himself and understanding exactly where he was at.
Thereafter, he met Bob, and then an array of existences who sought to claim the Blancverse that he had attained.

It became a source of great conflict as a Daughter of Existence perished due to her greed, such a thing causing his weavings to be brought to the attention of forces within the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse.

Within the expanse, there were the Pioneer Heracles and two Palace Masters who then proceeded to carry out an irreversible act against him by sending the other half of his existence to a place that was barren with any authorities!
In retaliation, the other remaining half of his existence went to collect these debts as a conflict sparked with all of the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse.
From this conflict, the distinction of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian was uttered, whether truthfully or not.
And now, here they were.
Entities from ancient Palaces of the Expanse making their appearance, to the extent that even those stemming from the Source of Dark Matter appeared!

It looked like an existential keg about ready to explode as many eyes circled through the surroundings, the appearance of more and more Outerversal Morphons blooming behind the vibrant Outerversal Sea that was tainting the golden strings of existence in the distance.
Their intentions were not entirely clear at this moment, but all those gathered here...were here for the singular possible weaving of a Megalonian.
That was how pristine a Megalonian was!
In the middle of such a perilous situation.

The man at the center of it all radiated a calm allure of power as he kept his eyes on a bronze shining humanoid Pioneer just outside of the Blancverse who had chains radiating from his body and piercing into the tentacled figure of the Great Mother.
Within him, multiple Severed weavings of Existence swirled as his eyes pulsed with profound epiphanies.
Epiphanies of causality. Of actions and their reactions!
His own complexity seemed to be wriggling- twisting and turning as it achieved greater heights during this whole process!
He began to float towards the Great Mother whose tentacles pulsed defiantly even against a Pioneer, his intent echoing out for all to hear.
|I do not particularly enjoy bloodshed and carnage, but if it comes, I more than welcome it.|
WAA!
His stellar obsidian radiance became even more exotic as the gold black wings on his back pulsed with blasts of grandiosity.
|Let it be known that for anyone here who chooses to point their complexity against me should also be ready for the collapse and decimation of their complexity of existence.|
Short and sweet.
After he finished such shocking words that caused the eyes of many to flash with brilliance, his figure took a step and disappeared!
Instantly!
Cerulean brilliance erupted around his stellar obsidian figure as ignoring everything else, he disappeared like a blinding bolt of complexity towards the Great Mother!
His body subtly changed as over his stellar obsidian skin, Runes of cerulean infinity began to be etched all over.
He held a great deal of complexity. He missed the full weight and tonnage of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed, but he still had the weight of the Secondary Infiniverse Megalos Seed!
At this moment, he was taking the complexity of all of his Severed concepts and layering them with the very weight of Infinity.
Of his endless reserves of mana- where he sought to turn their most profound quality into an indomitable weight of existence!
The density of his body reached unprecedented levels as in his hands, the allure of quintessence shone in the form of two infinity symbols that were grasped in his own two hands.
He grasped the center of the dazzling colourless infinity symbols in each hand as they both seemed like discoid blades ready to cut apart anything they came across!
Within these grasped infinity symbols, illusory Runes of Existence shone with tremendous complexity as each one seemed to represent a different Severed Ordinance of Existence.

He reappeared between the Great Mother and the bronze humanoid Pioneer of Existence like a cluster of an unstoppable force, his hands swinging the infinity symbols that he held as if they were weapons as he cut across the bronze chest of this Pioneer.
A booming impact emerged!
BOOM!
Bronze chains shattered and broke as the eyes of the muscular humanoid Pioneer became stern, his figure smashed back a few miles before he re-oriented himself and looked over.

His body that showed a sense of indestructibility currently had a massive gash across his chest- crimson bronze blood leaking out as around Ozymandias, clusters of blood converged into two dazzling globules that were sucked into his body.
There, outside of the protection of the Blancverse, the regal visage of Ozymandias could be seen.

Cerulean tattoos of Infinity covered his obsidian body as they seemed to be coursing with the weight and weavings of other Ordinances within them, his gaze cold as he stood in front of the Great Mother protectively- having even injured a Pioneer of Existence as his Quintessential League of Existence remained fully active!
When others saw this scene, they were flabbergasted by two things.
One was the fact that this being could push back a Pioneer, and the other...was that he had freely left the security of a Blancverse to appear outside of it.
Was this a foolish action, or was he simply that confident? He answered them in the next moment as his figure gazed out at the myriad of entities out here.
At the over one hundred Pioneers so far and hundreds of Existence Severing entities!
He looked at all of them as his chest expanded defiantly, his eyes those of valor and might as he bellowed out a challenge to all those here!
|Lets! Fucking! Go!|
HOONG!
A horn blew.
Drums began to resound.
A symphony played as the initiating event to a truly drastic future began to unfold at this very moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 3447 A Spark! I
paragraphs: A symphony.

Nothing else could describe the booming sounds occurring at this very moment as the figure of the Instrument of the Beyonder, who was supposedly the resurgence of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian- he proceeded to injure and draw blood from a Pioneer of Existence!
He then bellowed out to the masses of other Pioneers in the surroundings. Over one hundred pioneers
A few hundred Existence Severing entities!
They were all witnesses to this glorious moment where a single entity defiantly rebelled against the masses, and his power was not even something astounding to speak about!
He radiated the aura of Severing even at this very moment, and yet even before Pioneers, he was defiant.
Why was this? What gave this man such complex strength? What gave him the confidence to do such a thing?
None of them knew. None!
Only the man in question knew exactly what he was doing as even while he moved to do this, his weavings were conducting a series of complexities that others could not even imagine.
One of these involved the two Palace Masters that he had captured. Antiope and Nisa.
Two of the three were responsible for his other half being locked away in a barren place right now.
Over the past few seconds, he proceeded to extend his tendrils of influence into their weavings as when they struggled- he collapsed them entirely!
He wanted their memories. He wanted their weavings of existence, and yet only the Severed Weavings of loot were able to bring about any profound effect.

[Severed Source of Existence]:: The entirety of accumulation of the Severed Weavings of Existence that an entity accumulated. The complexity of this Severed Source is somewhat high, and could be utilized as a base reagent when constructing a unique Rune of Existence, as a tool to Sever a Single Aspect of one's existence, or as a tool that may be viable in the research of Omniversal Weapons of Mass Destruction...
From a single Existence Severing entity came a single Severed Source of Existence!
It could do the equivalent of a single Drop of Blood of a Pioneer, but it was worthy of its distinction.
Apart from this, there came a few records.
Memories!

The memories he read were scattered in bits and pieces, their weavings being disordered almost as if purposefully- many things were hidden not just from him, but even Antiope and Nisa themselves had lost many of their weavings.
But...he still learned a few things.
One was the basis of their fears.
The reason why the three of them did what they did. Why they wanted to lock him away in a frequency that even they and many others feared!
He caught a glimpse of weavings that foretold how these entities came from an entirely different Frequency of Existence.
He didn't obtain any actual memories of such a frequency, only scattered summaries of what went on within.
These beings were fearful of calamities- Entities that were considered the bringers of destruction onto entire Frequencies or multiple Frequencies of Existence!

The weavings of Time within some frequencies were much different compared to others as where one was living in at this moment in time could be the past of another frequency that was already advanced by over a thousand or even a million years.
It was undoubtedly hard and unfathomably complex to even try and understand it.

But the core point was that these entities believed that within their frequency- a frequency that seemed to be more advanced in time, someone similar to or exactly the same as Noah and the Infiniverse Megalos Seed...were present and causing destruction!
So they ran from such a calamity.
They arrived within this weaving of existence.
They stayed here for many years as they slowly reclaimed their power- with one of them even attaining his path once more.
But then they caught whispers of his weavings, and they moved to end what they believed to be the source of untold destruction!
And the rest was history.
The largest fear that they had before Ozymandias collapsed their existences was them questioning again and again.

Was this how everything was supposed to play out? That they were the initiators of the event that had the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian hunted by a vast number of factions across the Expanse? There were a lot of questions involving exactly what was happening at this moment in time as this caused Noah's weavings to also ponder.
He tremendously disliked the idea of a pre-set fate or destiny.
That somehow, he was simply a part of a systematic flow of existence- and that he simply had a part to play.
Unthinkable.
Impossible!
He was no mere character.
He was no single figure in some grand weavings of the Wheel of Existence!
He was Noah Osmont. He was Ozymandias. He was the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian!
He was the Protagonist.
As he arrived at this point, the two globules of blood that he had just drawn from the bronze skinned Pioneer burned within him as he called out vigorously.
|Sever the weavings of the Protagonist. Sever the weavings of Fables.|
What was true and what was false... he would decide for himself.
What actions he carried out...He would decide for himself.
His choices, his decisions, his consequences!
His story.
WAA!

The Severed Weavings of the Protagonist and Fables began to burn and join all others as Cheats remained at the forefront at this moment, with the Quintessential League of Existence burning tremendously bright!

Its effects silently applied across a distance of a single Omniverse, and it covered every single entity in the nearby Blancverse and outside of it. The Pioneers of Existence may not know it yet, but at this moment, the maximum power they could unleash was that at the peak of Severing.

Of course, depending on the Complexity of the Pioneer and just how far above they were in power, what a single one displayed could be 10 or even 100 times more powerful than another Pioneer that could also exhibit only the peak of power at Existence Severing.
Complexity was unique in this way as even in this Quintessential League of Existence where every single entity fell under the Relegation Zone of Existence, he still had to be careful!

chapters.title: Chapter 3448 A Spark! II
paragraphs: After all, essentially, a farm of Pioneers were presenting themselves before him. Mere Blood bags that he could use to obtain as many tools as he needed to continue Severing his concepts again and again!

He had a great deal of concepts where if you just took the round number of one hundred. If he truly wanted to Sever every single one of these one hundred concepts eighty-one times, he would need 8,100 Globules of Blood of Pioneers!
So far, he had barely gotten twice a dozen.
So these entities that looked towards him voraciously, as if he was someone they wanted to eat up.. he looked towards them with a similar gaze as his eyes were filled with even more greed!
To them, there was uncertainty on whether he was who he truly was said to be.

But...he did not have any uncertainty. He moved with certainty as at this moment, he felt the gaze of the Immovable Sacred Guard frown, his figure that grabbed Pioneer Heracles showing a limp Entity with a haggard appearance as his weavings of existence were collapsing at a rapid rate.
They were sealed, and one side had to perish before the other could fully be unsealed.
This process accelerated as around Ozymandias, the glorious weavings of Outerversal returned.
Stellar radiance bloomed around him as right away, he initiated the Plot of Tragedy!
BOOM!
Weavings erupted out in all directions as all those under the Relegation Zone of Existence were told of the singular rule of the Plot of Tragedy.
When Ozymandias initiated its effects, he could choose a single path to seal, while others could also choose a single path of his to be sealed.
There was no specification on exactly who could make the choice to seal a path of his, and none of them would know exactly which one of them was the one that he sealed the path of.

It was a capability that was extremely dangerous and unfathomable in nature. The moment these weavings flashed and were explained to everyone here in the span of an instant, their gazes rapidly changed.
Some even radiated tremendous complexity all around them, almost as if to superimpose their own domain onto the Relegation Zone of Existence.
But this was not something so simple as a domain!
It was a different league entirely.
A glorious League of Existence where Noah's weavings were burning all alone.
His body pulsed with seas of dark Outerversal Authority, hundreds of eerie tentacles erupting behind him as he moved.
|For daring to attack my people, your path is sealed!|

Ozymandias spoke out as he appeared above the bronze skinned Humanoid Pioneer whose eyes currently radiated shock and incredulity at being targeted as the first one, and the fact that truly he felt his path rapidly be enclosed and suppressed on all sides by an undeniable power.
When he saw the rapidly flourishing stellar obsidian sea behind Ozymandias, his own mind moved rapidly as he roared out.
|Your Outerversal Authority is also entirely sealed!|
Yes.
Now, both of them would have sealed paths as the level of complexity they could display would be something much lesser. And-...!
TSING!
The infinity symbols that Ozymandias held in his hands swung a few hundred times in the span of an instant the moment that he arrived before the bronze skinned Pioneer.
As he arrived, the recently returned Outerversal Authority was sealed yet again as this was the first and mainly prevalent path that everybody saw.
Yet even after it was sealed, this was merely a single aspect of the existence of Ozymandias.
His complexity did not whittle down by much at all!

So his hands flashed and swung down a few 100 times in the span of an instant. In the next moment, the eyes of a Pioneer showed unfathomable shock and rising fear as his body became bisected into a few hundred pieces!
Bisected.
Bisected!
A shocking progression.
A ridiculous reality!

And even within such reality, the Pioneer was still alive. Even now, his weavings were so complex that even after his path was sealed and then his body grievously injured, he was still witnessing everything that happened with his own two eyes.
He came here because he heard of the resurgence of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian.
His path being sealed and collapsed was not something he ever imagined here!

Crimson bronze blood gushed out as it coagulated into multiple droplets, with a Severed light of Loot flashing on these rivers of Blood as they all converged to form a blood red crystalline gem that was pulled into the hands of Ozymandias.

[Zenith Constellation Source of a Pioneer]:: The culmination of achievement on the path of a Constellation Complexity existence. It is equivalent to 25 Globules of Blood of a Pioneer, or it could be used as a consumable item to spur the formation of the Path of a Pioneer. The formation of such a path is currently not recommended until you can fully undergo Amalgamation with your Severed Sources of Existence and become one with them. Otherwise, the chances of a path failing and collapsing are high. Other methods of utilization include using it as a whole to increase the complexity of any aspect of Existence, not just Ordinances or Paths...
The brilliance of Loot shone and provided a tremendous treasure that when Ozymandias observed its weavings, his heart couldn't help but ache!
He realized how much he missed Ruination who could have multiplied this loot many times over!
Just thinking of this caused his dying rage towards the dead Antiope and others to begin rising again.
Before him, the bisected body of the Pioneer looked haggard and dim as it slowly began to fall apart
|Impossible...|
His intent barely managed to leak out as many watched from the sidelines.
They watched as before anyone else could make a move, a Pioneer had already fallen!
Around Ozymandias, the obsidian Outerversal Authority returned once more, and with tremendous vigor at this moment.
His eyes were like devilish serpents seeking prey as they gazed around the others at this moment!

[Zenith Constellation Source of a Pioneer]:: The culmination of achievement on the path of a Constellation Complexity existence.
It is equivalent to 25 Globules of Blood of a Pioneer, or it could be used as a consumable item to spur the formation of the Path of a Pioneer.
The formation of such a path is currently not recommended until you can fully undergo Amalgamation with your Severed Sources of Existence and become one with them.
Otherwise, the chances of a path failing and collapsing are high.
Other methods of utilization include using it as a whole to increase the complexity of any aspect of Existence, not just Ordinances or Paths...
The brilliance of Loot shone and provided a tremendous treasure that when Ozymandias observed its weavings, his heart couldn't help but ache!
He realized how much he missed Ruination who could have multiplied this loot many times over!
Just thinking of this caused his dying rage towards the dead Antiope and others to begin rising again.
Before him, the bisected body of the Pioneer looked haggard and dim as it slowly began to fall apart
|Impossible...|
His intent barely managed to leak out as many watched from the sidelines.
They watched as before anyone else could make a move, a Pioneer had already fallen!
Around Ozymandias, the obsidian Outerversal Authority returned once more, and with tremendous vigor at this moment.
His eyes were like devilish serpents seeking prey as they gazed around the others at this moment!

I do not know if the Master wishes to alter..."The new entrant pulsed with an aura of a Pioneer as he kneeled towards the Antediluvian Leviathan who radiated a far more complex aura!An aura that seemed to state that he had already found the source!This being accepted these waves of information as he became serious, thinking of many things as he waved his hands to dismiss the one who brought the news."Megalonians...O Omnifather, will this Entanglement never leave you? Even if I send you a message about them now, will it even reach you? Are you still...with us?"WAA!His words held doubts and hesitations as he didn't know for sure.But he still moved to send a message regardless!A Source Complexity entity...sent out a message towards an unknown place, not knowing if it would ever arrive!—Megalos Ynnere.Omniverse of the Protectors.Inside a certain Library filled with collections of records from eons past.A woman sat within its depths, her power silent this whole time as at this moment, it began to bubble out.It was pure obsidian brilliance that leaked from behind her, massive tentacles radiating outwards and coiling with each other like massive snakes as they rose up to form an oval gateway!Clusters of tentacles wreathed and connected together as in under a minute; they formed a massive oval structure that lit up with hazy black light.Akin to a thin film of light.Akin to a portal!And from it...WUU!A massive lifeform of a Wheel that was made up of tentacles came through!

chapters.title: Chapter 3450 A Spark! IV
paragraphs: It was a terrifying scene.
Something that was entirely out of the norm!
Within the depths of the Omniverse of the Protectors, Outerversal Authority he began to leak out in a maddening fashion as the Great Wheel appeared.
He stepped out of the oval portal as behind him, the auras of thousands upon thousands of Outerversal Morphons blazed and began to come through.
The aura of the Great Wheel stood exploded from Quasi-Ordinance Amalgamation and became fully fledged out, his tentacles radiating might of immense greed and valor as he bellowed out.

|The Instrument of the Beyonder is at this moment being besieged by the forces of Matter from all around. Let us fall in line under the grandeur of the Great Beyonder and fight against the forces of Matter ourselves, let us not sit still and do absolutely nothing!|
OOOOH!
His bellows came alongside a burst of eldritch horror, and the tide of an expanding sea of Morphons exploded out into the Omniverse of the Protectors.
A distance away.
The Shield of the Commonwealth, Old Man Eudemus, was sitting opposite a chaotic chess board with all the pieces fallen as he thought about his conversation with a certain man.
And yet, in the middle of his musings, his eyes opened wide as his pupils constricted- his figure rising and looking out into the distance as his face became enraged and he bellowed out angrily.
"Traitorous creature!"
BOOM!

The weavings of Ordinance Amalgamation of Kuklos erupted out maddeningly, Old Man Eudemus rising and shooting out like a bullet towards a direction that was gushing out stellar black weavings of brilliance!
This was within the Omniverse of the Protectors.
Apart from this location, in other renowned Omniverses under the banner of the Commonwealth.
As if there were already seeds that were only now sprouting.
As if they had been prepared and were silently waiting this whole time!
Inside of an Omniverse where the main body of the Viceroy was located.
Grandiose golden towers stretched out across a stellar expanse of Cosmos, the regality and wealth being unmatched as hundreds of golden white vessels moved all around.
The Omniverse of the Commonwealth.
Omniverse X-1!

In the heart of the Commonwealth, a heavy explosion bloomed from one of the grandiose golden towers, Outerversal Authority spilling out endlessly like a sea as an entity with the tentacles of an Octopus rose from this sea with millions of Reapers of Existence.
|Bahaha! Why did they initiate this after such a long slumber? I've been itching, but this Great One was not entirely ready!|
The booming intent was vile and filled with power, standing powerfully at...Existence Severing!
Within a core location of the Commonwealth, an Existence Severing powerhouse had actually been slumbering as it now rose with the rest of its forces!
SHIING!
Gloriously, a unique power emerged from the center of Omniverse X-1, the Sword of the Commonwealth appeared as his lustrous gold simian fur-like hairs shone with resplendence.
His gaze was a heavy one as he bellowed out.
|To me!|
In the next instant, figures of Simians ranging from Ordinance of Existence and below appeared, their bodies turning into streaks of light that went on to fuse into his figure!
He used to radiate the aura of Ordinance Amalgamation before, but his complexity began to rise at a shocking pace.
His body enlarged as all around him, hundreds of golden wheels bloomed with fervor!
And from the depths of Omniverse X-1...
AWOOO!
A deep, heavy roar that felt like the waking of an ancient treasure erupted.
Lustrous golden towers parted ways as from the depths, an object that was a hundredth of an Omniverse in size rose up, its brilliance dim as if it was on its last waking days.
It looked like a massive wooden structure, and yet it radiated an air of majesty as when it truly revealed itself, one could see that it was made up of...many strokes.
Strokes that formed a Rune!
|Ha! You all truly held it here! A Piece of a Phantom Trace of the Wheel of Existence!|

The booming voice of the Outerversal Morphon erupting out felt the aura of the shocking treasure that was rising, this Existence Severing entity being unable to hide his sense of trepidation as he prepared.
The treasure that made the Commonwealth what it is today.
Something close to the Wheel of Existence, with some even saying it held its musings more than many other things out there.
A Phantom Trace- a mere piece of it at that!
|Defend!|
|Deny!|
|Protect!|
Intents exploded out as at this moment, from many different areas of the Megalos Ynnere- conflict exploded.
Long rooted seeds emerged as from a single spark in a corner of the Expanse, flames began to spread!
At another point in the Megalos Ynnere, multiple Omniverses were rotating around a single entity that was silent in contemplation at this moment.
The Prisoner.
This silent contemplation of his was one where he went over the meeting with a Source Complexity entity seeking Osmont, and he couldn't make any headway!
But even this contemplation was short-lived.
His eyes turned sharp as he gazed out towards a far distance, tears blooming all across as the radiance of gold spread out.
From this gold, one massive titan after another appeared as they also looked towards distant areas across Megalos Ynerre, their eyes being capable of observing too many things!
Their auras were all at Existence Severing as they chuckled while looking towards the Prisoner.

|We have been waiting all this time and have begun to feel the auras of some of our descendants fading away. You Leviathans and your Omnifather are creatures that never hold to your promises...so we shall use this chaos blooming across your domains to ask- where are our people imprisoned?!|
Terrific power bloomed as the Golden Titans began to gather and float towards the Prisoner.
They came for their people who were imprisoned for eons, remaining at bay due to the power of the Omnifather!
But very few had heard of anything regarding this man for quite some time.
And now, their imprisoned people began to die as when they felt chaos and Entropy surging, they also made their move!

chapters.title: Chapter 3451 A Spark! V
paragraphs: They were entrenched in the Megalos Ynnere for a while as they searched for traces of the Antediluvian Leviathans- for the abode of the Omnifather where he had imprisoned their people!
And now, they finally picked up their traces.
The key lay with the man before them as these Golden Titans looked at him cautiously while the one at the forefront harrumphed.
|With those weavings, you'd have to be a Pioneer? Can't fool our eyes too easily here. But even if you are a Pioneer...we've killed a few before.|

The group of Golden Titans were surrounded by a seething light of complexity, golden Runes of Existence that read [FORMATION] blooming around them as a hazy and more massive idol of a golden titan slowly formed!

|So, will we find out about our people before or after your death? Oh, and that is without mentioning whether you want those Omniverses around you to be targeted by us or not. In each one, how many quintillions upon quintillions of lives lie within? All that complexity...it would be a shame if it disappeared with a single impact.|
A single, massive hazy golden titan formed from the group of Golden Titans, a flaming crown floating above its head as golden wings stretched out behind it!
Due to those who made it up, it swirled with the complexity of multiple Severed Ordinances of Existence that could be unleashed simultaneously.
Its expression was an angry one, as the Golden Titans were an extremely loyal and close-knit race.
Their people looked out for each other above all else as most of the time, when they cultivated their complexity, they did so together!
Within their habitats of golden seas, eons could pass as they spent time in groups cultivating.
Searching for their descendants...was a given as they were now at a critical step, and could not fail!
The Prisoner looked at them with a deteriorating expression as his body began to wake from a deep slumber, his complexity exploding out!
It was just another region of the Megalos Ynnere delving into weavings of utter entropy.
Chaos!
When chaos truly unfolded, it seemed to be everywhere.
It was a unique thing how every single chain of chaos could be traced back to a single point, with causality constantly twisted and distorted!
One thing led to another.
Randomness. Uncertainty. Causality.
They seemed to flow and conflict with each other as if one got them under control and understood them to a shocking degree of complexity...
"They would still be confused at the end of the day..."
Ozymandias shook his head and breathed out a stellar breath of complexity as he looked at the multicolored sea within the Secondary Infiniverse Megalos.

The design of the Quintessential League of Existence was being utilized at this moment to wage a war against enemies far more powerful than him, but this was not the primary intention of this terrifying league.

One must remember, many parts of Noah's weavings came together to decide that it should be Cheats who took center stage next to design something that would aid and eventually take his other half out of Hell Terra Firma!
This was the main purpose.
So the Quintessential League of Existence was made to place his weavings in a different League entirely, for him to even overcome the restrictions of Hell Terra Firma!
For a closer look at just which guideline would be critical for this purpose, one must turn to the Banner of Invictus.
Under the Quintessential League of Existence, there was the Relegation Zone of Existence and the Banner of Invictus as the current regulations, with others surely to follow.
The Banner of Invictus seemed simple at first glance.

[Banner of Invictus]:: Any Existence entangled and with a causal relationship with the holder of Cheats will have no barriers or obstacles between the two sides, regardless of distance or even different weavings of existence. If under the influence of the Quintessential League of Existence, one can never leave the Relegation Zone deployed unless the Causality between two sides is settled by any means necessary. A unique ruling of the League.
One of its most critical aspects was its first sentence!
Anybody entangled or with a causal relationship with the holder of Cheats...will have no barriers or obstacles between the two sides.
No barriers.
No obstacles!
Regardless of distance or even different weavings of existence!
This was the elevated stage of the League Noah's weavings placed themselves on as of course, there was theory, and then there was application.
Just like how truly powerful Pioneers of Existence could display tremendous levels of power even while under the Relegation Zone of Existence.
Based on Noah's own complexity- on the Complexity of Cheats, the level and depth at which the Banner of Invictus was applied towards truly complex things varied!
Hell Terra Firma was as complex as something could be if it entirely rejected all authority.
But from the other side of Hell Terra Firma, there were still possibilities of influence!

After all, the uniqueness of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed paved a path of survival. After all, a Pioneer like Heracles could pull upon his recorded weavings of when they nearly fell into Hell Terra Firma, and he used this to briefly open up its gateway to ensnare his enemies!
Frankly, it was a terrific attack when one thought about it.
Have an enemy? Just send them to Hell Terra Firma and they would die within a hundred years.
But of course, Noah had sensed something coming and moved away.
Others with varying levels of complexity would have also done the same.
It was only with the influence of a Source Complexity entity that Noah and the Infiniverse Megalos Seed were pulled back and held in place long enough for this attack to succeed!
So from other weavings of existence, there was a semblance of an effect.
With enough complexity, things could easily be ensnared into Hell Terra Firma.
And at this moment, the newly elevated Quintessential League of Existence showed its grandeur as above the multicolored sea, a domesticated Golden Eagle silently dove into the sea and disappeared!

Chaos!
When chaos truly unfolded, it seemed to be everywhere.
It was a unique thing how every single chain of chaos could be traced back to a single point, with causality constantly twisted and distorted!
One thing led to another.
Randomness.
Uncertainty.
Causality.
They seemed to flow and conflict with each other as if one got them under control and understood them to a shocking degree of complexity...
"They would still be confused at the end of the day..."
Ozymandias shook his head and breathed out a stellar breath of complexity as he looked at the multicolored sea within the Secondary Infiniverse Megalos.

The design of the Quintessential League of Existence was being utilized at this moment to wage a war against enemies far more powerful than him, but this was not the primary intention of this terrifying league.

One must remember, many parts of Noah's weavings came together to decide that it should be Cheats who took center stage next to design something that would aid and eventually take his other half out of Hell Terra Firma!
This was the main purpose.
So the Quintessential League of Existence was made to place his weavings in a different League entirely, for him to even overcome the restrictions of Hell Terra Firma!
For a closer look at just which guideline would be critical for this purpose, one must turn to the Banner of Invictus.
Under the Quintessential League of Existence, there was the Relegation Zone of Existence and the Banner of Invictus as the current regulations, with others surely to follow.
The Banner of Invictus seemed simple at first glance.

[Banner of Invictus]:: Any Existence entangled and with a causal relationship with the holder of Cheats will have no barriers or obstacles between the two sides, regardless of distance or even different weavings of existence.
If under the influence of the Quintessential League of Existence, one can never leave the Relegation Zone deployed unless the Causality between two sides is settled by any means necessary.
A unique ruling of the League.
One of its most critical aspects was its first sentence!
Anybody entangled or with a causal relationship with the holder of Cheats...will have no barriers or obstacles between the two sides.
No barriers.
No obstacles!
Regardless of distance or even different weavings of existence!
This was the elevated stage of the League Noah's weavings placed themselves on as of course, there was theory, and then there was application.
Just like how truly powerful Pioneers of Existence could display tremendous levels of power even while under the Relegation Zone of Existence.
Based on Noah's own complexity- on the Complexity of Cheats, the level and depth at which the Banner of Invictus was applied towards truly complex things varied!
Hell Terra Firma was as complex as something could be if it entirely rejected all authority.
But from the other side of Hell Terra Firma, there were still possibilities of influence!
After all, the uniqueness of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed paved a path of survival.
After all, a Pioneer like Heracles could pull upon his recorded weavings of when they nearly fell into Hell Terra Firma, and he used this to briefly open up its gateway to ensnare his enemies!
Frankly, it was a terrific attack when one thought about it.
Have an enemy?
Just send them to Hell Terra Firma and they would die within a hundred years.
But of course, Noah had sensed something coming and moved away.
Others with varying levels of complexity would have also done the same.
It was only with the influence of a Source Complexity entity that Noah and the Infiniverse Megalos Seed were pulled back and held in place long enough for this attack to succeed!
So from other weavings of existence, there was a semblance of an effect.
With enough complexity, things could easily be ensnared into Hell Terra Firma.
And at this moment, the newly elevated Quintessential League of Existence showed its grandeur as above the multicolored sea, a domesticated Golden Eagle silently dove into the sea and disappeared!

chapters.title: Chapter 3452 A Spark! VI
paragraphs: A Golden Eagle!
An entity that radiated low waves of Mana- something equivalent to Noah's days as a Hunter on the blue planet that would hold a Rank B or Rank A distinction.
Something with negligible complexity.
Such a thing dove into the multicolored sea and disappeared entirely!

|After 9 successful tests, Master, we can confirm that it is now possible to stably transfer lifeforms with very little complexity into Hell Terra Firma utilizing the Frequency Gateway and have them always appear from the Infiniverse Megalos Seed there.|
|The opposite of leaving Hell Terra Firma through the Frequency Gateway has shown failure every single time as of right now, it is still not possible for any lifeforms to leave Hell Terra Firma.|
|The reduction in quality and quantity of things leaving Hell Terra Firma had also been expanded.|
WAA!
Results, success, and failure all came at once as slowly but surely, he made progress!
He nodded as the words of the Infiniverse Megalos Body continued.

|We have also confirmed the distortion of time between this Frequency of Existence and Hell Terra Firma. It changes every few hours, but this Frequency holds a varying rate of time compared to Hell Terra Firma. During some time period, an hour here may be only a single minute within Hell Terra Firma, or an hour here could be 10 hours in Hell Terra Firma. It seems randomized, but I've already begun calculations on the possibility of utilizing the Ordinances of Chronos, Time, Relativity, Entropy, and other viable weavings to distort this process in our favor.|
A distortion of time!
Similar to the fractured memories of Palace Master Antiope and Nisa- these beings lived in a frequency that was supposedly advanced in time.
A similar phenomenon was present here, but it varied.
If they could make it work in their favor, then they could have the days of Hell Terra Firma pass by rapidly while only hours and minutes passed by here.
Events in Hell Terra Firma were naturally slower as his other half was undergoing a true trial of time in that place!
He always moved fast.
He crossed realms that took others years in a matter of days. He conquered entire Galaxies, Cosmos, Existential Domains, and Omniverses in a matter of weeks!
And now, his other half had to be in a place where the hours felt like they moved abysmally slow, with the feelings of hunger and stresses of a normal human being at the forefront.
Even getting sick of the common cold was a possibility for the great Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian- how ridiculous was that?

Ozymandias had already sent over a dense bundle of medications, first aid equipment, and herbs that humans in his home world would have considered extinct that promoted overall health and strengthened immunity to an alarming extent.
Every minute detail was theorized and handled to perfection as the possibilities of mistakes and chance happenings were reduced and controlled greatly
And as a result of all this...
HUUM!
The multicolored sea churned heavily as drops of crimson gold blood rose from it- numbering 15 in total as the amount that could pass through was increased tremendously.
This was the result of the Quintessential League of Existence as it had just begun to express its wonders.
And now that they could accelerate this whole process to a ridiculous degree as Ozymandias waved his hands to obtain the Globules of Blood of Pioneers.
|Let Chronos, Relativity, Time...|
His eyes shone brightly as he commanded for multiple other parts of him to be Severed!
And as this process began, he turned his head towards the side of the Frequency Gateway.
There, dozens of domesticated Golden Eagles and Manabourne Warhorses with feathered blue wings floated.
Further behind them, there was an obsidian blue platform radiating a neon light as on top of it, advanced technological vessels and armaments could be seen!
Since authorities were not viable, he would lean into science and technology fully to dominate.

Advanced Warplanes, Helicopters, and even massive metal constructs that looked like eight-legged spiders hummed with technological brilliance- and this was not to mention the heavy crimson tanks and mortars carrying ammunition that would cause even Dragons to cry!
Yes.
He was already preparing for when he had to face other races that held massive statures.
Dragons.
Titans.
Ents.
Any possibility one could think of was accounted for as what could a dragon with an oversized body do against a fighter jet that could move at Mach 9.9?!
His eyes flashed coldly as his voice boomed out.
"Let us send the tools to accelerate the domination of Hell Terra Firma..."
WAA!
To others, Hell Terra Firma was a land to die in.
To him, it was something to Conquer and revolutionize!

All of the advanced technological equipment he prepared held their own supply of fuel and source of power, and on the neon platform of things to send were also Electricity Generators, Batteries, along with Coal, Oil, and Natural Gases in addition to their already built Power Plants to generate seamless electricity!
Electricity was a simple advancement for normal humans, not to mention someone like Ozymandias who could pull from the records of Omniverse X-999 that had multiple advanced technological lineages.
It was the mere conversion of mechanical energy into electrical energy through a turbine generator. He could send forth all of this and an endless supply of fossil fuels, coals, and oil!
It meant that very soon, Hell Terra Firma was about to look very different in the lands that Noah touched.
And his most daring package that he was sending into Hell Terra Firma yet...were the dazzling constructs of white gold humanoid autonomous robots sectioned off in the far back.
Many things had to be prepared for them as around them were also satellites that would be able to map out every single area Noah crossed, and even observe other areas he had not explored!
All of this and more was prepared as he may have gone a bit overboard, but the results were bound to be heavy!
