chapters.title: Chapter 3453 Serendipity! I
paragraphs: Hell Terra Firma.

A place of terrifying atrocities and sheer despondency, based on the simple fact that every single entity that used to be comfortable and used to profound authorities that made their lives infinitely easier... all found themselves faced with absolutely nothing.
Returned to a basal state of existence where not a single ounce of authority flowed within them.
And that is how it was, that is how it has always been.
"So what the hell is this exactly?"
Where the gray earth should be, a woman with crimson hair stood on a platform that had expanded beneath her feet by simply being watered by the unfathomable entity.
A firm, solid structure that expanded massively in size and stature based on, again, being watered.

And yet this seemed to be the least of all the shocking things that were happening here. The dilapidated and aged Settlement that used to be here was gradually being overrun by the ever-expanding structures of futuristic buildings, complex weaponry, machinery, and power grids that had been getting built one after another.

Things that she could only remember in her memory being tools of science and technology that the lesser entities who could not fully grasp mana had leaned into were being processed here in wild abundance.
In a short few hours, a complex city filled with neon lights and a terrifying air of technological advancement had been born.
She was the Palace Paster of massive power in her Frequency of Existence, and she had been in Hell Terra Firma for 5 years already.

She was known as the Mistress of Flames, but even she had never come across anything like this. As a Pioneer, she now had to give blood to the man behind all of this as even now, she found him unfathomably hard to understand!
But she could not do anything else except fall in mine.
And if an entity like this, who could enact change and was seemingly pulling out countless complex structures out of nowhere...he may just be a way out of this barren wasteland.
So she would follow him vehemently.
But this was her thought, and the thoughts of many other collected Pioneers who were initially hesitant.
But now seeing all the structures coming out, not a single entity had even a speck of doubt as they all even wanted to get closer to that man adorned in a golden armor.

The Mistress of Flames was one of them as her eyes shone with sharpness, using her hands to pull down her hair as she also looked down at the size of her chest, and then she stroked forward with affirmation.
The revolution of Hell Terra Firma.
Something that could have occurred in a number of years had been occurring in mere hours as more and more complex things continued to come out of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed.

At this moment, Noah was seated on the blue throne in the center of an enclosed room that seemed to be made of reinforced steel. In front of him, there were at least a dozen screens that showed multiple different things, each one shining brightly as the allure of electricity had long been established.

Electric regenerators were the first thing he had brought along with all the required equipment and fuel to run it, and now around the many structures he had laid out, electricity was running and flowing smoothly as power grids were already being installed.
As soon as he reached a sufficient point, it could then begin mass production and movement as the Autonomous Quintessential Androids could be brought here and be fully operational.
When these autonomous creatures began to move under his control, the number of things that he could do would be multiplied dozens of times over.
At this moment, he was observing the launch of the first ever Satellite that would go up on Hell Terra Firma.
Beside him, Ruination and the Infiniverse Megalos Seed watched on calmly as the Satellite blasted higher, reaching an extremely high height on the gray skies before....
|Warning! Warning! Warning! An unknown force is preventing any further ascension and imposing a type of gravitational pressure on Satellite X-01!||
A blooming sound and word flashed on the screens they observed as Noah waved his hands.
"Slow the ascent and be stationed here."
His words were quickly received as the advanced artificial intelligence model that could pick up his voice and commands proceeded to make the necessary arrangements.

Soon, a Satellite hung in the distant space as thereafter, it flashed brightly and released a burst of blue light that spread down, thousands of cameras on it beginning to sweep across the lands below!

Noah looked at all of this coldly as he continued. "Prepare for the launch of other Satellites. In a few hours, I want a mapped out area of the nearby tens of thousands of miles of this Barren wasteland. After that, we shall begin using all military force to Conquer any nearby settlements. The goal remains Pioneers and above."
His gaze was mighty as his ambitions were unfathomably high. What nobody had conquered before. What people feared ranging from Pioneers to even Source Complexity entities!
He wondered whether there were even competitors here in Hell Terra Firma. Did anybody have something as complex and unique as him when he came to the Infiniverse Megalos Seed?
He didn't have the answer, but he would find out soon enough as his gaze penetrated every single part of this endless barren expanse.

"Begin the design of analyzing signatures of all beings here and how we can differentiate between those that are Ordinance of Existence, or Existence Severing, or even Pioneers. And find me someone at Source Complexity first and foremost."
WAA!
The Pioneers he had use for as he needed a tremendous amount of their blood to continue Severing his concepts.
What would Source Complexity entities provide? As he thought of this, he found his mind wandering towards none other than Barbatos.
This got him to think of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed and the other Barbatos within, as well as many other of his most important people still locked in there!

chapters.title: Chapter 3454 Serendipity! II
paragraphs: "How is the progress with the Infiniverse Megalos Seed?"
Many changes that occurred since his other half had enacted the Quintessential League of Existence.
These changes extended here as well.
|The size continues to gradually increase, Master. If more and more of its basal authority is unlocked, when it reaches the size of a World, I may be able to release those within safely.|
Yes.
More and more changes continued to propagate as in a short period of time, Noah expected for him to get back every single thing and person he had lost access to!
As he sat on his throne, he clenched his fist while looking at all the monitors.
Waiting.
Preparing.
This was his conquest here as outside of this place, Ozymandias was facing an army of Pioneers that would bloom countless Entanglements and death.
Towards the end of it all, what would his progress in Hell Terra Firma be? When he was finally released, where would his own complexity be at?
Pioneers, or Source Complexity?!
HUUM!

The radiance of his body seemed to ever slowly be returning as the Quintessential League of Existence fully began to unfold. Soon enough, he may not even be considered a mere human as he prepared to violate the very basal workings of Hell Terra Firma!
As he imaged the type of Complexity he would have, the visage of the dark skinned Barbatos flashed as he wondered how things continued with her!
In a unique Frequency of Existence.
Purple Strings of Existence intricately stretched out and into a massive circular construct the size of ten Omniverses.

A hum and glow of magnificence were constantly being released from these purple strings, a terrifying luster of complexity lying within as even from afar, one could feel a sense of suffocation that came from dozens of Source Complexity entities lying within this place!
At this moment.
In a small corner of this grandiose structure filled with purple Strings of Existence.

Inside a domain less than the size of a world, radiant silver-purple radiance spread out all around as the figure of Barbatos stood on a sea of purple complexity while staring at the back of a man who was seated in a meditative position at its center.
"What has happened, Father?"
She asked with a sharp gaze as the man ahead of her had a back so massive- as if he was carrying an indeterminate amount of weight on his back!
His hair was a sleek black, his skin dark and radiant as he seemed like a sculpture of a nigh perfect entity.
He breathed out heavily and sighed at the question his daughter paused before he spoke out calmly.
"Existence...is unraveling."
Three words.
And yet they caused Barbatos to feel a heavy beat of her heart as she kept her face placid while she asked.
"What do you mean? You know I don't like cryptic things!"
She voiced out her frustration as the man before her, a Pillar of the Logos of the Wheel, replied succinctly!

"In the mission you participated in. It has become a Source Nexus Event connected to the Unraveling of Existence there, and the process is rapidly expanding. Strings of Existence have been snapping at an ever-increasing rate, and they want those involved in that event...to be used as scapegoats if need be. If this unraveling is not stopped, there will be unknown consequences, and there will be a War across Frequencies. Nobody wants that."
The words caused Barbatos to become enraged as a habit she had long ago suppressed rose up.

"The fuck do you mean they want a scapegoat? I only went on that mission because I was ordered to! I know nothing about an unraveling of existence or a War across Frequencies. I was only acting on orders- the Orders of the Logos of the Wheel!"
Her gorgeous face showed indignation and anger as she continued.
"They want a scapegoat, but so what? My Father sits atop the council, surely such a thing was shut down as soon as it rose up?"
She asked a critical question.
One that should have a very easy and quick answer.
And yet...
Her father did not reply.
Her gaze rapidly changed as her face became ashen!
This was her father.
The man who was always there to protect her. The man who should always be on her side.
And yet at this moment...

"I hope the unraveling stops. I hope that none of this unfolds in the worst way possible. But if it does follow the worst possible result, I will not be able to stop the others. If it can stop an eruption of a War across Frequencies, they will sacrifice anyone they can to prevent it- even me."
His back, which was already so broad and heavy, seemed to become narrow at this moment.
His Source that was ever so radiant felt unfathomably dim to her at this moment!
He spoke as if the decision had already been made, as if there was nothing he could do, and he had accepted it!
"I am sorry."
He stared at the stellar purple sea around them and uttered such empty words as Barbatos felt her heart breaking.
How many years of a relationship was this? How many complex weavings between father and daughter?
For him to just...
Barbatos was in a daze as he continued.

"They do not know you are here. They will want to keep you under their surveillance just in case to be ready. The most I can give you...is a head start. Go and hide in a place that would make it hard for them to even find you. If things do unfold in the worst possible way, maybe they will sweep over and end before you can be affected."
His words only felt worse and worse to her as she couldn't help but feel a sense of revulsion!
She was so angered and betrayed that she couldn't help but laugh!
"Hide? Fucking where could I go hide that the Logos of the Wheel would not find me? Have you truly resigned to allowing your only daughter to be used like this?! Have you...!"
She wanted to ask if he had truly already made his decision.
But seeing his placid gaze, she knew the answer as her heart truly couldn't help but bleed!
The last words he said to her...
"You should go. They do not know you are here now, but they will soon. Be safe."
His words weren't hurried, even though her weavings were facing tremendous peril!
She couldn't wrap her head around all of this as she wiped her tears away, giving this man, her father, one last look before she defiantly shook her head and disappeared.
But where could she go?
How could she hide from something as vast as the Logos of the Wheel that extended their claws across the Frequencies of the Wheel?
In her complex and tumultuous emotions, the image of one man rose up as her shattered heart felt a form of solace even just thinking about him.
But...he was much lesser in complexity than even her or someone like her Father.
If even her Father chose to abandon her because he couldn't bear the weight of the Logos of the Wheel, then what about him?
As her heart ached, she resigned herself to at least say goodbye as her source exploded out, going towards another Frequency of Existence!

sentences.text: "How is the progress with the Infiniverse Megalos Seed?"
Many changes that occurred since his other half had enacted the Quintessential League of Existence.
These changes extended here as well.
|The size continues to gradually increase, Master.
If more and more of its basal authority is unlocked, when it reaches the size of a World, I may be able to release those within safely.|
Yes.
More and more changes continued to propagate as in a short period of time, Noah expected for him to get back every single thing and person he had lost access to!
As he sat on his throne, he clenched his fist while looking at all the monitors.
Waiting.
Preparing.
This was his conquest here as outside of this place, Ozymandias was facing an army of Pioneers that would bloom countless Entanglements and death.
Towards the end of it all, what would his progress in Hell Terra Firma be?
When he was finally released, where would his own complexity be at?
Pioneers, or Source Complexity?!
HUUM!
The radiance of his body seemed to ever slowly be returning as the Quintessential League of Existence fully began to unfold.
Soon enough, he may not even be considered a mere human as he prepared to violate the very basal workings of Hell Terra Firma!
As he imaged the type of Complexity he would have, the visage of the dark skinned Barbatos flashed as he wondered how things continued with her!
In a unique Frequency of Existence.
Purple Strings of Existence intricately stretched out and into a massive circular construct the size of ten Omniverses.

A hum and glow of magnificence were constantly being released from these purple strings, a terrifying luster of complexity lying within as even from afar, one could feel a sense of suffocation that came from dozens of Source Complexity entities lying within this place!
At this moment.
In a small corner of this grandiose structure filled with purple Strings of Existence.

Inside a domain less than the size of a world, radiant silver-purple radiance spread out all around as the figure of Barbatos stood on a sea of purple complexity while staring at the back of a man who was seated in a meditative position at its center.
"What has happened, Father?"
She asked with a sharp gaze as the man ahead of her had a back so massive- as if he was carrying an indeterminate amount of weight on his back!
His hair was a sleek black, his skin dark and radiant as he seemed like a sculpture of a nigh perfect entity.
He breathed out heavily and sighed at the question his daughter paused before he spoke out calmly.
"Existence...is unraveling."
Three words.
And yet they caused Barbatos to feel a heavy beat of her heart as she kept her face placid while she asked.
"What do you mean?
You know I don't like cryptic things!"
She voiced out her frustration as the man before her, a Pillar of the Logos of the Wheel, replied succinctly!
"In the mission you participated in.
It has become a Source Nexus Event connected to the Unraveling of Existence there, and the process is rapidly expanding.
Strings of Existence have been snapping at an ever-increasing rate, and they want those involved in that event...to be used as scapegoats if need be.
If this unraveling is not stopped, there will be unknown consequences, and there will be a War across Frequencies.
Nobody wants that."
The words caused Barbatos to become enraged as a habit she had long ago suppressed rose up.
"The fuck do you mean they want a scapegoat?
I only went on that mission because I was ordered to!
I know nothing about an unraveling of existence or a War across Frequencies.
I was only acting on orders- the Orders of the Logos of the Wheel!"
Her gorgeous face showed indignation and anger as she continued.
"They want a scapegoat, but so what?
My Father sits atop the council, surely such a thing was shut down as soon as it rose up?"
She asked a critical question.
One that should have a very easy and quick answer.
And yet...
Her father did not reply.
Her gaze rapidly changed as her face became ashen!
This was her father.
The man who was always there to protect her.
The man who should always be on her side.
And yet at this moment...
"I hope the unraveling stops.
I hope that none of this unfolds in the worst way possible.
But if it does follow the worst possible result, I will not be able to stop the others.
If it can stop an eruption of a War across Frequencies, they will sacrifice anyone they can to prevent it- even me."
His back, which was already so broad and heavy, seemed to become narrow at this moment.
His Source that was ever so radiant felt unfathomably dim to her at this moment!
He spoke as if the decision had already been made, as if there was nothing he could do, and he had accepted it!
"I am sorry."
He stared at the stellar purple sea around them and uttered such empty words as Barbatos felt her heart breaking.
How many years of a relationship was this?
How many complex weavings between father and daughter?
For him to just...
Barbatos was in a daze as he continued.
"They do not know you are here.
They will want to keep you under their surveillance just in case to be ready.
The most I can give you...is a head start.
Go and hide in a place that would make it hard for them to even find you.
If things do unfold in the worst possible way, maybe they will sweep over and end before you can be affected."
His words only felt worse and worse to her as she couldn't help but feel a sense of revulsion!
She was so angered and betrayed that she couldn't help but laugh!
"Hide?
Fucking where could I go hide that the Logos of the Wheel would not find me?
Have you truly resigned to allowing your only daughter to be used like this?!
Have you...!"
She wanted to ask if he had truly already made his decision.
But seeing his placid gaze, she knew the answer as her heart truly couldn't help but bleed!
The last words he said to her...
"You should go.
They do not know you are here now, but they will soon.
Be safe."
His words weren't hurried, even though her weavings were facing tremendous peril!
She couldn't wrap her head around all of this as she wiped her tears away, giving this man, her father, one last look before she defiantly shook her head and disappeared.
But where could she go?
How could she hide from something as vast as the Logos of the Wheel that extended their claws across the Frequencies of the Wheel?
In her complex and tumultuous emotions, the image of one man rose up as her shattered heart felt a form of solace even just thinking about him.
But...he was much lesser in complexity than even her or someone like her Father.
If even her Father chose to abandon her because he couldn't bear the weight of the Logos of the Wheel, then what about him?
As her heart ached, she resigned herself to at least say goodbye as her source exploded out, going towards another Frequency of Existence!

chapters.title: Chapter 3455 Serendipity! III
paragraphs: As one entity resigned herself to say goodbye.
Within the stellar purple domain she was just in, the man she left behind retained his difficult expression for a while longer before it subtly shifted into a weary, tired expression!
His eyes held immense heaviness and regret as he sighed.

What bigger failure was there for a man than to be unable to protect their child? Worse yet, if they played a hand in the cause of their destruction, and they gave them up in order to protect themselves!

His gaze was unfocused as countless memories of his daughter flashed across his mind, not being able to notice when a woman adorned in a dazzling gold dress and overflowing blue hair appeared behind him.
She looked around the purple sea with a sigh before her voice echoed out.
"I told you eons ago during your Severing for you to include your emotions and attachments among your Ordinance. Had you Severed your attachments then, today would have been very easy for you."
Her voice was filled with understanding and coldness as it echoed out.
Yet the seated man didn't move or turn towards her direction as he voiced out gruffly.
"You all promised a day. A day where you would leave her alone. This must not change."
A day.
The most he could do was buy his daughter a single day!
How laughable was this?
The blue haired woman raised her brows while shaking her head at such a question.

"Did you really think giving her a day was a form of mercy? You do realize how torturous this single day will be, right? She knows there is nowhere for her to hide. She knows her own father has thrown her away. Do you think this single day will be some form of solace? It is the opposite! It is why I wanted to take her in and hold her right here. You only prolonged her misery..."
WAA!
The words were utterly cold as the man's gaze shifted, his eyes going through many complex emotions before he asked once more.
"The Unraveling of Existence?"
"It continues to accelerate. But the rate is not exponential- there are times when the rate of Unraveling jumps up, then slows down, and then it jumps up again. It doesn't seem random...."
It didn't seem random.
The snapping of the Strings of Existence...seemed to hold a pattern!
"If it continues...haaah. The Watchers of the Wheelomachy themselves are not an issue. It is that man. That bald headed demon...he is the one that will make this all that much more difficult."
That man.
They didn't even say his name, but they didn't have to.
They knew who he was!
Some people called him the Bald Headed Demon.
Others had different names.
But he was known simply as...Bob!
Inside another Frequency of Existence.
Megalos Ynnere, Omniverse X-999, the Secondary Infiniverse Megalos Seed!

Ozymandias and the Infiniverse Megalos Body were observing the low hums of Runes of Existence around the multicolored sea, their expansion, and the smoothness of the shocking number of things they were sending down.
Setting up a technologically advanced civilization was easy when one held the authority they grasped in their hands!
In a single day, the barren lands of Settlement in Hell Terra Firma were so drastically transformed that others may feel like it was a dream.

And now, Power Grids were laid out all around, with supercomputers, cloud quantum computers, and many more wonders required as the central base for the deployment of the Autonomous Quintessential Androids. These Autonomous Quintessential Androids had the first batch successfully arrive as they would be able to work 24/7, allowing the setup and innovation within that place to advance at a shocking pace!
Now, it was only a matter of time.
And as they had begun distorting the weavings of Chronos around here-...!
WAP!
Their gazes both shifted as they felt the fluctuations of space, turning their eyes above as there, the visage of Barbatos with reddened eyes appeared!
Looking at her, a pang of anger rose within Ozymandias as he beckoned towards her and pulled her body towards him.
"Who caused you to cry?!"
His eyes radiated a terrifying might, and this anger he displayed...uniquely caused the reddened eyes of Barbatos to clear up as she threw herself to him in a hug!
With him, she felt safe.
Slowly, she contained herself after a minute and told the story of what had happened.
The Unraveling of Existence.
The possible War across Frequencies between the Logos of the Wheel and the Watchers of Wheelomachy!
Her Father...and his decision and powerlessness when it came to using Barbatos and the other Source Complexity entity who was with her on this mission.
"That is why...I have come to say goodbye. I will ensure that nothing traces back here. Knowing the power of the Logos of the Wheel, they will likely find me in a short period of time..."
Her eyes were heartbroken as the mentality of being chased down by her own people that she had relied on this whole time was too heavy!
Ozymandias looked at her desolate small figure as he asked calmly.

"If there is nowhere you can run to, just stay with me. Your Father...the Logos of the Wheel, these Watchers of the Wheelomachy...none of them will be able to get their hands on you so long as you are beside me."
Words that caused her heart to buzz echoed out as she smiled wryly!
She looked at the man before her.
His shining eyes of singularities were earnest as if he truly meant it!
Him!
Someone levels below her in power. Multiple levels below her father in power!
And yet for her, he didn't hesitate to say he would stand against the Logos of the Wheel and the Watchers of the Wheelomachy!
He didn't care or think about all the shockingly complex beings within these groups. He only cared for her and wanted to do right by her.
He only wanted to protect the one he loved, no matter what.
This...was a Man!

chapters.title: Chapter 3456 Serendipity! IV
paragraphs: Her own father was renounced as in her eyes, he lost the distinction of a Man.
This entity before her...he was a true Man!
But even with this...
She was about to shake her head when an instant later, Ozymandias didn't even give her a chance to as he took her hand and flashed to appear above the multicolored sea.
"The place you will have a vacation in for now while I take care of everything is where my other half is. I've turned it into a beautiful place as there, nobody will come to chase after you."

She blinked as her eyes opened wider in shock, finally looking around her to see the remaining reserves of Fossil fuels, coals, and oil among others. Alongside massive fighter jets, satellites, spaceships that would make billionaires of a past blue planet jealous, and more!
She saw all of this and recalled what she knew about that frequency as she uttered out.
"Just..what exactly are you doing?"
What was he doing?

"Only what I need to do to protect those I love. Now, this will be temporary. Sending things into this barren Frequency matters not regardless of complexity, but we have not yet tried sending anything nearly as complex as you in Existence. Are you able to utilize your complexity to the utmost and leave only a single shred remaining?"
He took control and told her what she should do, and after she thought about it...this was definitely a place where they wouldn't be able to find her!
Nobody from the Logos of the Wheel nor the Watchers of the Wheelomachy would dare to waste their own lives to go to a place nobody could leave.
But this meant that even she would not be able to leave.
When she thought about it, all hesitation left her as there, she would at least be with this man who wouldn't abandon her no matter what!

So she put apart all her reservations. She didn't even ask anything else as she nodded, looking at the Runes she had laid out around this Gateway Frequency last time as now, to expend most of her complexity...
HUUM!
She pulled from the very depths of her existence as she began to form a massive Rune of Existence.
"I will put everything I have in here."
Her voice was calm and sweet.
The heavy emotions she held seemed to all be leaving her as above the multicolored sea, strokes of a single intricate rune began to form as it read...COMPLEXITY!
A literal rune of complexity.
To empower the complexity of the multicolored sea and everything around her.
And it would hold all the empowerment of a Source Complexity entity!
BOOM!
The multicolored sea churned as the massive rune rapidly went towards completion.
A minute passed.
Five minutes.
Half an hour!

Finally, Barbatos showed a weary look, her body feeling weak and empty of all power as she had truly imparted everything she held onto this single Rune of Existence that was currently radiating a heart shaking air.
It released a calm barrier all around as its complexity was contained, and it reflected all of its power on that multicolored sea that had already begun to explode in size and grandeur!
Already, it had more than doubled in size since she began designing the Rune of Existence, and it continued even now as this was a truly serendipitous event.
In the heartache and betrayal, there was always something positive on the other side!
Ozymandias knew that the Frequency Gateway was akin to a two-way street.
The influence of authorities on this side was tremendously larger, but the more this Frequency was used, the larger its space became.
Akin to a passage being used again and again, gradually expanding it and making it bigger.
Until eventually...the number and quality of things that could pass through would be drastically increased!
Ozymandias floated down and grabbed the now frail figure of Barbatos from under the dazzling Rune of Existence that was floating above the multicolored sea.
He saw her eyes that showed relaxation and peace as he kissed her forehead, their figures coming to float above the churning waves of the multicolored sea as he slowly lowered her down!
"You will see me again before you even know it."
She looked towards him and smiled with a nod.
The moment her feet touched the surface of the churning sea...
WAP!
Her figure was pulled down as she instantly disappeared into the Frequency Gateway!

Waves of luminosity shone just from this action, the multicolored sea stretching out rapidly in size yet again as the massive Rune of COMPLEXITY came to settle right above the dazzling sea, radiating unfathomable waves of reinforcement and power.
In the distance, the visage of the Infiniverse Megalos Body uttered out with shining eyes.
|This has advanced our process by weeks or months...the things I only theorized of being able to send and do later, we should be able to do them soon.|
She mentioned the shocking positive boon out of all this as she continued observing the seething multicolored sea!
On the other side of this radiant sea.
Within another Frequency entirely.
"Mmm?!"
Barbatos felt a squeezing pain across her whole body, as if she was squeezing through an extremely tight space!
The pressure was heavy as soon, she felt like waves of water were trying to flow into her body to drown her.
But a moment later...
SPLASH!
Her figure broke above a radiant sea, her mouth opening to breathe heavily as she then felt a sense of weightlessness.
As if she were falling down!
But an instant later, a robotic hand filled with cushions reached out and grabbed her, and she breathed out while looking around her.
What she saw caused her to continue looking around in a stupor.
Multiple long robotic hands surrounded a sizable sea, huge neon platforms built around it as this sea looked to be larger than even ten football fields.
Further around it, a massive lower side of an Extremity Vein could be seen, along with the ever expanding wonders of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed that was getting bigger and bigger!
This...was the barren Frequency that all types of entities, no matter their complexity, feared?

As she thought of this, the robotic hand pulled her towards a certain neon platform as when she was turned around, she saw three figures staring towards her as behind them, hundreds of white gold Autonomous Quintessential Androids stood!
She saw...him.
Adorned in simple gold robes at this moment.
His hair was dark as stellar space, his eyes deep and mesmerizing as he smiled towards her figure that was set down seamlessly and spoke in a teasing tone.
"You missed me so much that you entered Hell Terra Firma to join me?"
Barbatos looked at Noah's grand figure as her eyes shook.
She then ran towards him and delved into his chest in a deep hug as at this moment, free of all attachments from the Logos of the Wheel, a Source Complexity entity joined Noah's banner!

chapters.title: Chapter 3457 Serendipity! V
paragraphs: A Source Complexity Entity entered into Noah's fold freely after her own people told her she was about to become a scapegoat for something she didn't have any control over.
She didn't know that the moment she passed through the Frequency Gateway, it just so happened that a moment later, the largest number of Strings of Existence thus far snapped all at once!
BOOM!
At the Point of Origin.
Bob was surrounded by blinding weavings of complexity, golden blood erupting from over a hundred white gold tentacles that had been wrapped around Strings of Existence nearby!
They snapped all at once, this Unraveling being the most violent one so far!

His gaze was cloudy and filled with silent anger as the ruptured white gold tentacles returned into his body, and even more erupted out from his sides as they held onto a few hundred more golden Strings of Existence.
At such a time, a deep sigh echoed out in the surroundings as space opened up like pages of a book, and an aged old man with white hair and a beard appeared from these pages!
|Even though it may all be pointless, this old man will alap join you in this endeavor.|
A terrifying but silent complexity seethed around him as over a hundred white lines erupted from him to wrap onto other golden Strings of Existence.
Bob turned towards this entity as he harrumphed, his gaze also turning towards other directions as more auras came out!
|Great Sage, Persephael...you lot only decided to come in now? Useless.|

His voice was cold as, after the old man, a few more entities with utterly terrifying weavings of complexity appeared one after another, their gazes full of unknown weavings as they stared at this Point where Existence itself was Unraveling!
It was Watchers.
Watchers of the Wheelomachy!
Wheelomachy.
What did this word even mean?
The first term was simple as it related to the Wheel.
It was the second term that was more complex.
It meant battle. It meant war!
The Watchers of the Wheelomachy were literally the Watchers of the Battle of the Wheel!
The Watchers of the War of the Wheel of Existence!
But their weavings did far more than just watch.
At this moment, multiple of these Watchers appeared.
Among those to arrive, a woman adorned with golden jewels all over her body looked at the empty region of the Expanse that was absent of a few hundred Strings of Existence as she asked.

|What caused such an unraveling? What important piece of Existence did this Frequency lose to cause this phenomenon, especially one that is occurring this fast? In any other Frequencies that lost something that should have never been lost, the reaction has never been this violent. And Existence rectified itself soon after to fill the hole of the missing piece. What creature is the Wheel deeming irreplaceable that this Unraveling is continuing?|
The one called Persephael asked such heavy questions.
Yes!
There had been instances in the past where events that should have never occurred...took place.
But always, the Wheel continued to churn.
What was lost was replaced.

Whatever piece that was needed for the flow of the Wheel to continue would arise even without the Watchers having to intervene, but there were instances where they did intervene and were able to solve small unravelings of existence.

|The possible Point of Origin is a creature I was drawn to not too long ago- or those connected to him. A creature barely beginning to grasp the States of Existence. He was forcefully sent into the weavings of the Purgatory Lands through the forced hand of the Logos of the Wheel. Things began to unravel from that point.|
Bob waved his hands dismissively while he replied and gave the most rudimentary information.
Hearing it, the gazes of others changed as Persephael looked toward Bob inquisitively.
|You were involved even before this all began? Could your weavings have rubbed off-|

|Don't speak any nonsense. The critical thing here is that the lost weaving of Existence was lost in the Purgatory Lands. What is lost in Purgatory Lands does not come back. And if the Wheel itself cannot rectify it...the unraveling will only accelerate.|
Silence descended as these entities listened to the words of Bob with differing expressions.

|The bigger question to ask, and those responsible will answer it- is what exactly prompted the Logos of the Wheel to issue out one of their missions for this? Was this truly an accidental event, or was it purposeful on their behalf?|
Shocking words came out of Bob as the eyes of those here flashed with brilliance!
Purposeful?
The first ever unraveling of existence that was this massive in scale was a purposeful event?
|This...| The Great Sage had a hazy expression as he thought carefully before he continued.
|Is this why I hear the talks of War? That fox, Heimilzana, reached out to me to act as a mediator between the Logos of the Wheel and the Watchers if I could.|
|Oh, did she now?| Bob's singularities became even sharper as he harrumphed and continued.

|The pretext of War makes it so that I can uproot all of those involved in this within the Logos of the Wheel. With their records, I'll be sure whether this was truly an accident or not. I have to do this because...what do you all think will happen if this Unraveling of Existence continues?|
The pretext of the War across Frequencies. Because the forces of the Logos of the Wheel were stretched out across Frequencies.
But Bob asked an even more critical question thereafter as in the distance, the bejeweled figure of Persephael sighed as she spoke out with a gloomy expression.

|When it passes a certain point, all weavings of this Frequency of Existence will destabilize, and the complexity of life within will start to be affected. Eventually, the entire Frequency will unravel as after that...|
|Yes. After that...| Bob looked at all the Watchers who had arrived here as his gaze was exceedingly cold.
He finished the words of Persephael.
|After that, this unraveling of existence will likely spread onto other Frequencies as we...will have a Catastrophic Weaving of the Wheel on our hands!|

chapters.title: Chapter 3458 Serendipity! VI
paragraphs: A Catastrophic Weaving of the Wheel!
Something that the Watchers of the Wheelomachy had to ensure never even had its beginning stages.
It was a theory of things that should never come to pass.
Something that if they did their jobs properly, they wouldn't even be hearing about it!
To hear about it now....
The Great Sage was holding on to dozens of Strings of Existence when...
SNAP!
A heavy force snapped a string he held as the white line he released was broken.
His gaze was cloudy with a pondering allure as he spoke out.
|There are only so many ways to stop the unraveling of existence. We absolutely cannot let it spread from this Frequency and unto others as the only way to do so...|
His words did not finish.
They couldn't!
They lingered in the air as the answer was too heavy, and it was one that nobody here wanted to have on their hands.
The closest one could liken it to was a dying, decaying branch on a vibrant tree.
This decay couldn't be allowed to spread to all other branches of this tree as naturally, it had to be cut down. Isolated. Separated from the rest!
This was the simple idea that the Great Sage mentioned without finishing his words. Because even for those like them, it was unthinkable.
A deep silence hung in the air as Bob harrumphed.
|How about we stop things where they are? The first thing to do is figure out the intent behind the origination of this event as I will seek the answers from the Logos of the Wheel.|
With an eruption of brilliance, Bob's body split in two as one disappeared right after!
The other Watchers remained silent as the Great Sage closed his eyes while releasing even more white lines- and perceptive eyes would notice these white lines burning with weavings of Anti-Matter!
The Watchers of the Wheelomachy were mysterious with their numbers unknown, and they were composed of entities from all different origins.
At this moment, they moved to stop the unraveling of existence, while one of them sought to grasp the true nature behind it- and hold certain people responsible!
As they did this, Persephael looked towards the far distance, her eyes squinting as she voiced out.
|And what the hell is going on over there?|
Her gaze was locked in a direction where it seemed dozens of Pioneers were grouping up against a single one.
Weaving of Matter and Dark Matter seemed to also be clashing at the same time!
Bob glanced towards that direction for a moment as he replied.
|The same weavings of greed that occur time and time again. In history and many frequencies, it follows the same pattern. It has occurred in this Frequency before, and it is occurring again now.|
History had a tendency to repeat itself.
And at this moment, the events unfolding in the distant Immovable Sacred Palace were nothing but a repetition of history.
The other Watchers glanced at the shocking battles as the Great Sage asked.
|What is occurring there is not related to the unraveling of existence here?|
Another critical question.
In the middle of the very unraveling of existence, could the eruption of profound entropy and chaos truly have nothing to do with it?
Bob was silent at this question as he looked among the sea of moving entities with their own Complexities, his gaze coming to lock onto Ozymandias as his eyes flashed.
And his answer was a simple one.
|No.|
The other Watchers heard his words as even if any of them had a shred of doubt or suspicion, after Bob answered, it faded away.
After all, he was Bob.
He was someone who left no stone unturned as if he said there was no relation, then truly, there was no relation!
So their focus returned onto the dazzling unraveling of existence as even within their conversation...
SNAP! SNAP!
More strings of Existence continued to break!
They looked at this event as a mistake.
Something that the Wheel of Existence itself would normally correct as Existence continued to flow.
Something that needed to be reversed.
They didn't know that the one who was actually involved....only saw it as a profound serendipity!
In the distance where they had just turned their gazes away from...
|Your Outerversal Authority is sealed|
|Your weavings of Mana are sealed!|
|Your colorless path is sealed!|
Three Ents with massive verdant gold bodies appeared around Ozymandias as they roared out.
Under the Quintessential League of Existence, one didn't even need to know the identity of the Ordinance or Path they wanted to seal.
So long as they made their intention clear and selected the weavings of a path on the target, it would be sealed!
These three Ents appeared around Ozymandias after he had sealed the path of A Gold Ash Tree Ent Pioneer, they interjected to protect their own.
But they were shocked to find that Ozymandias still had complexity surging around him as he sealed their paths, and so they sealed more of his!
At this time, he had to have at least Four Ordinances sealed.
And yet he still moved forward, a heavy purple light blooming from him as he bellowed out.
|Your Complexity has already collapsed, everything about it is already mine!|
The Severed Weavings of Plot erupted out like a wave, the speed rapid as they covered one of the closest Ents right away.
The tree like face turned livid with fury as the other Ents around it with their Complexity sealed scrambled away not to be caught in this domineering light!
At such a time.
WAP!

A massive Golden Titan appeared above, and he didn't even attack as instead, he released golden strings that wrapped around the Gold Ash Tree Ent Pioneer and the other two Ent Pioneers that were not yet affected, and he pulled them all back!
His eyes were callous as he watched the single affected Ent Pioneer break apart, verdant gold blood leaking from it as it all went towards Ozymandias.
And after these drops of Blood- the complexity of a Pioneer, entered his being...the pressure and complexity he radiated became even more intense!
And yet the Golden Titan only looked at this calmly as he bellowed out.

|Three of his Ordinances are now sealed so long as these three do not die! If you have your path sealed, we will save you and keep you alive until every single Ordinance this creature has...is sealed!|
WAA!
The Golden Titans took control and revealed a terrifying plan.
This Instrument of the Beyonder was a terrifying creature, yes.
But if its Ordinances continued to be sealed and remain sealed...what more could it do?!

And if three Ordinances were already sealed, how many more did he have up his sleeve? Another two? Another three? They simply had to wait for him to seal a few more entities, keep those entities alive, and they would finally get their hands on his Complexity!

chapters.title: Chapter 3459 Who Said! I
paragraphs: The weavings of the Pioneers were sharp as they moved in synchrony to ensure that no more of them died.
After all, they were distinguished Pioneers of Existence.
They held their own dignity and pride, and the sheer fact that their complexity was getting thrashed around like this... caused them to feel a sense of violation!
They had to put a stop to it, get their hands on the body of this entity, and determine whether he held the weavings of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian or not.

|You can make all of this easy by simply answering the question- do you deny having any connection to the weavings of Megalonians? It is such a simple question that stops all of this the moment you answer. So what will it be?!|
Above, a Golden Titan bellowed out as once more, the Instrument of the Beyonder said nothing. At this moment.
|Bahaha, what right do you have to make the Instrument of the Beyonder answer? We will protect him from here on out!|

At this time, the tides of Outerversal Authority also arrived as multiple Great Ones- not yet observed within the Pantheons of the Megalos Beyond nor the Primal Eldritch Palace of the Expanse, appeared.

They stemmed from ancient groups that even held Source Complexity entities behind them, with their intent unknown as the blanketing Outerversal Sea covered everything around the Instrument of the Beyonder at this moment!
And amidst it...Ozymandias easily saw through the murky sea as the face of a massive octopus and its tentacles looked towards him.

|You are the Instrument we heard whispers of from the Greatest Morphon to rise amongst us? I am the Great Eater, the One Who Sleeps in the Depths! I will lend you my aid here along with my brethren, but...just let us confirm who we truly are protecting. It is unheard of for an Outerversal Morphon drenched in Dark Matter to somehow have the weavings of the purest lifeform stemming from Matter. We have to ascertain this, O Instrument.|
The words were filled with a profound veiled sense of greed.
The Pioneer even made it clear as its greed was straightforward- a part of its tentacles going towards Ozymandias!
Behind the blanketing stellar black obsidian sea, other Outerversal Authorities at the level of Pioneers rose and came forward.
All of this happened in the murky darkness of a stellar black sea as the Golden Titans and other Pioneers frowned at this intrusion that would make this whole ordeal take even longer!

In the Blancverse Domain of the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse, the Immovable Sacred Guard frowned as he looked at the visage of Pioneer Heracles that had nearly collapsed, his eyes flashing as he sent a message towards a Source Complexity entity only he knew how to contact.

|Sir, any action or guidance on the report I sent regarding three offenders from different Frequencies of Existence? Possibly a Fourth one that the others claim has connections to the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian.|

A message that crossed unique weavings of existence to go towards a Source Complexity Entity that had been one of the earliest entities from the establishment of the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse.
Someone who had placed himself under the banner of those Entities who oversaw the smooth flow of the weavings of the Wheel!
The Immovable Sacred Guard waited briefly after he sent a message towards such a being, and a reply rang out in his mind soon enough.
|I have sent this message upwards. It has been deemed...as nothing for us to be involved in.|
What?
The Immovable Sacred Guard became stern and entirely somber.
This was exactly the type of thing they normally became involved in.
Correcting the flow of those in Frequencies of the Wheel that didn't belong to them.
Ensuring that everyone was where they were supposed to be!
So...why was it that now was an exception?
His mind buzzed with questions, but he had no answer.
In the next moment...
ROAR!
The enraged roar of an Outerversal Morphon rang out!

Outside of the Blancverse, a stellar black sea churned as a titanic Eldritch visage of an Octopus roared while moving back- its body pulled by a humanoid Pioneer who had the head of a Squid while another Pioneer in the form of a Mollusk protected from the front!

The figure of Ozymandias erupted from this sea as he held 4 ripped tentacles that were sucked of their obsidian blood, pristine stellar obsidian Globules of Blood of Pioneers flowing into his body as his aura continued to scale upwards.
|We sought to help you, fiend!|
The Outerversal Morphon in the form of an Octopus had its Path sealed, over 30% of its weavings having almost collapsed with its blood drained!
The scene was a heavy and shocking one as...the Instrument of the Beyonder even sought death against his own people?

In this moment of shock and confusion, the Instrument gazed at all beings while his complexity continued to climb up another level, his intent booming out as behind him, a dazzling purple throne began to manifest.
|I am Ozymandias, and I burn with a glorious purpose.|
HUUM!

On the purple throne, space twisted and distorted as an illusory visage of a woman that burned with crimson gold grandeur bloomed, her eyes burning with the weight of millions of suns as they looked at all Pioneers here with coldness!
In her hands, a Rune of Existence that held the word [SWORD] bloomed inside a singularity as moments later, a dazzling crimson gold sword bloomed as it pointed its tip towards the many entities here.
It was something alongside the Transcendent Megalos Techniques of the Great Beyonder- a Rune he had obtained in his Dreams.
The Sword of the Megalos!
Boundless complexity seemed condensed inside of it and ready to erupt as Ozymandias continued.

|Whoever stands against my path, whether that be someone from the Megalos Beyond burning with Outerversal Authority, or those from the Megalos Ynnere and Megalos Nihilos burning with their own weavings of Matter and Anti-Matter...every single one should be prepared for death because of such a choice!|
WAA!

All of this happened in the murky darkness of a stellar black sea as the Golden Titans and other Pioneers frowned at this intrusion that would make this whole ordeal take even longer!

In the Blancverse Domain of the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse, the Immovable Sacred Guard frowned as he looked at the visage of Pioneer Heracles that had nearly collapsed, his eyes flashing as he sent a message towards a Source Complexity entity only he knew how to contact.
|Sir, any action or guidance on the report I sent regarding three offenders from different Frequencies of Existence?
Possibly a Fourth one that the others claim has connections to the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian.|

A message that crossed unique weavings of existence to go towards a Source Complexity Entity that had been one of the earliest entities from the establishment of the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse.
Someone who had placed himself under the banner of those Entities who oversaw the smooth flow of the weavings of the Wheel!
The Immovable Sacred Guard waited briefly after he sent a message towards such a being, and a reply rang out in his mind soon enough.
|I have sent this message upwards.
It has been deemed...as nothing for us to be involved in.|
What?
The Immovable Sacred Guard became stern and entirely somber.
This was exactly the type of thing they normally became involved in.
Correcting the flow of those in Frequencies of the Wheel that didn't belong to them.
Ensuring that everyone was where they were supposed to be!
So...why was it that now was an exception?
His mind buzzed with questions, but he had no answer.
In the next moment...
ROAR!
The enraged roar of an Outerversal Morphon rang out!

Outside of the Blancverse, a stellar black sea churned as a titanic Eldritch visage of an Octopus roared while moving back- its body pulled by a humanoid Pioneer who had the head of a Squid while another Pioneer in the form of a Mollusk protected from the front!

The figure of Ozymandias erupted from this sea as he held 4 ripped tentacles that were sucked of their obsidian blood, pristine stellar obsidian Globules of Blood of Pioneers flowing into his body as his aura continued to scale upwards.
|We sought to help you, fiend!|
The Outerversal Morphon in the form of an Octopus had its Path sealed, over 30% of its weavings having almost collapsed with its blood drained!
The scene was a heavy and shocking one as...the Instrument of the Beyonder even sought death against his own people?

In this moment of shock and confusion, the Instrument gazed at all beings while his complexity continued to climb up another level, his intent booming out as behind him, a dazzling purple throne began to manifest.
|I am Ozymandias, and I burn with a glorious purpose.|
HUUM!

On the purple throne, space twisted and distorted as an illusory visage of a woman that burned with crimson gold grandeur bloomed, her eyes burning with the weight of millions of suns as they looked at all Pioneers here with coldness!
In her hands, a Rune of Existence that held the word [SWORD] bloomed inside a singularity as moments later, a dazzling crimson gold sword bloomed as it pointed its tip towards the many entities here.
It was something alongside the Transcendent Megalos Techniques of the Great Beyonder- a Rune he had obtained in his Dreams.
The Sword of the Megalos!
Boundless complexity seemed condensed inside of it and ready to erupt as Ozymandias continued.

|Whoever stands against my path, whether that be someone from the Megalos Beyond burning with Outerversal Authority, or those from the Megalos Ynnere and Megalos Nihilos burning with their own weavings of Matter and Anti-Matter...every single one should be prepared for death because of such a choice!|
WAA!

chapters.title: Chapter 3460 Who Said! II
paragraphs: Whoever stood against his path, every single one should be prepared for death!
Regardless of their origins.
|And you, O Outerversal Morphon of the Megalos Beyond....|
His gaze turned fiery.

On the purple throne of Severed Tyranny, the visage of the Saintess of Fiery Damnation wielding the Sword of the Megalos turned her head towards the powerful Great Ones that were looking towards him in rage.

|Outerversal Morphons of the Megalos Beyond...The very Instrument of the Beyonder, the Great Beyonder, stands before you while waging a war. Why have you not kneeled and paid your respects?! You dare to try and lay your unworthy hands on me?!|
BOOM!
A terrifying intent exploded out as it seemed like everything was about to deteriorate!
The Severed Weavings of Tyranny exploded out with wild abandon as they pressured any entity nearby to bend their will.

Such a pressure would cause any Pioneer to be utterly enraged as it was akin to the very Path that they forged being told to bend its weavings towards another. The Hererical Outerversal Morphons were living as more and more of them came out of the sea of obsidian authority, a massive entity that was a massive single slender tentacle with a crimson serpentine eye at the very end arising from this sea and looking towards Ozymandias as a cruel feminine voice boomed out!
|Imposter! No Instrument of the Beyonder would raise their might against other Outerversal Morphons! Apprehend this vile creature!|
A drastic change in ideology.
At this moment, even his own people- those of the Dark Matter, turned against him as their eyes held burning complexities!
Down below, near the entry point of the Blancverse of the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse, The Great Mother watched this unfolding with an ashen expression as she was dismayed.
She saw legends of the Outerversal Morphons she had only heard of in the Megalos Beyond- Entities that had long made their home in the Expanse.
She admired such entities and hoped to be like them one day, but at this moment, they turned their blades towards the Instrument of the Beyonder!
Towards the one that was promised!
HUUM!
She shouted out, but her intent could not even be heard amidst the roiling complexities of Pioneers.
It was only heard and passed around in the illusory scenes she displayed in the Pantheon of Umbra in the Megalos Beyond.
|Where are the true followers of the Beyonder?! The Pioneers that followed his path and tradition?! His Instrument is being besieged on all sides by our own forces, so where are you!|
A deep howl filled with indignation and misery.
And it had no answer.

In the Expanse, Ozymandias looked at the Outerversal Morphons who actually sought to lay their hands on his body just from hearing of the possible resurgence of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian as at this moment, the Sword of the Megalos in the hands of the Saintess of Fiery Damnation pointed towards the three Outerversal Morphons protecting the Octopus he had already begun to collect the weavings of.
As he did this...
|None of your Outerversal Authorities work!|
He bellowed out as instantly, the complexity of these Morphons began to dim.
As they experienced this...
|Your tyrannical purple Ordinance is also sealed!|
|Your crimson Ordinance is sealed!|
|Your illusory authority of dreams is sealed!|

They all bellowed out in turn as around Ozymandias, the purple throne began to dim and fade away- alongside the Saintess of Fiery Damnation and the Sword of the Megalos she held as Tyranny, Helios, and Dreams were being sealed.
The Outerversal Morphons were overjoyed at this as in the background, Pioneers of Matter also began to move forward.
Was this not about 6 or 7 of his Ordinances sealed? He may not even have any more paths left in store as his path may be closed!

The Outerversal Morphon that was a single slender tentacle with an eye at the very end- the Great Spermathos, arrived above the the four Sealed Outerversal Pioneers to protect them as he watched the dimming light around Ozymandias- his eye shooting out rays of obsidian brilliance ahead.
But...the purple throne that was just fading away began to light up again, this time burning with a violet purple radiance as the Severed Weavings of Entropy surged from it.
Atop the throne, the Saintess of Fiery Damnation reformed as her body became painted scorching gold, the Severed weavings of Destiny burning within her!
And in her hands, the Sword of the Megalos came back to life as it was filled with a murky darkness that was none other than the Severed Weaving of Apocalypse.
It was a scene of sheer horror as the sword swung down unhindered, the Great Spermathos feeling its own authority becoming sealed as the terrifying voice of Ozymandias thundered out.
|Who said all my weavings were sealed?!|
WAA!
Words that boomed out and repeated in the minds of all those here spread out as a terrifying Sword of the Megalos exploded in front of five Outerversal Pioneers of Existence!
BOOM!

A Cataclysmic light of brilliance covered everything as illusions of apocalyptic pieces of Omniverses arose in the surroundings, these illusions slowly becoming real as in a short period of time, it truly seemed like decimated pieces of Omniverse were swinging around into a swirling circular storm that only expanded outwards!
Any Pioneers that approached would have to get past this blooming storm brought about by the Severed Weavings of Apocalypse that only seemed to be picking up speed and distinction.

And at the center of this storm, the figure of Ozymandias could be seen floating between the bodies of five decimated Outerversal Pioneers of Existence, his eyes of singularities blaring pillars of baleful light as his body radiated a heavy gravitational force that was devouring rivers of blood and tentacles of all of these Outerversal Pioneers!
As he did so, his aura became more and more maddening as in the distance, the Golden Titans bellowed out.
|Do not let him continue!|

chapters.title: Chapter 3461 Who Said! III
paragraphs: Everyone could see that the complexity of this being only continued to rise as he directly devoured every entity he killed.
He had just killed 5 Outerversal Pioneers at this moment as they truly could not sit still!
Five Golden Titans shot out and entered the swirling circular storm of apocalypse, along with dozens of other Pioneers who knew this could not go on.
They had to ensure that no more sealed Pioneers were dying to this being, and that both he and them remained sealed as they found out the limit of the number of Ordinances this entity had!

Since he had just killed those five Outerversal Pioneers, five of his sealed Ordinances were unsealed as the brightness around him only increased- making it approximately 8-9 Ordinances they had now seen him display.

This number was gradually becoming more and more shocking, and it was one that showed just how impure this entity was in declaring all of these Ordinances. None of them could fully grasp how he had managed to amalgamate and sever all these 9 Ordinances- this alone being an impossibility!
But in the endless weavings of Existence, there were always oddities.

And the more power he displayed- the more he showed these nonsensical capabilities that were outside the scope of others...the more they were convinced of the assertion of the Resurgence of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian!
After all, his uniqueness and complexity could be explained if one attributed it to the mystery of the Megalonians!
Arriving into the Apocalyptic severed domain around Ozymandias, the Paths of dozens of Pioneers erupted.
This time, they moved all at once as they treated this unique existence with less care than before, not wondering whether he would perish from their attacks after all they had seen.
What they needed to do was suppress!
After all, he couldn't evade the instantaneous attacks of dozens of Pioneer even if he sealed five or even eight of them!
|O Light!|
|O Chaos!|
|O Dignity!|
|Raze, Destruction!|
|Absorb, Plunderer!|
Dozens of paths struck out.
At this dire time, all by himself, Ozymandias faced the unshackled attacks of dozens of Pioneers.
It felt like heavy waves of complexity were surging at him from all around as if he didn't do anything, their sheer complexity combined together could crush his weavings one by one!
Even if their power was limited to not unleash their true paths of Pioneers by the Quintessential League of Existence.
Their sheer complexity was heavy as from all around, manifestation of pure wonders bloomed.
Golden pillars of pure light that swung down like spears of judgment.

A manifestation of a massive Golden Titan appeared above, withstanding the swirling shattered pieces of miniaturized omniverses as it bellowed out and released beams of white light from its facial orifices!
Dark purple petals that danced with heavy destruction swirling down like a storm, cutting anything nearby apart as they all pressed towards Ozymandias.

Towards the throne behind him and the Saintess of Fiery Damnation seated on it as she wielded the Sword of the Megalos and pointed it up- thousands of singularities that looked like balls of glorious flames shooting out from the sword tip and spreading out all around!
But it was still not enough.
The pressure and complexity smashing down on all sides was suffocating, and if he didn't reduce it, he would be the one reduced to dust!
So...
|OOOOH!|
Ozymandias bellowed out as a terrifying Sacred Primal Eye of Existence opened above him, locking onto the most dreadful paths coming down as he gave the command.
|Seal|
|Seal!
|SEAL!|
HUUUM!
Everything trembled.
Of the brightest authorities cascading down, seven instantly dimmed and began to fade away!
At the same time...bellows echoed out from the affected Pioneersas they yelled out while selecting the radiant authorities around Ozymandias.
|Motherfucker, you're also sealed!| ...!

The price of the Quintessential League of Existence to seal authorities was equal, with many thinking such a high cost could not be borne by anyone as, eventually, they would fall after enough of their authorities were sealed.
So moments later, the Pioneers nearby were energized as those sealed...
|I've been sealed- pull me out!|

They yelled out towards those around them- not even their allies, but they trusted them to aid in keeping their bodies away as it would mean the Instrument of the Beyonder would have a path that remained sealed with their survival.
Thus, before the Apocalyptic storm or flaming singularities could claim anyone, Seven Pioneers were pulled out from the storm by other Pioneers!
They didn't even get taken towards the same direction, with all seven entities being pulled towards different directions.
To ensure that even if the Instrument of the Beyonder tried to make a move against them, he may at most be able to get one or two!
Adding to the other Pioneers protected by the Golden Titans...
|That is at least 10 Ordinances of Existence of his sealed! No matter how impure he is, there cannot be too many more. Strip him of everything!|
The other Pioneers remaining in the storm of apocalyptic miniaturized shattered Omniverses pressed on as momentarily, 14 were taken out of circulation.
The weight pressing down on Ozymandias from all sides lessened, but the Pioneers did not relent!
Where other attacks used to be but had dimmed, new ones took their place.
|Do you deny it?!|
Another Golden Titan came in as he bellowed out, his golden hand stretching out and crashing down alongside other attacks.
And in front of all this...
|Seal!|
|Seal!|
All the attacks crashing down were sealed one after another, the eyes of many beginning to widen in alarm as they heard the intent of sealing from the Instrument ringing out ten times.
Ten times!
There was a momentary pause before clamor erupted as those sealed shouted out.
|Another one of your Severed Ordinances is also sealed!|
|Get us out!|
Shouts of sealing and of help boomed out as ten more Pioneers pulled out ten sealed Pioneers, and they left behind a dying down storm of Apocalypse as even this concept was sealed.
But...there was immense silence in the surroundings.
That was ten more paths of Pioneers sealed.
Ten!
For a total of 20 Ordinances of Existence sealed from the Instrument of the Beyonder!
What was this? What exactly was this being?!

chapters.title: Chapter 3462 Who Said! IV
paragraphs: 20 Ordinances.
Twenty possible paths!
They actually confirmed this being to have 20 sealed Ordinances of Existence, such a thing making them extremely somber!
In the distance, the visage of the Golden Titan distinguished as the Great Marshall spoke out commandingly.

|Those who have their Paths sealed- leave this region for now to ensure your lives. Your deaths would result in the 20 sealed Ordinances of this creature to be unsealed- so stay away until the rest of his paths are sealed!|
He spoke commandingly even though he didn't have any direct control over the other forces.
But his words held merit as to ensure their own safety, those who had their path sealed began moving even further away after accepting the help of others.
Other Pioneers were even more straightforward as they continued their aid, releasing bursts of light that contained the sealed Pioneers and sent them far from here!
But...
|Huh?|
BZZZT!
When they reached a certain distance, as if there was a terrifying and absolute barrier, they found that their bodies could not move any further!
From any direction.
All those sealed Pioneers who were being led to leave...found that an undeniable force stopped them!
They didn't know that they had simply gotten to the edge of the Relegation Zone of Existence.
|You all do not seem to understand.|
WAA!
The booming voice of the Instrument of the Beyonder thundered out.
|You may have not been heeding my words earlier but...|
As he spoke, with approximately 20 Ordinances of Existence sealed...the temperature around him began to distort and rise as the severed weavings of the Protagonist bloomed to form a dazzling Bow.
Its expression at this moment was one of scorching rage, this bow grasped on the left hand of Ozymandias as it formed with shocking intricacies!
Behind him, the throne and Saintess of Fiery Damnation fully faded as it was only his stellar visage and the bow of the Protagonist.
A bow radiating its weavings and questioning all those here- just who did they think they were pushing around?!
|You are within an entirely different League of Existence at this moment. You are now entangled with me as in these weavings of existence, none may leave!|
WAA!
His words were booming.
With the bow held in his left hand, his right hand reached out to the dazzling gold bowstring as he began to draw back- a scorching obsidian light of Vacuous brilliance forming!
|The only way to leave here is to break this Entanglement- through my death, or yours!|
Either he died, or they died!
There could be no other possible result.
Such terrifying words boomed out as the Great Marshall of the Golden Titans here roared out while looking at the dangerous golden bow and formed obsidian arrow within the hands of Ozymandias.
|Protect those sealed!|
TING!

No sooner had he spoked...did Ozymandias release the terrifying obsidian arrow of Severed Vacuous lined with the golden brilliance of the Protagonist as...this arrow instantly disappeared after it was shot out.
All Pioneers tensed as they didn't know who the target would be, many Pioneers scrambling to those sealed as...

A humanoid golden titan adorned a silver suit of armor felt a sensation of a void in his chest as when he looked down, he saw half of his chest missing as a dazzling obsidian arrow bloomed from his body.

It was akin to a dazzling singularity blooming and eating away at his existence, this singularity devouring his blood and complexity as an instant later, it exploded to decimate and collapse his sealed path entirely!
On the other side, a singularity bloomed behind Ozymandias as it gushed out crimson gold blood and complexity unto him.
His body also lit up as a sealed Ordinance was unsealed.
Silence hung in the surroundings as in an instant, from afar, the Instrument had sniped another Pioneer to oblivion while devouring their complexity!
And after this, his shining singularities blazed as he roared out, raising his bow while pulling it back multiple times in an instant.
Dazzling lines of severed weavings of Vacuous formed and shot out, their destinations unknown!
And Ozymandias did not stop as he continued to pull the bowstring and form more deadly arrows where a single one had bloomed to collapse the weavings of a sealed Pioneer.
The Great Marshall of the Golden Titans saw this deterioration as he roared out while moving himself.
|Useless wretches, protect those sealed!|
Pioneers scrambled.

Those not sealed appeared around the sealed Pioneers and released their paths around them protectively to isolate any entrance of foreign attacks, with the Golden Titans radiating heavy complexity and moving out from the command of Great Marshall to ensure his orders!
At this critical time.
The gaze of Ozymandias that had been roaring and bellowing this whole time became focused.
His gaze became straight as he calmly stared.
He stared at the Great Marshall roaring out orders.
The Pioneer with the most complex weavings of existence here.
And he uttered silently.
|Your Complexity is sealed.|
In the distance, the gaze of the Great Marshall giving out commands rapidly changed.
The booming weavings of complexity around him became suppressed and stifled as before he could do anything...
HUUM!
Over a dozen obsidian gold arrows bloomed inches away from his body, and they thundered down like havenly spears of hellish judgment!
The Instrument of the Beyonder played many Pioneers and conducted a move that caused many to turn in shock!
His many arrows and show of power were not aimed at anybody else.
They were aimed at the strongest Pioneer here!
BOOOM!
|Great Marshall!|
The Golden Titans, who had left his side to protect others, bellowed out as their eyes burned red with shock and wrath.
Others watched on in stupefaction as the strongest among them had his weavings sealed while he was bombarded with more attacks than any other sealed Pioneers!
And in the midst of their shock, the hand of Ozymandias never stopped as he continued to pull the bowstring, using this momentary lapse to also target others.
It was a critical turning point in this great battle!

sentences.text: 20 Ordinances.
Twenty possible paths!
They actually confirmed this being to have 20 sealed Ordinances of Existence, such a thing making them extremely somber!
In the distance, the visage of the Golden Titan distinguished as the Great Marshall spoke out commandingly.
|Those who have their Paths sealed- leave this region for now to ensure your lives.
Your deaths would result in the 20 sealed Ordinances of this creature to be unsealed- so stay away until the rest of his paths are sealed!|
He spoke commandingly even though he didn't have any direct control over the other forces.
But his words held merit as to ensure their own safety, those who had their path sealed began moving even further away after accepting the help of others.
Other Pioneers were even more straightforward as they continued their aid, releasing bursts of light that contained the sealed Pioneers and sent them far from here!
But...
|Huh?|
BZZZT!
When they reached a certain distance, as if there was a terrifying and absolute barrier, they found that their bodies could not move any further!
From any direction.
All those sealed Pioneers who were being led to leave...found that an undeniable force stopped them!
They didn't know that they had simply gotten to the edge of the Relegation Zone of Existence.
|You all do not seem to understand.|
WAA!
The booming voice of the Instrument of the Beyonder thundered out.
|You may have not been heeding my words earlier but...|
As he spoke, with approximately 20 Ordinances of Existence sealed...the temperature around him began to distort and rise as the severed weavings of the Protagonist bloomed to form a dazzling Bow.
Its expression at this moment was one of scorching rage, this bow grasped on the left hand of Ozymandias as it formed with shocking intricacies!
Behind him, the throne and Saintess of Fiery Damnation fully faded as it was only his stellar visage and the bow of the Protagonist.
A bow radiating its weavings and questioning all those here- just who did they think they were pushing around?!
|You are within an entirely different League of Existence at this moment.
You are now entangled with me as in these weavings of existence, none may leave!|
WAA!
His words were booming.
With the bow held in his left hand, his right hand reached out to the dazzling gold bowstring as he began to draw back- a scorching obsidian light of Vacuous brilliance forming!
|The only way to leave here is to break this Entanglement- through my death, or yours!|
Either he died, or they died!
There could be no other possible result.
Such terrifying words boomed out as the Great Marshall of the Golden Titans here roared out while looking at the dangerous golden bow and formed obsidian arrow within the hands of Ozymandias.
|Protect those sealed!|
TING!

It was akin to a dazzling singularity blooming and eating away at his existence, this singularity devouring his blood and complexity as an instant later, it exploded to decimate and collapse his sealed path entirely!
On the other side, a singularity bloomed behind Ozymandias as it gushed out crimson gold blood and complexity unto him.
His body also lit up as a sealed Ordinance was unsealed.
Silence hung in the surroundings as in an instant, from afar, the Instrument had sniped another Pioneer to oblivion while devouring their complexity!
And after this, his shining singularities blazed as he roared out, raising his bow while pulling it back multiple times in an instant.
Dazzling lines of severed weavings of Vacuous formed and shot out, their destinations unknown!
And Ozymandias did not stop as he continued to pull the bowstring and form more deadly arrows where a single one had bloomed to collapse the weavings of a sealed Pioneer.
