chapters.title: Chapter 3463 A Clean Sweep! I.
paragraphs: Devastation.

Pioneers looked left and right as at the edges of the Relegation Zone of Existence, the sealed Pioneers faced an unprecedented attack where from the very center of their beings, an obsidian gold singularity bloomed and ravaged everything.
With their paths being sealed, the complexity they could unleash was unfathomably less as they could not withstand the heavy attack brought about by the Instrument of the Beyonder!

And they could only watch in dismay and utter horror as their complexities- their very existence that they raised in complexity since they were young...collapsed right before their eyes. As it collapsed, their blood and very weavings of existence were devoured as the singularity brought forth by an arrow returned back to the one that pulled back the bow string.

A glorious flourishing of rivers of the Blood of Pioneers streamed from all directions towards Ozymandias, his body taking in every single thing as at this moment, he began channeling every single drop that formed into a singular concept.
OOOOH!
His complexity reached unfathomable levels. He had not undergone Ordinance Amalgamation. He had only jumped to Sever his existence as they were all considered small aspects of who he was!

Yet right now, the aura that he radiated seemed like something that only the most stupendous and excellent entities of the Existence Severing stage could ever radiate. Its complexity seemed so much more that it didn't truly match the parameters of what one would consider an entity of the Severing stage to be.
|The Ordinance of Cheats has undergone its 25th Severing!|
|The Ordinance of Cheats has undergone its 26th Severing!|
Dazzling prompts constantly buzzed within his mind as he went for a certain accomplishment he only theorized about before.
Continued Severing...until he reached the limit!
But when he reached a certain point....
|The Ordinance of Cheats has undergone its 27th Severing!|
BZZT!
His weavings of existence buzzed.
As if a barrier lay ahead.
Ozymandias looked within the depths of himself as he saw the terrifying complexity that cheats had achieved, where it seemed like it was being compressed and refined again and again.
But when it reached this point, to compress it even more- to Sever its weavings of existence further...much more would be required!
|The requirement analyzed to get past the 27th Severing of Existence has been determined to be three Globules of Blood of a Pioneer.|
The cost of elevation was made known.
To Sever Existence so many times, again and again, the cost did not remain the same!
So Ozymandias looked hungrily towards his target that should have been holding the most complex Blood of a Pioneer.
The area where many eyes were currently honed in as they wondered of the fate of the one called the Great Marshall of the Golden Titans over here.

And what this saw caused all eyes to open wide as there, the scene of a once glorious Pioneer of Existence- a Golden Titan at that, had his body pierced by countless small holes as the vast majority of his blood was drained.
But around him, a golden water lily floated in front of him and radiated a terrifying glow of gold.
It seemed to have protected him as after this, it was not done.
The skewered body of the Great Marshall that seemed nearly about the fall began to brim with life ever so slowly as from this golden water lily, a sea of complexity surged out and bathed him.
His expression was currently that of utmost rage and ferocity as he bellowed out.
|Do you truly think that you could kill one of the Great Marshalls of the Golden Frequency Monarch?!|
WAA!
Even with his path sealed, his life force seemed to be brimming with an unfathomable radiance!
Who was he?!
A Great Marshall of the Golden Frequency Monarch- this was a Frequency Monarch! How could he not be protected? How could he not have life saving means that others could not even imagine?
At this moment, he stood tall as five Golden Titans appeared instantly after surrounding him on all sides as their bodies pulsed with unleashed paths that covered him entirely.
Even with his path sealed, he still roared out!
|Do not let him continue! Do not let him continue unsealing all the paths that are blocked from him!|
He roared out commandingly, but at this point in time, a truth had settled in.
Seeing so many Pioneers being killed had already made many beings hesitant.
Now, after watching even a Great Marshall of the Golden Titans nearly perish, many had begun to rethink all this!
They weren't as organized as before, and this only allowed Ozymandias to shoot more arrows as he began to turn his gaze to others here.
|Your Path is sealed!|
|Your Path is sealed!|

He selected entities and sealed their paths as the instant after their paths were sealed, terrifying obsidian gold arrows already arrived to claim their complexity. But the moment he sealed them, the Great Marshall also roared out as if he had been waiting and watching.
"Your nullifying black authority is sealed! Your golden fateful authority is sealed!|
He called out for the sealing of the Protagonist and Vacuous as moments later, the golden bow and dark arrows began to slowly fade away!
And before they could do so completely...
'O Genesis. O Chronos.'
HUUM!

White brilliance gushed out maddeningly as the severed weavings of Genesis filled the disappearing golden bow as a dazzling white bow bloomed. And from his pulled-back fingertips of the bowstring, a terrifying purple brilliance of Chronos unfolded.

The scene only caused more eyes of the Pioneers to turn somber as in the far distance, the rageful eyes of Outerversal Pioneers that had begun to come out of the heavy obsidian sea turned calmer and more controlled.
They stopped their movements as they and many others looked at each other while all thinking the same thing.
Was...it really worth risking their lives in the hopes that this being truly was the Resurgence of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian when they might die before they even get close to him?
A heavy thought.
It crossed through many heads while Ozymandias himself continued his rampage!

chapters.title: Chapter 3464 A Clean Sweep! II
paragraphs: A terrifying idea passed through the minds of many Pioneers as they questioned the risks and benefits of where they were right now.
The potential benefits at this moment as Pioneers and their paths forever closed left and right seemed infinitely small when one ascertained the heavy risks that lay all around them.
The risks of death with any possible sealing as even now...they had not confirmed the final number of Ordinances this being had!

At the highest they had sealed all at once was twenty, but with every dying Pioneer- even more of his sealed Ordinances were being recovered as it felt like they were making no progress. Some even held a sense of hopelessness when they fought as initially; the idea was that the Instrument of the Beyonder held two or three ordinances!

This idea was overthrown when he showed five and then six, and then ten. Each time he showed a higher number, they always raised the bar and stated that surely...he would run into his maximum number of Ordinances soon.

This occurred when he reached 10, when he reached 15, and even when he reached 20 as many began questioning at this moment. What if this number continued to 25 or 30 or even more? And just how many more concepts and Pioneers do they have to keep alive all at once to truly and entirely seal all the Ordinances of this being?
They did not have an answer.
They only knew Pioneers were being butchered left and right as at this moment...
|Whether you are the Resurgence of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian or not is of no consequence to the Pure Heart Sacred Palace of the Expanse. Our people are not participating in this endeavor!|
A group of humanoid Pioneers from a Sacred Palace voiced out as they hung around the edges of the Relegation Zone of Existence.
They shockingly stated their intent to pull out!
They were the first, as the moment they did so, the gazes of the Golden Titans turned furious, while even fewer Pioneers were intent on attacking Ozymandias!
Following their lead...
|The Pioneers from the Royal Existential Sacred Palace of the Expanse have not entangled themselves by attacking you. We do not seek any conflict.|
WAA!
Another group of Pioneers rose up and made their intent known!
At this moment, many were stepping back as the benefits of this whole endeavor truly seemed far too low at the risk of their own lives.
But some were more staunch than others.
Some came from lineages that were too important across the weavings of the Expanse! The Golden Titans looked at this scene with utter rage as the healing Great Marshall bellowed out.

|You do not seek conflict? You do not seek conflict?! You are the dignified Pioneers who have enacted your own grand path in the expanse! Members of Palaces of the Expanse that have stood for Cycles! You would take a step back?! Do you truly think this creature will allow any of you to take a step back?!|
The voice was booming.
But it did lay out some truly critical pieces of information and questions. Many could seek to say they no longer wanted any part of this conflict.
But the response of the Instrument of the Beyonder himself...
BOOM! BOOM!
Was a silent one, but booming one.
As if he didn't hear any of their words.
He continued to pull on his bowstring while terrifying arrows formed and disappeared, with his voice echoing out ever so often.
|Seal!|
|SEAL!|
The gazes of many turned utterly sour as entities with their Complexities could come to conclusion very quickly.
He had already said it.
It would either end with their deaths, or his!
Along with the words of the Great Marshall of the Golden Titans, dozens of terrifying lights of Pioneers began to light up all around this region.
There had been a momentary lull in the number of authorities being exchanged as some had tried to back off and even leave, but now...
The concentration and number of authorities that began to light up exceeded even the initial volley of participants.
Because at this moment, everyone knew that their very lives were on the line! The Great Marshall looked at this and nodded his head as even with his sealed path...
|To me.|
He called out calmly as all remaining Golden Titans lined up around him in different positions.
Around them, scorching golden heat began to spread as a massive illusory Golden Titan began to form around all of them!
The complexity radiating from it was utterly stifling as two golden singularities bloomed for its eyes that coldly stared towards Ozymandias.
|We can clearly see that this creature poses a high likelihood of truly being the Resurgence of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian.|
WAA!

|Do not hold anything back as at this moment, we fight for our very lives before it. Sometime soon, A Source should arrive to aid us in breaking this domain of this Megalonian, and his fate will be sealed completely.|
|So fight! Fight! FIGHT!|
BOOM!

The forming Golden Titan shot out as a Stanchion of trillions of suns was grasped in its hand, throwing it towards Ozymandias like a celestial spear as truly terrifying details came from its words and actions.
One thing was paramount.
They had to give it all they had as sometime soon, this domain nobody could leave would be broken through by a Source!
What was a Source?
Some Palaces of the Expanse held such beings if they had truly deep histories, and making even a single one move was unfathomably difficult.
There were weavings of rumors that those at the level of Source Complexity were bound by rules others did not even know- rules instituted by the Watchers of the Wheelomachy!
Weavings of rumors.
Nothing substantiated.

And certainly, nothing that Pioneers could speak about as there had been too few instances in history where a Source Complexity entity interfered in anything, and even if they did, their power was so high that others might not be capable of recognizing their interference!

Nobody here knew that not too long ago, there had actually been an interference by Source Complexity entities from the Logos of the Wheel- and their interference was actually what kicked off a set of events that led exactly where they were now...

chapters.title: Chapter 3465 A Clean Sweep! III
paragraphs: The precipice of the battle.
Everybody knew they had arrived at such a place as they could feel how fickle their lives could be.
Many came here because their Palaces of the Expanse sent them to confirm and obtain the possible weavings of the Megalonians.
They weren't able to obtain a definitive confirmation, but everything they saw so far pointed to a single conclusion.
And now, with the very real threat of death towards entities such as them, their paths kindled brightly as they gave it everything they had.

In the periphery of the Relegation Zone of Existence, there were also the Existence Severing entities who came, and yet they had been shockingly ignored this entire battle as only the Pioneers had joined in!
Every single one of them turned against the Instrument of the Beyonder who even at this moment radiated the aura of Severing.
But...
|That is not existence severing...!|

A group of humanoid Existence Severing entities adorned in white robes had ashen expressions as they watched their remaining Pioneers surge toward Ozymandias. The more they looked at this being who was pulling on a bowstring and releasing bursts of heavy complexity, the more they confirmed again and again that he seemed to be in an entirely different League!
He had shown at the very least twenty Severed weavings of Existence. Did this mean that he held a power equivalent to twenty Existence Severing entities in his body?
No!
Even this felt wrong as at this moment, even though his aura felt like Existence Severing, even though it looked and smelled like Existence Severing, they were convinced that it was not!
These Existence Severing entities who became wallflowers in the background felt the same stifling sensation from Ozymandias as the renowned Pioneers they knew.
And this sensation was continuing to rise in an even more obscene manner. His complexity continued to climb!
This could not be allowed to continue!
The Existence Severing Palace Masters knew this, and the Pioneers knew this even more.
So the last assault began.

Pioneered Paths flourished. In the middle of all this, Ozymandias held a dazzling white bow filled with the coursing aura of Genesis, his hands moving nonstop as he pulled on the bowstring and released arrows filled with the Severed Weavings of Chronos!
At this moment, time felt like it slowed.
Around him, rivers of blood of Pioneers poured in large numbers as finally, all those 20+ Pioneers who were sealed and sent towards the edges of the Relegation Zone of Existence perished.
All of their collapsed weavings and blood flowed into him with the estimate of a single Pioneer giving approximately more than 25+ Globules of Blood.
It meant a gain of more than 500 Globules of Blood of Pioneers.
In the slowed time, as Pioneers surged all around him to fight their very lives, Ozymandias paused to wonder how he got here.
How a young man from a blue planet was standing in a place known as the Expanse while entities that had lived for billions of years before him...were dying due to his means.
Pioneers.
He closed his eyes as he felt all of his Ordinances that were unsealed.
He felt the beat of his heart. He felt his Invictus Wings. He felt...his weavings.
His weavings! What made him who he was. What allowed him to do what he was doing now with no regrets or worries on what the consequence could be in the future.
He felt it all...as it turned unfathomably bright at this moment.
|All your Ordinances of Existence have undergone at least a Single Severing.|
|Your Weavings seek complete Severing of all Aspects.|
He went about things differently.
With the Blood of Pioneers, he was able to sever aspects of himself, and he had now severed nearly all of them to arrive here.
Nearly all of them.
|Invictus Maximus is undergoing its first Severing.|
|The Amarantos Dream of the Megalos Rune of Existence is undergoing its first Severing, seeking to break from the source of the one who forged it and become your own.|
|The Sacred Primal Eye of Existence is undergoing its first Severing.|
|Your connection with the Infiniverse Megalos Seed is undergoing its first Severing.|
All of the minute, small aspects of himself each achieved their own Severing as after a sufficient amount did so...
|A critical percentage of your weavings of existence have all undergone Severing. It is sufficient enough to consider and distinguish your entire being as a Severed Complexity of Existence.|
|You are constructing and embarking on a new path towards the peaks of the Constellation Complexity.|
WAA!
In his unique state of profundity, he felt all his weavings cut off from...something as he felt a profound sense of joy and loss at the same time.
He felt as light as a feather.
He felt like he could do many more complex things with much greater ease and fewer requirements of authority.

But the sense of loss was also tremendous as he felt like he had entirely and completely cut himself off from something he was always a part of. The overall existence. The overall weavings of existence!
They were bright and had a very clear path, but they came with their own regulations and flow.
All beings had to follow this flow.

But once one severed themselves, they broke apart from this flow and attained a powerful state where they could impose their own flow- their own regulations to achieve terrifying effects of their surrounding weavings of Existence!
Normally.
Usually.
For the vast majority of entities.
When they underwent Severing, they had first Amalgamated with their concept to make it part of themselves fully, and even after severing, there was still a sense of attachment with nature.
With Existence. After all, they were fully one with a concept that stemmed from nature.
No Amalgamation was done by Noah Osmont.
No Amalgamation was done by Ozymandias.
And then, his weavings had gone even further to singularly and completely sever many, many small aspects of himself from Existence.
By the time all of him was Severed...
SAAA!
An unfathomable phenomenon occurred as all noise faded.
The scene of Pioneers and all other entities faded!

chapters.title: Chapter 3466 A Clean Sweep! IV
paragraphs: When he opened his eyes again, all he saw...was darkness.
Not the Expanse. Not the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse, nor the Pioneers or the few hundred Palace Masters surrounding him!
He had truly, utterly, and completely Severed himself from Existence in a manner that no other being had done before!
Complete Severing.
True Severing!
The darkness all around him felt extremely stifling as he found that he could barely move around. He could also barely see or even spread his senses out too far as everything felt far, far too heavy!

As if his complexity was extremely small for having arrived at this place. For him to truly be able to move around with ease and understanding, his complexity had to be raised multiple times over from where he was right now. He looked around him as he could only sense himself, but a small part of him felt an inkling. A sensation that there was something else around him.
He focused on this sensation as very quickly, he recognized it to be something he knew.
The weavings of existence that he had known this whole time, he was just simply and truly disconnected from them at this moment.

To exist within their landscape and their regulations would require him to be familiar with them, understand them, and then analyze just to what extent he could now exert his control over these weavings of Existence!
Ever so slowly, the complete darkness all around him began to light up with brilliance as he returned towards the weavings of existence, but he was not the same being he was before!
Within the Expanse.
Dozens of Pioneers were seriously putting their lives on the line at this moment as they unleashed their glorious paths unto Ozymandias.
They saw his distinct figure that grasped the luminously white bow and continued to shoot out blazing arrows that disappeared the moment they were shot and emerged right before their bodies!
Their terrifying paths were about to arrive on him in the next moment when...
WAP!
He faded away.
He faded out of existence as if he were never there to begin with!

Their eyes became stern as they were shocked to find that the oppressive domain that hung around all of them also disappeared. The massive fused form of the Golden Titans became unfathomably bright as from its very center, the Great Marshall roared out as his power fully returned!
|Where is he?!|
He rode out maddeningly as their auras all spread out, and yet they couldn't find a single shred of evidence that Ozymandias was here.
|WHERE. IS. HE?!|
HUUM!
The full power of a Pioneer erupted out.
With nothing to seal or hamper it, it was akin to a blazing, scorching sun that radiated its might all around- even causing the outer ring of the Blancverse in the distance to fluctuate!
The Great Marshall of the Golden Titans here was so powerful that in his enraged state, even other Pioneers nearby felt stifled and turned somber.
But even as they all looked around, they truly couldn't find a single trace of Ozymandias.
At such a time.
"What are you talking about?"
A voice echoed out.
A voice filled with ancientness and power, and a profound sense of dignity that could not be imitated so freely!
And yet at the same time, it felt familiar.
It did not seem to be filled with authority, but they recognized this voice to be Ozymandias!
They couldn't trace its origin as in the next moment, it echoed out again.
"I have been right here this whole time."
Light flickered.
Exactly where Ozymandias was before, he reappeared once more.
And yet his aura could not be felt. Even though he was speaking to them, they couldn't be certain that his voice truly stemmed from where he was!
A certain sense of errieness spread as even when their powerful complexities gazed at him, they couldn't sense anything regarding his.
What his level of power was.
Nothing was given off!

His stellar obsidian form and the obsidian gold wings behind him seemed to all have a certain sense of calmness and immovability as his mere appearance caused a heavy silence to descend in the surroundings!

The massive fused form of the Golden Titans looked towards Ozymandias with emboldened rage, this massive entity grasping an even more sizable Stanchion of scorching complexity that it threw forward at this moment!
It was the power of a full fledged Pioneer fused with other Pioneers as the Relegation Zone of Existence was not yet reinstated.
It crossed the vast distance of a quarter of an Omniverse to appear right before the visage of Ozymandias!
By the time it occurred, many eyes finally realized what had happened, and they became regretful soon after.

Because of the eeriness of the whole situation, the Great Marshall had moved due to his rage as currently, such a horrific attack of multiple Pioneers in a fused formation smashed onto Ozymandias. They did not expect even a shred of him to survive. How regretful was this?
This was an entity who very likely had the resurgent weavings of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian!
As many weavings moved with complex emotions, the heavy and scorching Stanchion that could burn away an Omniverse into ash with a millisecond arrived before Ozymandias as...
PAH!
His hand arose as a single finger of his moved forward to stop it.
A single finger.

Even his own eyes seemed to be blinking in confusion before readjusting as one could see a thin veil between his finger and the massive Stanchion, as if they were on different planes of existence entirely!
On a different complexity!

Much of the complexity and damage of the Stanchion was mitigated by the single complexity on the tip of the finger of Ozymandias, and he flicked this finger towards the pillar of scorching brilliance as an instant later, it flew back at nearly five times the speed as it came with.
Towards the one who had thrown it.
And there...utter horror unfolded!

chapters.title: Chapter 3467 My Weavings Are My Own! I
paragraphs: The scene was one that those who managed to survive here today would never forget for the rest of their existence.
A terrifying Stanchion of scorching complexity was thrown towards the Instrument of the Beyonder as in retaliation, this entity actually raised his hand and used a single finger to stop it!
A single finger!
Nobody knew or understood the mechanics of how he did it, but they only observed the flick of the finger thereafter. It was simple, but it was also unfathomably heavy.
It shot out the stanchion of light many times faster than when it came, this stanchion arriving at the chest of the massive formation made of multiple Golden Titans as the moment it struck...
BOOM!

Brilliant sparks flew as the massive illusory visage of the Golden Titan illuminated cracks instantly, its complexity shattering as the widening eyes of the Great Marshall were seen at the very center.

The Stanchion arrived right before the Great Marshall, its front end pillar smashing into him and disintegrating his chest instantly- creating a sizable hole as the Stanchion then continued piercing through and disappearing like a flash of golden brilliance in the distance!
The Great Marshall stared down at the massive hole in his chest, his complexity there facing disintegration as the force was so heavy that...
CRACK!
Cracks began to spread across his body, his path being so unfathomably shaken that it was no longer capable of holding itself.
At this moment in time, his gaze was that of astonishment and incredulity as he looked towards Ozymandias.

Around him, the other Golden Titans had ashen expressions as they spat out blood, their faces drained of color as they looked towards the Great Marshall they all admired...his complex weavings seemingly disintegrating from the reflected attack they had sent out!
A Pioneer.
Not a Sealed one, not one who could only express weavings of an Existence Severing entity...but a full-fledged Pioneer.

At this moment, such a creature had their weaving collapsing from a reflected attack born from multiple other Pioneers and the Great Marshall himself...an attack that was reflected back with a flick of a finger!
A horrid silence settled in the surroundings.

Utterly horrid as nobody wanted to be the one to break this silence. In the distance, the figure of the great mother had her tentacles trembling jovially and with uttered disbelief as she looked towards Ozymandias.

In her mind, words of fanaticism and wonder replayed again and again, the figure of the Instrument of the Beyonder etched on her soul as his actions just now were put on full display to the Pantheon of Umbra in the Megalos Beyond!
Within the Blancverse, the always calm figure of the Immovable Sacred Guard was filled with solemnity as his eyes showed great shock.
He was a Pioneer, and he understood his complexity very well. Compared to the Great Marshall, who was currently collapsing, his own complexity could be considered slightly less!
And yet...
And yet...!
The appalling silence was deafening, as it seemed like it could be heard the equivalent length of tens of Omniverses.
This whole time, the Instrument of the Beyonder himself who had done such a shocking action was looking at his hands as if he himself was just now understanding exactly what he had just done!
Megalos Ynnere.
Omniverse X-999, Secondary Infiniverse Megalos Seed.

In this area that was filled with dazzling multicolored brilliance, there were the briefest flashes of darkness and light. The body of Ozymandias had disappeared and reappeared right after as when it did, the very weavings of the nearby Secondary Infiniverse Megalos Seed began to shake!
His weavings were fully severed.
Truly Severed.
So was his connection to the Infiniverse Megalos Seed.
And what, pray tell, was the Infiniverse Megalos Seed made of at its core? The very same weavings he had Severed from Existence!
HUUUM!
The Infiniverse Megalos Seed began to tremble as the tens of thousands of Runes of Existence all around began to swirl.
The multicolored sea seethed and expanded as it seemed to flash in and out of existence alongside the Secondary Infiniverse Megalos Seed itself, its body expanding in breadth and complexity rapidly!

Ozymandias arrived above this sea as it resonated with his weavings, feeling the unshakable connection between him and this Secondary Infiniverse Megalos Seed as alongside it, through the sea...he now very clearly and distinctly began to feel his connection with the main Infiniverse Megalos Seed.
After truly severing this connection from Existence, it crossed and defied all set norms of Existence as he felt it clearly at this moment!
This Frequency had its weavings of existence.
Hell Terra Firma...also held its own scope of existence as it seemed far more unique and complex when compared to any other Frequencies.
But, it was still a frequency.
It still held weavings of existence.
And he was cut off from all of this now as the inviolable workings of Hell Terra Firma...how could he not bend them, even if just a little?!
Ozymandias stood above the multicolored sea- the Frequency Gateway, as he opened his mouth.
"My weavings of existence are my own."
WAA!
His words felt like a silent, ancient bellow of existence. It felt old, archaic, and filled with complexity!
"My body, origin, and soul are my own!"
"How could I ever be separated from myself?!"
BOOM!
The Frequency Gateway churned.

Its multicolored brilliance seethed as if one delved into it; they would cross waves of complexity for an indeterminate length of time, and by the time they got across it, they would come to find the neon anterior of another sea!
They would come within Hell Terra Firma.
Since a new entrant came in through the Frequency Gateway, time had distorted as nearly a day had passed here.
At this moment, inside of a white villa.
"I need a one week break!"

The visage of a dark-skinned Barbatos lay sprawled on a bed, her dazzling figure covered by white sheets as she heaved with a face full of defiance while glaring towards Noah, who was currently chugging a bottle of water.
He was about to reply as a smile hung on his lips when...
BZZT!
His body buzzed as if he had jolts of electricity coursing through him!
Change in chap titles!

His words felt like a silent, ancient bellow of existence.
It felt old, archaic, and filled with complexity!
"My body, origin, and soul are my own!"
"How could I ever be separated from myself?!"
BOOM!
The Frequency Gateway churned.

Its multicolored brilliance seethed as if one delved into it; they would cross waves of complexity for an indeterminate length of time, and by the time they got across it, they would come to find the neon anterior of another sea!
They would come within Hell Terra Firma.
Since a new entrant came in through the Frequency Gateway, time had distorted as nearly a day had passed here.
At this moment, inside of a white villa.
"I need a one week break!"

The visage of a dark-skinned Barbatos lay sprawled on a bed, her dazzling figure covered by white sheets as she heaved with a face full of defiance while glaring towards Noah, who was currently chugging a bottle of water.
He was about to reply as a smile hung on his lips when...
BZZT!
His body buzzed as if he had jolts of electricity coursing through him!
Change in chap titles!

chapters.title: Chapter 3468 My Weavings Are My Own! II
paragraphs: Jolts of electricity.
They were silent, but they were there!
He felt....
"Ozymandias..."
He felt himself. He felt the other half of his existence as a flood of memories came rushing in!
Everything that had occurred on the other side. Everything that had just occurred recently.
The Severing of his many aspects of Existence until he attained...True Severing!
True Severing allowed him to be on his own terms of existence as he recalled that dark place Ozymandias had appeared in the moment it occurred.
It was a stifling place that felt like he needed a tremendously high level of complexity just to move around it, but it represented a new flow of existence for him to understand!
Hell Terra Firma...held its own flow as even now, after truly severing himself from Existence, he still could not break its workings.
He could not outwardly radiate any weavings of power as he wasn't able to conjure fireballs or summon undead.
But within his body...he began to feel the wakings of brilliance.
The wakings of severed weavings of existence that were always with him!
Most profoundly of all, the one concept that had been severed 37 times now....Cheats.
He felt it.
He felt the severed weavings of Mana, of Quintessence, and of the Protagonist!

He felt all of them as the jolts of electricity that were always with him...but he just could not express them in Hell Terra Firma. That was how terrifyingly complex this place was that even after truly severing his weavings of existence, the alteration of the existence of Hell Terra Firma was still almost impossible!
Almost.
New waves of information continued to flow in his mind.
Alongside this flood of information was...a sensation.
Something that Noah could not exactly put his finger on as this sensation made him want to try something!
He raised his hands and stared at his palm, but nothing occurred.

There wasn't an explosion of authority or anything like that, but he still felt something as he reached out and adorned his robe, leaving the room within the villa and going towards the Infiniverse Megalos Seed!
"I'll be back soon."
He left behind a tired Barbatos who waved her hands without even looking up.

A minute later, Noah saw the shocked figures of Ruination and The Infiniverse Megalos Body join him, their eyes holding tremendous brilliance as Noah only nodded towards them while they went into the Infiniverse Megalos Seed!
The Infiniverse Megalos Seed that seemed to be contracting and expanding rapidly at this moment, as if shackles were unleashed and let loose.

It was transferred onto a protected hangar that was called the first Quintessential Base of Existence, and it had been placed in an empty clearing due to its increasing size as Noah had the Autonomous Quintessential Androids build a wide empty protective base around it!
Neon metallic floors stretched out for hundreds of miles all around it as if one wanted to walk towards it, it would take days.

But Noah, Ruination, and the Infiniverse Megalos Seed had simply boarded an Advanced Aerial Drone that rose into the skies and shot out with a blinding hum of blue light to very quickly arrive near the Infiniverse Megalos Seed.
It was rapidly expanding and taking on more space as its insides glittered with brilliance, the Extremity Vein seemingly coming to life as the sea within churned.
Its size had grown so much that it now reached 500 miles, and it still continued to expand as if it wanted to take back its old stature!
Noah looked towards the Infiniverse Megalos Body as her eyes were shining brilliantly while the Drone passed through the wide gaps and entered.
"The Infiniverse Megalos Seed...I can feel nearly every part of it as its previously unusable features are slowly coming back to life, Master!"
Her voice felt ecstatic.
And how could it not be when, at this moment, there was a possibility of them being capable of doing something nobody had done before?

The vessel they were in passed into the interior of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed as Noah looked up to see the discs that used to be Aletheian Havens, their weavings now looking fuller as they seemed like they wanted to return back to their actual size!
His family was within these dazzling rings surrounding the Extremity Vein.
And soon enough, he would be able to bring them out!
He looked towards the Infiniverse Megalos Body for affirmation as she nodded.

"Yes, Master. I can sense the life forms within the Infiniverse Megalos Seed smoothly, and with the gradual return of its workings, I should be able to pull in and out all miniaturized beings. As if they are passing through a gateway to enter Hell Terra Firma themselves."
It would occur soon!
Noah nodded at this as he arrived above what used to be a pond days ago, but was now a sea expanding to 100 miles.
Its waters bubbled with brilliance and wonder as the Advanced Aerial Drone opened its doors, Noah looking down into this vibrant sea as...he felt that inkling again!
That sensation!
Across this sea, past its unknown depths, he could sense the Secondary Infiniverse Megalos Seed and Ozymandias.
He could sense himself as even while locked away with an untold distance, the sensation he had told him...that nothing should be able to stop his weavings from rejoining!
After all, they were truly and completely severed.
His weavings were his own. His existence was his own!
He remembered the words his other half had said not too long ago.
With his hair whipping about madly, he spoke out with a voice that seemed to be filled with archaic grandeur.
"My body, origin, and soul are my own!"
WAA!
The jolts of electricity within him became even more intense.
That sensation he felt...became even more potent!
He stood on the edge of the vessel he was on as he stared at the dazzling sea below and bellowed out.
"How...could I ever be separated from myself?!"
And without any hesitation, he dove towards the dazzling sea.
Towards the Frequency Gateway in Hell Terra Firma...that led towards another Frequency entirely!
He wanted to do something that nobody else had been able to do in history!

chapters.title: Chapter 3469 A Change! I
paragraphs: Noah knew that he had arrived at a critical point in time the moment that he plunged into the multicolored sea.

His eyes only saw brilliance as an instant later, he found himself drawn further into the depths of the sea at a rapid rate. As this occurred, his surroundings began to crackle with an astounding amount of complexity as after his rapid descent, he began to slow down. This slowness continued until the point that he came to a complete stop and could not go any further down. As if it was not possible for such a thing to occur. Around him within the weavings of the multicolored sea, he saw tendrils of grey brilliance coursing through it and forming a sort of a channel.

Through this channel, things thrown from the Secondary Infiniverse Megalos Seed within Omniverse X-999 could flow in smoothly, but something sent in the other direction- especially something with as much complexity as Noah... was impossible.
Before.
Before he had completely and truly Severed his weavings of existence!
OOOH!
He bellowed out with unfathomable majesty at the point he was stopped at in this channel.
He seemed to be in between Frequencies- one being Hell Terra Firma and the other being his home frequency.
And there was a barrier he could not cross.
But because it was in between...
BOOM!
His body flickered out of existence entirely as he found himself in the unique obsidian space.

That space of darkness where his complexity felt so immensely minuscule that it could barely move- he found himself here as in that space, he proceeded to burn his weavings of complexity to take a single step forward.
A single step.
It was a miserable step to take as it felt like his very weavings were creaking and it was unfathomably hard to even raise a single foot!
And yet he took the single step.
He took it as thereafter, he focused on the sensation of existence where he was just at, and his figure found the multicolored radiance returning again as this time...
He had moved past that point where his body was stopped in place.
A single step.
But it was far too critical!
BOOOM!
The channel that he was in trembled and seethed as more and more tendrils of grey authority from Hell Terra Firma filled this place!
After he passed that point where he could not move forward from, his body still felt a sense of resistance, but he could proceed forward on his own as his complexity was waking up rapidly.
He felt Mana coursing through him. He felt Quintessence and Infinity!
He felt Cheats.

Cheats burned with ambition as its Quintessential League of Existence was deployed, the unfathomably heavy tendrils of resistance in the surroundings being shaken off even more work as Noah began to charge through this channel.
Within Noah's home Frequency.
In the Expanse.

At the Point of Origin where a number of Strings of Existence had been snapping one after another, the eyes of Bob and multiple other Watchers of the Wheelomachy suddenly turned unfathomably bright as they gazed up to see....
CRACK!
The splintering of the weavings of existence themselves where there wasn't even a single String of Existence!
Splintering!
Space itself seemed as if it were shattering and breaking apart akin to a broken mirror, and from the cracks of this mirror, terrifying tendrils of gray brilliance instantly spread out.

These tendrils of gray brilliance instantly caused the Atmospheric Weavings of Existence to tumble and deplete at a rapid rate, and the cracking Expanse only continued to get bigger and bigger as the fractures of the mirror-like space extended out for a distance of multiple Omniverses.

Bob and the other Watchers saw this scene as their gazes rapidly changed, recognizing this terrifying grey authority. "Hell Terra Firma! Hell Terra Firma! Its weavings are leaking from this point of Origin!"
Persephael shouted out while the Great Sage looked extremely somber, his gaze going towards Bob as he spoke out gravely.

"We have to make the choice right now- whether we isolate this incidence into this Frequency of Existence, or we do nothing and allow it to possibly extend to all other Frequencies. It is not too late."
The lives of countless many, and the lives of countless few.
Since they could do nothing to stop it, at most they could isolate it and ensure that the damage would not be too extensive. That the Wheel of Existence would not be severely affected!
This was their job as the Watchers!
Bob's eyes showed a flash of hesitation as he waved his hands and pulled out the manifestation of a tree. This tree was unique as it was made up of threads, of strings.
These strings were entwined with each other as they formed a massive trunk and extended outwards to form innumerable branches that attached to a round wheel.
This tree seemed to be sending its branches upwards and downwards, with the main trunk holding most of the dazzling strings- of the dazzling Spokes!

At this moment towards the center of the trunk, there was a particular String that had been shining with a golden radiance, but this golden radiance seemed to be rapidly dimming as a grey point of light bloomed at its very center.
It was a change.

This singular string that was affected was intricately connected to other strings all around it. If it was affected by this change, it was very likely that in time, the other strings- the other Spokes, the other frequencies would also be affected!
After all, the snapping of a single Spoke could go ahead and affect an entire Wheel.
Bob looked at this representation calmly as he replied.

"You are not just talking about the isolation of Frequency. You are talking about Megalocide- the erasure, closure, and decimation of all the Megalos and all their forms within this Frequency of Existence- as that is the only way to isolate and close down a Frequency."
Magalocide!

chapters.title: Chapter 3470 A Change! II
paragraphs: There was genocide- the act of horror of decimating and wiping out an entire group of people.
And then there was Megalocide.
The action of wiping out entire Megalos.

Very few had the power to do such a thing. Very few could even comprehend, or think about such a complex issue. The Watchers were entities that fit such a description due to their complexity and power!
At this moment, a heavy silence settled as they watched the Expanse crackling all around them, and the Great Sage sighed.

He raised his hand as weavings of Anti-Matter bloomed on his palm, and he felt the levels of Atmospheric Weavings of Existence in the surroundings. They continued to get less and less, as it was very easy to imagine what sort of problems could arise from such a phenomenon in the future. And the Great Sage closed his eyes as he mumbled something only he should have been able to hear.
"Is this it? Were we truly powerless to stop it?"
Was this it?

He asked such a question because the Watchers had long known that something was coming. A Change. And they just did not know what the change could be. In recorded history, there had been many events that they looked at as the potential sources of the change, but they never led to anything. This one though...they seemed powerless to stop it if it was truly the one.
The Erasure of entire Megalos was not something that he could do alone in a short period of time.
He needed the others to agree, as there were many who backed Bob. If he was not convinced of Megalocide, many would not be.
And what it meant...was that they would not be able to do anything at this moment but continue to Watch.
Was this the right choice? Was it truly the proper path and stand to take in the face of this unfolding phenomenon that none of them could say, with certainty, what it truly stood for?
There was no answer as the mirror-like fractures continued to spread across the expanse.
A distance away.
The eerie silence of the battle near the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse was broken by the sounds of space shattering.

Many turned around to witness Strings of Existence snapping rapidly around them as it was followed by the Expanse itself having cracks spread out- and then tendrils of gray energy blooming from these cracks!
Instantly, all of them felt the rapid drop in the levels of Atmospheric Weavings of Existence.
What others needed to replenish, communicate with, and resonate to ensure a smooth flow of existence.
The very same weavings that were distorted whenever an Existence Severing powerhouse or a Pioneer made a move to alter the surrounding existence.
Because there was an abundance of weavings of existence, they were able to effect great change and unleash stupendous capabilities.
But if these very Atmospheric Weavings of Existence began thinning out, just what would happen? Nobody knew as at this moment, the figure of Ozymandias raised his head and looked at this phenomenon.
The cracks.
The tendrils of gray energy.
They were familiar!

None of this was coincidental, where somehow the moment that his other half was seeking to leave Hell Terra Firma, the phenomenon of the Unraveling of Existence became even worse. He knew it was connected to him.
He knew that if his other half made the sacrifice and chose to remain in Hell Terra Firma, this unraveling may be stopped, slowed, or gone entirely!
And so, a choice came.

Should he proceed with the path that he was on where he would be able to return to his home, and be able to bring his family from a barren place where their lives were capped, and would likely perish within a hundred or a few hundred years?
Or should he turn back. Forget about Noah Osmont.
Live his life in Hell Terra Firma and die in time.
Maybe over time, be able to see his family as they were taken out of the Miniaturized Havens.
Maybe.
He closed his eyes as he felt the profound changes all around him.
As he felt his own weavings of existence.
DUM!
He felt the beat of his heart.
His mind buzzed as the memories of Adelaide, Henry, and his Mother arose.
His mind buzzed as he thought about his own future.
And...he already knew the answer. His mind had never wavered.
Not once!
HUUM!
His eyes opened with ferocity and valor as he bellowed out.
"Come!"
Whatever may come.
Let it come.

His roar was guttural as far from here, the figure of Noah that was crossing a certain channel...proceeded ahead with even more tremendous speed as his complexity was fully waking up the further across he went!
And after a second...his body burning with complexity saw the surface of a churning sea ahead.
And...
POP!
The glorious visage of Noah Osmont appeared above a multicolored sea.
It was a moment that would be unforgettable in his Weavings of Existence and the Weavings of Existence of many other entities.
The moment he arrived above the sea, a dazzling cylindrical channel followed his path and solidified itself!
It looked like a wormhole beginning to form as the very center of the Frequency Gateway was constructing an extremely solid pathway for the traversal of one side to another.
But the more this pathway solidified...
BOOM!
It eventually led to an eruption of an unfathomably heavy and complex blast of light.
A blast of gray brilliance that propagated from this place, from Omniverse X-999... and spread out all around.
Across the Omniverses of Megalos Ynnere.
Across complex weavings of existence towards the Megalos Beyond. Across into the Megalos Nihilos!
The complex blast of gray radiance truly spread out from one point and covered all the Megalos!
A choice was made.
And a man brimming with complexity looked around as he felt the boundless waves of mana seething within him.
As he felt the severed Weavings of Existence as well as the unique resonance of the surrounding existence in response to him.
He was the first man to cross Hell Terra Firma and back.
It was Noah Osmont!

Instantly, all of them felt the rapid drop in the levels of Atmospheric Weavings of Existence.
What others needed to replenish, communicate with, and resonate to ensure a smooth flow of existence.
The very same weavings that were distorted whenever an Existence Severing powerhouse or a Pioneer made a move to alter the surrounding existence.
Because there was an abundance of weavings of existence, they were able to effect great change and unleash stupendous capabilities.
But if these very Atmospheric Weavings of Existence began thinning out, just what would happen?
Nobody knew as at this moment, the figure of Ozymandias raised his head and looked at this phenomenon.
The cracks.
The tendrils of gray energy.
They were familiar!
None of this was coincidental, where somehow the moment that his other half was seeking to leave Hell Terra Firma, the phenomenon of the Unraveling of Existence became even worse.
He knew it was connected to him.
He knew that if his other half made the sacrifice and chose to remain in Hell Terra Firma, this unraveling may be stopped, slowed, or gone entirely!
And so, a choice came.

Should he proceed with the path that he was on where he would be able to return to his home, and be able to bring his family from a barren place where their lives were capped, and would likely perish within a hundred or a few hundred years?
Or should he turn back.
Forget about Noah Osmont.
Live his life in Hell Terra Firma and die in time.
Maybe over time, be able to see his family as they were taken out of the Miniaturized Havens.
Maybe.
He closed his eyes as he felt the profound changes all around him.
As he felt his own weavings of existence.
DUM!
He felt the beat of his heart.
His mind buzzed as the memories of Adelaide, Henry, and his Mother arose.
His mind buzzed as he thought about his own future.
And...he already knew the answer.
His mind had never wavered.
Not once!
HUUM!
His eyes opened with ferocity and valor as he bellowed out.
"Come!"
Whatever may come.
Let it come.

His roar was guttural as far from here, the figure of Noah that was crossing a certain channel...proceeded ahead with even more tremendous speed as his complexity was fully waking up the further across he went!
And after a second...his body burning with complexity saw the surface of a churning sea ahead.
And...
POP!
The glorious visage of Noah Osmont appeared above a multicolored sea.
It was a moment that would be unforgettable in his Weavings of Existence and the Weavings of Existence of many other entities.
The moment he arrived above the sea, a dazzling cylindrical channel followed his path and solidified itself!
It looked like a wormhole beginning to form as the very center of the Frequency Gateway was constructing an extremely solid pathway for the traversal of one side to another.
But the more this pathway solidified...
BOOM!
It eventually led to an eruption of an unfathomably heavy and complex blast of light.
A blast of gray brilliance that propagated from this place, from Omniverse X-999... and spread out all around.
Across the Omniverses of Megalos Ynnere.
Across complex weavings of existence towards the Megalos Beyond.
Across into the Megalos Nihilos!
The complex blast of gray radiance truly spread out from one point and covered all the Megalos!
A choice was made.
And a man brimming with complexity looked around as he felt the boundless waves of mana seething within him.
As he felt the severed Weavings of Existence as well as the unique resonance of the surrounding existence in response to him.
He was the first man to cross Hell Terra Firma and back.
It was Noah Osmont!

chapters.title: Chapter 3471 The Descent of a Dark Age! I
paragraphs: He felt everything about himself.
His concepts.
His authority.
His connections.
His Atlas!
Even his Atlas was Severed as it glowed with its own fantastical brilliance, the changes brought about due to this being unknown!
The changes.

At this moment Noah looked up to see the gaze of Ozymandias and the Infiniverse Megalos Body that showed elation, but he didn't return this elation. He had to grasp and understand exactly what his choice had led to at this moment as behind him, the Frequency Gateway that looked like a wormhole swirled with multicolored radiance- gray light brightly showing a stable channel.

A stable channel where one could easily pass through from any side. After he crossed through once, the pathway was fully set and stabilized as there was now a direct path established between Hell Terra Firma and another Frequency of the Wheel!
For the first time.
Now, what came from such an action?
A distance equivalent to a few thousand Omniverses away from Omniverse X-999.
Omniverse X-1.
Outerversal Authority was running rampant as hundreds of Morphons fought against thousands of Simians.
At the forefront, the Sword of the Commonwealth gloriously stood above a unique runic structure that seemed to be made of wood- its strokes making the character [SU]!
It was none other than a Piece of a Phantom Trace of the Wheel of Existence!

With it, The Sword of the Commonwealth who was fused with multiple other Simians at Ordinance of Existence and Ordinance Amalgamation level...stood against three Existence Severing Outerversal Morphons.
An entity in the form of a starfish, another who looked like a purple gold jellyfish, and an eel who radiated stellar obsidian grandeur!
And yet...
They all couldn't get past a bunch of Ordinance Amalgamation Simians with the Sword of the Commonwealth in the lead precisely because of the unfathomable power of a single thing.
The treasure that gave The Commonwealth their power.
The Piece of a Phantom Trace of the Wheel! Not much was known about it apart from its closeness to the Wheel of Existence, but with it, the campaign of Outerversal Morphons may actually be halted.
The Outerversal Morphon in the shape of a jellyfish, a Great One known as the Deep Sea Violator, roared out while constantly unleashing inky black flames that formed sharp typhoons forward.
|You will soon fall when you cannot power up that tool! When your weavings cannot sustain it anymore, do you know what we will do to your people?! Do you know?!|
Its gaze was filled with interminable brilliance as its flames that burned with complexity were warded off by a dim gold radiance that stemmed from the Piece of a Phantom Trace of the Wheel!
If only-
BOOM!

At such a time, a blast of gray light passed through this area as it caused every single entity to feel alarm, and in the next moment, the Deep Sea Violator felt the complex and scorching dark flames it was releasing by imposing his existence onto the surroundings...he felt it rapidly weaken and falter as it reduced in complexity and size by at least ten times.
At least!
He was shocked to see this as he wasn't the only one, with even the Simians experiencing this but...
"Haha...!"

The Sword of the Commonwealth laughed raucously as he felt the brilliance of the Piece of a Phantom Trace of the Wheel...remain exactly as powerful while every other weavings of existence seemed to be weakening.

His complexity and the complexity of those fused with him flooded into the Piece of a Phantom Trace of the Wheel as in the next moment, it released a blinding arc of golden light that formed into a complex spinning Wheel- one that speedily went towards the Deep Sea Violator who roared out and manipulated existence with his severed Ordinance, but he barely managed to gather a shred of his normal weavings!
SHIING!

The attack arrived as the Existence Severing Outerversal Morphon instantly had a huge gash spread across its body, its complexity shaking unsteadily and with shock while it looked at the Simians who seemed energized by the tool around them.
The Sword of the Commonwealth looked at this scene with blinding eyes as he roared out.
|Kill them all. Kill them ALL!|
BOOM!
Wonder and heaviness unfolded.
Away from here.
On another Battlefield, the Prisoner stood surrounded by dozens of Golden Titans- his body filled with faint marks of injuries as if it were made from reinforced steel.
And yet he stood undaunted by all of these attacks as the Golden Titans that were fused into a single massive one roared out at this moment.
|We just want our people! Simply give our people back, and all of this is over!|
Their roars were maddening ones filled with rage.
And in the midst of all of this, a shocking blast of gray brilliance flashed past them and caused everything to change.
All of them were alarmed as they gazed around, their weavings erupting out to discern and analyze exactly what had happened.
What they discovered startled them as the illusory form of the massive Golden Titan rapidly shrunk in size, and the few dozen Golden Titans that formed it could now be seen as it dissipated!

The level of Atmospheric Weavings of Existence in the surroundings...had reduced tremendously in that short period of time that the input of weavings they were placing in to form that illusory visage were no longer sufficient to keep it portrayed in the outside weavings of existence.
At the same time.
The eyes of the Prisoner and the Golden Titans all looked towards a certain direction.
There, the blast of gray brilliance had revealed the grandeur of a massive multicolored tree that branched out towards the Omniverses of the Megalos Ynnere.
It was none other than the Tresoverse Primaltree of Existence from the Tresoverse Domain of the Omnifather!
It was now unveiled as from the depths of its massive trunk, the Golden Titans could feel the lineage of their brethren there!

chapters.title: Chapter 3472 The Descent of a Dark Age! II
paragraphs: The Golden Titans held looks of elation as they roared out, feeling their lineage closely!
|Let's go!|
Many changes bloomed.
Of these changes, the vast majority of entities were initially shocked as they studied what had happened, but then continued on with their weavings of existence as they were before.
As if they didn't think what was happening now would be a big deal.
As if like many things before, it would come to be understood and pass.
That it was momentary!
And then, there were those who knew better.
In the Expanse.
At the Point of Origin.
Cracks spread out with even greater abundance as if something critical had been broken, with Strings of Existence continuing to snap by the hundreds as the landscape of the Expanse changed rapidly.
Bob and the other Watchers observed this scene with cold eyes filled with complexity as each one had their own thoughts.
Their Sources were far too complex and advanced as what they saw and what others saw was very different.
They saw the changes taking place that looked irreparable.
Irreversible.
"There are always countless paths. But over the cycles, the paths that make way for chaos and disorder always seem to triumph."
Persephael spoke out with a tired gaze as she looked at everything.
Chaos.
Disorder.
It always spread freely and without fear as when she said this, Persephael looked towards Bob.
He knew a lot regarding Chaos.
After all...

"No path can ever be perfectly predicted. The chaos that blooms is always and has always been part of the Weavings of the Wheel. The Chaos comes, and the Chaos recedes- leaving behind a brighter path thereafter. That is our job. To ensure this bright path even in the midst of all the chaos."
Bob's visage shone lustrously as his bald head radiated majesty.
The Great Sage was silent as Anti-Matter seethed around him, his voice echoing out.
"There is chaos, and there is this. This...is something far past the rungs of chaos."
It was too heavy.
Too widespread!
At this moment, they could feel that it was already on its way to cover this vast Frequency of Existence, and very soon, it would spread to other Frequencies!
"Feeling these changes in the weavings of Existence, this change will be akin to the descent of darkness after eons of brilliance. A descent of an age that many may not survive. A change..."
"A change that we knew was coming, but did not know exactly what it could be. But we knew something was coming, and we now deal with it."
WAA!
Bob cut off the Great Sage as his singularities thought about many things.
The Nine he had warned and prepared from across the Megalos and Expanse of a coming change.
One had disappeared into Hell Terra Firma as the point where he disappeared from became the Point of Origin for the change.
What about the rest? How would they fare?
Weavings buzzed with heaviness and complexity as the space around them continued to shatter like mirrors, tendrils of gray radiance spreading all around as another Watcher chimed in!
"What now?"
What now? Bob blinked at this question before he replied.

"Observe and understand, while I...shall wage a War to understand the Origins of those behind all of this. The Logos of the Wheel has gotten too comfortable. Too much leeway. If they truly saw these weavings of change and jumped to start them, then maybe the Logos of the Wheel should no longer exist after this."
WAA!
Terrifying words bloomed as the other Watchers listened, some sighing and turning away as they had to observe the extent of these changes all around!
In a far, far distance from here, Ozymandias was watching the eruptions of shattered space and the reduction of Atmospheric Weavings of Existence as his gaze was solemn.
The result of his choice was clear, but he would never regret the choice that he made.

The Atmospheric Weavings of Existence were reduced tremendously as in order to cause change and impose one's own weavings on the surrounding existence, there had to be a much larger concentration of authority released.

In simple terms, if it took ten points of mana to cause a flaming fireball the size of a Sun to appear in the surrounding weavings of existence, it may now cost a hundred points of mana to do the same.
The expenditure of authority was going to be that much higher, while the change itself would not be as significant.
For countless entities out there, they would come to find this change to be a heavy shackle around their existence.
But then, there was him.
Did it matter to him whether he had to spend ten points of mana or a thousand points of mana to achieve a single change in the weavings of existence?
With his infinite mana, would he be at all affected in this drastically changing environment while others adapted to a landscape where their very authorities were that much harder to impose?!
The answer was a clear one as he raised his left hand again.
Amidst crackling and shattering space in the background, his weavings were silent as not a shred of the aura leaked out of his body, but his voice was indistinguishably clear.
"Let us finish this."
HUUUM!

In his left hand, a dazzling cerulean bow formed as it brimmed with endless waves of mana. The Pioneers and the Existence Severing experts in the surroundings who were startled and shocked by the sudden changes had their faces become even more solemn as they realized that this being would not leave any stone unturned.
Even at a time like this where something that none of them understood was occuring!

In the brief moment of shock, others who had felt at the disappearance of the weavings of the Instrument of the Beyonder briefly when he truly severed his Weavings of Existence- they had already discreetly left this region and continued running extremely far away.
As for those who did not realize to take this chance and stayed behind...
They may as well leave their Weavings of Existence here as Noah would need a great deal of the Blood of Pioneers in order to achieve complete Severing of his concepts many times over!
