chapters.title: Chapter 3473 The Descent of a Dark Age! III
paragraphs: Within the Expanse.
Ozymandias floated with silent brilliance all around him as his complexity barely gave off any gravitas.
And yet the Pioneers and Existence Severing entities here all felt trepidation as Ozymandias called out.
"Let the Quintessential League of Existence be established once more."
HUUM!

Blue light of shocking immensity surged out of him as to alter the weavings of existence- the requirement being so high that to alter existence at this scope, an Existence Severing entity would have their entire reserves and complexity drained just to establish it!
Just to unleash the Quintessential League of Existence.
And yet it was laid out as this time, even with the greater requirement of input of weavings, it covered a distance equivalent to five Omniverses!
This was the wondrous rise of complexity due to true severing of his weaving, but he knew he needed a whole lot more resources in order to continue elevating his complexity.
Every 27 Severings, he needed 3 Drops of Blood of Pioneers instead of 1. For over a hundred Ordinances...
The number was tremendous as he spoke calmly, making another choice.

"Let us end our current Entanglement. You all came here to know whether I held the Resurgence of the lineage of Megalonians. I will tell you now that I hold what could not be obtained eons ago. The singular Megalonian who chose to dissipate his weavings of Existence instead of being devoured. I have taken the weavings of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian for myself!"
WAA!
"Since you came for precisely this, you all can leave your weavings here forever."
The Golden Titans looked towards him with hatred and burning brilliance as the massive stature of the Great Marshall collapsed entirely- scorched ash falling on the bodies of other Golden Titans.
Other Pioneers had ugly expressions as they just gained affirmation that they came here for, and yet they did not want to stay!
They did not want to stay.
At such a moment.
Ozymandias closed his eyes as he pulled back the bow string.
"Ashes to Ashes."
HUUM!
In the surroundings, the Pioneers began to scramble.
The Existence Severing entities began to rush out!
They all sought to unleash their complexity to protect, and yet they found that it was nearly ten times harder to exact any effect of altering existence compared to before.
The power they could unleash was that much less.
They were furious, and now deeply fearful of losing their complex workings here!
But the Instrument of the Beyonder did not even wait for them.

From the pulled bowstring, it seemed like a sea of complexity was being charged to be released, the aura of a deep and ancient Severing only now being felt as it caused all dozens of Pioneers nearby to roar out!

The sensation they felt from it was utterly horrendous as their paths lit up like never before, spending every ounce of reserves of complexity they held within them as bright Runes of Existence lit up within their bodies.
Methods of operation seethed.
New ways to course weavings across meridians flashed!
And yet...
"Dust to Dust."
Ozymandias let go of the bowstring.
And a gorgeous flourishing of cerulean brilliance unfolded as...one might swear they could hear the cries of birds.
But it wasn't that.
It was the unfolding of petals of cerulean arrows- an endless array of petals of arrows flourished in shocking abundance!

They were utterly beautiful to observe and yet, the Pioneers and Existence Severing entities in the surroundings had ashen expressions as these petals bloomed right before their bodies. A single petal smashed onto the body of an Existence Severing entity as he exploded into a mass of blood and complexity right after. Complexity that was drawn into a singularity that was absorbed by another flashing blue petal as it appeared above the Instrument of the Beyonder to be devoured!
And then multiple petals appeared before a Golden Titan with the weavings of a Pioneer, this entity erupting with golden flaming snakes as his body burned with blood gold tattoos.
And yet when the petals landed...
BOOM!

The complexity of the Pioneer dimmed before they were utterly shredded, with the rest of the petals ravaging the body of this Pioneer as each petal drew over a tenth of its complexity and devoured it entirely.
In a short instant, this Pioneer was gone.
This was one, but such a scene had occurred simultaneously across this wide Expanse for dozens of Pioneers!
Blue arrows of petals flashed in wild abundance and glory.
Alongside it, the Blood of Pioneers was drawn.
What followed were cries of rage, anguish, anger, and helplessness as eventually..there was only a deafening silence that followed!
Within the Megalos Nihilos.

In a space filled with murky white radiance and storms of gray Anti-Matter, a blast of gray radiance had also passed through here as the Atmospheric Weavings of Existence were tremendously falling down.
In a nondescript corner of Nihilos.
A massive Acanthamoeba that looked like an iridescent silver Worm floated grandly while radiating the air of a Pioneer.
Behind it, a sizable white Mountain a few thousand times greater in size could be seen, trillions of life forms felt within that had been protected by this Acanthamoeba for eons!
As this Pioneer observed the changes in the surroundings with shock and grimness.
In the next moment.
RIIIP!
A distance of a tenth of an Omniverse away, space tore apart like paper as unique entities the size of worlds walked out from the ripped space!
Covered by obsidian-gray armaments, some were humanoid, some held animalistic features, and others looked like worms or trees!
And yet the one unique thing...was that these Entities did not have any eyes, ears, nose, or any distinct facial features.
No faces at all!
The only characteristic they shared was a single shining white line that was etched from the bottom to the top of where their faces should be!
Such entities appeared as they looked around at the changes and spoke freely.
|This is far off from the calculations we were told. It is too early, and we aren't as prepared as we were supposed to be.|

sentences.text: Within the Expanse.
Ozymandias floated with silent brilliance all around him as his complexity barely gave off any gravitas.
And yet the Pioneers and Existence Severing entities here all felt trepidation as Ozymandias called out.
"Let the Quintessential League of Existence be established once more."
HUUM!

Blue light of shocking immensity surged out of him as to alter the weavings of existence- the requirement being so high that to alter existence at this scope, an Existence Severing entity would have their entire reserves and complexity drained just to establish it!
Just to unleash the Quintessential League of Existence.
And yet it was laid out as this time, even with the greater requirement of input of weavings, it covered a distance equivalent to five Omniverses!
This was the wondrous rise of complexity due to true severing of his weaving, but he knew he needed a whole lot more resources in order to continue elevating his complexity.
Every 27 Severings, he needed 3 Drops of Blood of Pioneers instead of 1.
For over a hundred Ordinances...
The number was tremendous as he spoke calmly, making another choice.
"Let us end our current Entanglement.
You all came here to know whether I held the Resurgence of the lineage of Megalonians.
I will tell you now that I hold what could not be obtained eons ago.
The singular Megalonian who chose to dissipate his weavings of Existence instead of being devoured.
I have taken the weavings of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian for myself!"
WAA!
"Since you came for precisely this, you all can leave your weavings here forever."
The Golden Titans looked towards him with hatred and burning brilliance as the massive stature of the Great Marshall collapsed entirely- scorched ash falling on the bodies of other Golden Titans.
Other Pioneers had ugly expressions as they just gained affirmation that they came here for, and yet they did not want to stay!
They did not want to stay.
At such a moment.
Ozymandias closed his eyes as he pulled back the bow string.
"Ashes to Ashes."
HUUM!
In the surroundings, the Pioneers began to scramble.
The Existence Severing entities began to rush out!
They all sought to unleash their complexity to protect, and yet they found that it was nearly ten times harder to exact any effect of altering existence compared to before.
The power they could unleash was that much less.
They were furious, and now deeply fearful of losing their complex workings here!
But the Instrument of the Beyonder did not even wait for them.

From the pulled bowstring, it seemed like a sea of complexity was being charged to be released, the aura of a deep and ancient Severing only now being felt as it caused all dozens of Pioneers nearby to roar out!

The sensation they felt from it was utterly horrendous as their paths lit up like never before, spending every ounce of reserves of complexity they held within them as bright Runes of Existence lit up within their bodies.
Methods of operation seethed.
New ways to course weavings across meridians flashed!
And yet...
"Dust to Dust."
Ozymandias let go of the bowstring.
And a gorgeous flourishing of cerulean brilliance unfolded as...one might swear they could hear the cries of birds.
But it wasn't that.
It was the unfolding of petals of cerulean arrows- an endless array of petals of arrows flourished in shocking abundance!
They were utterly beautiful to observe and yet, the Pioneers and Existence Severing entities in the surroundings had ashen expressions as these petals bloomed right before their bodies.
A single petal smashed onto the body of an Existence Severing entity as he exploded into a mass of blood and complexity right after.
Complexity that was drawn into a singularity that was absorbed by another flashing blue petal as it appeared above the Instrument of the Beyonder to be devoured!
And then multiple petals appeared before a Golden Titan with the weavings of a Pioneer, this entity erupting with golden flaming snakes as his body burned with blood gold tattoos.
And yet when the petals landed...
BOOM!

The complexity of the Pioneer dimmed before they were utterly shredded, with the rest of the petals ravaging the body of this Pioneer as each petal drew over a tenth of its complexity and devoured it entirely.
In a short instant, this Pioneer was gone.
This was one, but such a scene had occurred simultaneously across this wide Expanse for dozens of Pioneers!
Blue arrows of petals flashed in wild abundance and glory.
Alongside it, the Blood of Pioneers was drawn.
What followed were cries of rage, anguish, anger, and helplessness as eventually..there was only a deafening silence that followed!
Within the Megalos Nihilos.

In a space filled with murky white radiance and storms of gray Anti-Matter, a blast of gray radiance had also passed through here as the Atmospheric Weavings of Existence were tremendously falling down.
In a nondescript corner of Nihilos.
A massive Acanthamoeba that looked like an iridescent silver Worm floated grandly while radiating the air of a Pioneer.
Behind it, a sizable white Mountain a few thousand times greater in size could be seen, trillions of life forms felt within that had been protected by this Acanthamoeba for eons!
As this Pioneer observed the changes in the surroundings with shock and grimness.
In the next moment.
RIIIP!
A distance of a tenth of an Omniverse away, space tore apart like paper as unique entities the size of worlds walked out from the ripped space!
Covered by obsidian-gray armaments, some were humanoid, some held animalistic features, and others looked like worms or trees!
And yet the one unique thing...was that these Entities did not have any eyes, ears, nose, or any distinct facial features.
No faces at all!
The only characteristic they shared was a single shining white line that was etched from the bottom to the top of where their faces should be!
Such entities appeared as they looked around at the changes and spoke freely.
|This is far off from the calculations we were told.
It is too early, and we aren't as prepared as we were supposed to be.|

chapters.title: Chapter 3474 The Descent of a Dark Age! IV
paragraphs: Early.
Something arriving at a time when it was not anticipated.
It would have required prior knowledge regarding that thing...as well as the timing of when it would actually arrive!
At this moment, unknown entities appeared as one stated that what had occurred was far too early.

In response, a humanoid entity with four hands, carrying the same faceless quality with a vertical white bar shining up where his face used to be, replied. |We adapt to changing circumstances. We follow orders and do what we are told, so let us proceed.|
His visage seemed commanding as after he spoke others quieted down.

The vertical white bars of their Faceless heads shone as they looked around, and after a moment, the white mountain in the far distance was spotted- along with the blazing aura of a Pioneer who stood before it!
|A Viable Cluster of Complexity has been located. Move out.|
The command was a quick one as a moment later, the figures covered in seamless obsidian-gray armaments disappeared.
A distance away.
The visage of the Acanthamoeba was a brilliant one as it studied the changing weavings of existence with caution, its feelers sensing one change after another when suddenly...
BZZT!
It was shocked to find that a party of entities without faces appeared not too far from it!

Its body pulsed with weavings of Anti-Matter as white flames began to swirl in the surroundings, but the newly appearing entities did not bat an eye to this as the Four Armed Faceless creature simply moved forward while radiating an intent.
|Do not resist.|
Do not resist.
A Pioneer was told such a thing as it was furious, the white flames around it beginning to form into concentrated galaxies when suddenly.
Speedily.
Unfathomably!

The Four Armed Faceless creature flashed to appear inches away from the Acanthamoeba, one of its four hands shooting out as on its faceless head...one could now see a brief flash of something wondrous!
It was...a Rune of Existence!
But not just that.
This Rune of Existence carried a heart-shaking allure as, from its brief flash, one could sense the weavings of a Source from it.
A Source Rune of Existence!
It only flashed on its faceless visage briefly as its fist landed on the Acanthamoeba Pioneer.

Thereafter, the most terrifying thing occurred as the weavings of the Acanthamoeba Pioneer seemed to be suppressed and contained as the punch neared, and by the time it landed on the skin of the Acanthamoeba Pioneer...its weavings of a path all but disappeared as the glorious white flames that were just surging nearby were nowhere to be seen.

The feelers of the Acanthamoeba Pioneer trembled as after that, a formidable unknown power seemingly pressed it from all around- a dull boom echoing out from where the fist of the Faceless entity landed on it as an instant later, the consciousness of the Pioneer began to dissipate!
Its complexity...was suppressed and sealed as its massive body soon only floated in the white space without an ounce of authority.
No sign of life. No sign of weavings of complexity.
A Pioneer...was eviscerated by a single punch!
After that, the Four Armed Faceless entity waves its hands to pull out an obsidian cylinder.
|Laying down the Banner.|
A Banner, it was called.
And yet this being took this obsidian cylindrical object and plunged it into the body of the Pioneer- a low hum being released from it as a moment later, it entirely disappeared.
The body of the Pioneers convulsed thereafter before its skin split apart, an illusory image of...a tower rising from it!

This illusory image of a tower seemed to be drinking from the complexity of the Pioneer, this tower emanating a dreadful darkness as one could see a single, radiant vertical band of white running up the obsidian tower.
It rose up rapidly and expanded in size while the massive body of the Acanthamoeba Pioneer shriveled up.

The figure of the Four Armed Faceless creature pulled back to join the others as they watched this scene gloriously, the faceless heads not being able to show any emotions, but one could distinctly feel a fervent sense of complexity on the white beam of light on their faces!

They watched the illusory dark tower grow as after it reached a certain point, it pulsed and released a vibrant domain of obsidian light that spread out all around, going on to cover the white mountain that the Acanthamoeba Pioneer had been guarding this whole time as it stretched out even further.
It stretched out a distance equivalent to five Omniverses before it stopped, and all life forms within this encapsulated domain...began to feel their complexity of existence be slowly drained!
It was an eerie and terrifying chain of actions, and those responsible observed it gloriously while the vertical white bars on the faceless heads began to hum with fervent brilliance!
Away from Megalos Nihilos.
In the Megalos Beyond.
Above a Pantheon.

Faceless entities floated above dominantly as a titanic Faceless Wolf stood above a lifeless figure of a squid shaped Outerversal Morphon that radiated terrifying Megalos Regnum at the level of a Pioneer!
|We are not prepared. This will take even longer now...|

Its voice was thick and heavy as its claws waved down, an obsidian cylindrical pillar shooting out and inserting itself into the lifeless body of the Great One as moments later, a vibrant obsidian tower began to rise while the body of the Outerversal Morphon shriveled!

The other Faceless entities near the Faceless Wolf were silent as they observed the booming domain that erupted from the Tower, the white bands of radiance on their faceless heads shining brightly as if they were bringing forth an advent of something grand.
Away from the Megalos Beyond.
In the Megalos Ynnere.
Omniverse X-1.

The Shield of the Commonwealth breathed heavily as he stood near the Piece of a Phantom Trace of the Wheel, hundreds of other Simians around him as they looked towards defeated Outerversal Morphons that were roaring out maddeningly!
At such a time.

Above them, space tore as Faceless Entities appeared, the visage of a dominating Faceless Nine Tailed Fox wreathed in black flames looking down towards the Piece of a Phantom Trace of the Wheel as its eyes flashed with brilliance!

chapters.title: Chapter 3475 A Piece! I
paragraphs: A Faceless Nine Tailed Fox.
The vertical white band on its head pulsed with heavy brilliance as it locked onto the Piece of a Phantom Trace of the Wheel over anything else.
Behind it, other Faceless entities appeared as the moment they did, the Faceless Nine Tailed Fox made a move!
It flashed and disappeared instantly, its figure reappearing behind the Sword of the Commonwealth and his forces as a single tail out of its nine released hundreds of obsidian hair-like fur.
They acted like silent spears that targeted all entities here- Ordinance Amalgamation and the suppressed Existence Severing Morphons alike!
On the Faceless head of the fox, an obscure rune brimming with a Source pulsed silently as the weavings of those here were not even able to react in time.
They only felt dread.
And a moment later...
|No!|
Sudden cries of shock and fury erupted as, in the next second, there was only silence.
Hundreds of Simians at Ordinance of Existence and even those like the Sword of the Commonwealth at Ordinance Amalgamation....dead.
Existence Severing Outerversal Morphons, dead!
The disparity in complexity was far too large.

An eerie silence hung in the surroundings after this as the Faceless Nine Tailed Fox looked towards the Piece of a Phantom Trace of the Wheel warily, an obsidian pillar rising from it and sinking into the body of the entity that had the highest complexity here.
HUUM!

The massive body of an Outerversal Morphon shriveled as a dark tower rose from it, unique weavings emerging from the Tower as the moment they did, the Faceless Nine Tailed Fox roared out through the vibrant white line across its head, its tails dancing chaotically as a net of obsidian weavings erupted from it to cover the Piece of a Phantom Trace of the Wheel!
WU! WU! WU!

Yet the Piece of a Phantom Trace of the Wheel released a dim glow of radiance that evaded all the lines of the net, along with the terrifying light of the Tower as an instant later, it warped into the folds of space and disappeared!
The Faceless Nine Tailed Fox breathed out heavily with frustration while looking at this as behind it, a Faceless Obsidian Titan appeared as his intent was a laughing one.

|Our power isn't nearly enough to obtain a Piece of a Phantom Trace of the Wheel. The Degree of Rejection is simply too high for our Complexity to overcome. Leave it to the Forelders. Come, this early start of the change has thrown many things haywire, and Forelder Noxus has already given us new orders.|
The Faceless Obsidian Titan stated such words as the Faceless Nine Tailed Fox was still looking at the spot where the Piece of a Phantom Trace of the Wheel had disappeared.
|What are the new orders?|

|To hunt down one of the possible contributors to the Change. Not much is known about the one we are assigned to apart from the fact that they originate from the Megalos Ynnere. But we have been told that when we meet them, we will know.|
WAA! The reply of the Faceless Obsidian Titan was heavy as the Faceless Nine Tailed Fox and others nodded with affirmation.
The Faceless Nine Tailed Fox could not seem to take the Piece of a Phantom Trace of the Wheel out of its mind as it asked while staring at the spot it disappeared to.
|Where do you think it went? Another Frequency entirely, or still here? This is the third one I see up close that disappeared right before me.|
The Faceless Obsidian Titan scratched his head while shaking it ruefully.

|The objects that reject us are the ones you're most interested in? What an odd creature you are. As for that Piece of a Phantom Trace of the Wheel...who knows where it went? You may never see that particular one again.|
WAA!
Dreadfully unique words were left behind as the battlefield where Outerversal Morphons and Simians were fighting...was turned into a land of death.
Silently, the Sword of the Commonwealth perished.
When the light of the dark Tower reached all of Omniverse X-1, what would happen to the Viceroy and all the core members of the Commonwealth here?
Everything was unknown.
Further away within Megalos Ynnere.
Near Omniverse X-999.
A dim glow of gold flashed as space tore, something with fantastic unique weavings emerging from the folds of space as it was but a Piece.
A single Piece!
Omniverse X-999.
The Secondary Infiniverse Megalos Seed.
Noah stood side by side with Ozymandias as he felt the concentration of severed authority, his next steps outlined clearly as he thought of exactly what had to occur.
The resources that he needed were too numerous as the one place to obtain them in abundance was Hell Terra Firma. But without authority, the passage of time there was far too slow.

What was needed was the acceleration of time as he collected pioneers en masse. Revealed the weavings of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian in the Expanse would also draw in even more fodder for him to eat up as-...!
HUUM!
He felt a buzzing all of a sudden.
It was loud, and it seemed to come from a close distance!
It resonated with the Atmospheric Weavings of Existence even here as he- someone who was entirely severed from Existence, felt this buzzing frequency clearly!
His eyes flashed brightly as his figure disappeared, crossing a distance equivalent to more than a single Omniverse as he appeared a distance away from Omniverse X-999.
The buzzing of a frequency was now extremely clear as he appeared near a dim brilliance- his eyes capturing a complex object that was miniaturizing itself at this moment.
He didn't know its initial size, but it became smaller than a world in a few milliseconds, and then the size of a human head after another few milliseconds!
It became something a bit over ten inches in size, and yet its radiance was frightening as it held truly potent complexity.
Noah stared at this object with caution and alarm as he saw it was made with countless strokes, and it made the word...[SU]!

chapters.title: Chapter 3476 A Piece! II
paragraphs: His Sacred Primal Eye of Existence instantly opened while he took a step forward to grab this shocking object.
In one fell swoop, it fell into his hands as he felt like he was holding a piece of a hot stone.
It felt extremely heavy and unfathomably light at the same time!
Grasping it, the terrifying gold eye above him radiated a light of Severing as it peered at the details, his own complexity burning in his hands as he felt subtle changes begin to unfold.
In a moment, the weavings of what he held flowed into his mind as his eyes gradually opened wider and wider.

[A Piece of the Core Trace of the Wheel]:: Over the cycles, the Weavings of the Wheel remain abstruse and indecipherable. Something unforeseen has been the emergence of Traces of the Wheel of Existence. Something that allowed one a deeper look and understanding of the Wheel, but could not be held or obtained unless one had sufficient enough complexity. Some entities who were not able to grasp it could, at most, make Phantom Traces of what they observed. But even this contained tremendous power of the actual Trace. This Piece of a Core Trace of the Wheel has been mistaken to be a Piece of a Phantom Trace of the Wheel by many before as they barely grasped a percentage of its power. Its true usage can only be understood when a heavy enough complexity cycles through it...
A Piece of the Core Trace of the Wheel!
A Tracing. The Wheel of Existence was unfathomable to grasp or understand as a trace was akin to observing the Wheel itself up close!
And this wasn't just a Phantom Trace of the Wheel, but a piece of the Core Trace itself!
Noah looked at it with somber eyes as its touch that felt hot to the touch felt like it was just asking him to pour his complexity into it.
But he didn't do it. Not yet.
His figure looked around this region before he disappeared, reappearing a moment later in the Secondary Infiniverse Megalos Seed.
He held the Piece of the Core Trace of the Wheel in his hands as the moment he returned here with it, the surroundings instantly began to buzz as the thousands of Runes of Existence lit up.

There were Runes stretched out around the multicolored sea and inside of it, and yet they vibrated with resonance at this moment at their light- what they were intended to accomplish...was getting elevated rapidly!
As if there was some catalyst that made them that much more powerful.
Noah grasped the wooden-like object in his hands as, at this point, his body began to light up with waves of mana that began to flow into it.
Since it was something related to the Wheel.
Since it reacted to the language of the Wheel itself!
What could actually be done with it?
HUUM!
The influx of his severed mana caused a dull gold glow to erupt along with a hum, a calm intent of feedback actually being released from the object in his hands and into his mind!
||What action would you like to accomplish?||
Not even a voice.
It was an intent, and it felt foreign and unique! As if it was a different language being translated right before him.
It asked him what he wished to accomplish from the waves of complexity he was placing into the Piece of a Core Trace of the Wheel!
His eyes were bright as he looked around this radiant area, eventually coming to land on the multicolored sea as the one thing that plagued him came to the forefront.
"Time."
WAA!
"I need the smooth alteration of the flow of time between here and Hell Terra Firma. It is already occurring, but I need to control it under my own banner."
He wanted for a day to pass out here, but for hundreds of days to have passed in Hell Terra Firma!
To give himself time to go through Settlements and Conquer those there as he enacted his farms to obtain complexities of others.
This was what he wanted to do.
The Piece of a Core Trace of the Wheel felt his intent and began to buzz, ultimately responding with a glorious intent.

||The proposed action could be accomplished by the utilization of the True Rune of Existence, TEMPUS. Its weavings will be passed on to you. For its construction, more waves of complexity are required.||
A True Rune of Existence!
True.

He looked around at the thousands of runes in the surroundings that he and the Infiniverse Megalos Body had made as did this make them false? The Runes that the alternate Barbatos forged, were these considered false too?
His eyes were luminously bright as the heat of the object in his hand became more intense, musings of a terrifying language flowing into him as he saw...a word!
A single word!
But to simply utter this word out was nearly impossible as one had to have immense reserves of authority- just to speak it.
It could be written down by unique means until one became familiar with the trillions of strokes that made up this single word, and for Noah to construct it right now...
He raised the Piece of a Core Trace of the Wheel in his hands as he allowed his severed mana to flow freely into it.
Without limit.
||Pure Grade A Weavings of Complexity of Existence have been detected.||
||The forging of the True Rune of Existence will hold even higher quality due to the Grade of Purity of the Weavings of Existence.|
Purity.
Many entities stuck on a single path for the sake of purity to the Wheel of Existence.
That it was purity which kept the wheel turning!
So why...was Noah's Mana that could form many things considered of stupendous Purity?
Seas of it surged out.

Seas of severed authority blasted this unique object as moments later, it spun in his hand like a scorching sun as it began to release tendrils of white gold light that formed into strokes to form a word!
A True Rune of Existence!
HUUM!
Everything nearby tumbled and vibrated as Noah saw the rapid formation of a letter that was a mile long, its structure looking ancient and old as it looked like a carved white gold piece of wood.
Trillions of lines and strokes came together to form it as a subsequent letter began to form right after, this process being extremely fast due to the endless waves of Mana Noah was releasing!
In a short period of time, all letters were forged as a single True Rune of Existence bloomed, its weavings reading TEMPUS as this entire word looked like an ancient white gold wooden carving.

And yet the air it radiated was utterly fantastical- all other forged runes nearby, even the last one that Barbatos formed, trembling at its appearance as it released a vortex of white gold light that went on to cover the multicolored sea down below!
||A True Constellation Rune of Existence has been forged for the first time.||
||You have gained the distinction of Scholar of Runes.||

chapters.title: Chapter 3477 Are You Free? I
paragraphs: A True Constellation Rune of Existence!
Noah forged one for the first time through the Piece of a Core Trace of the Wheel by putting in Pure Grade [A] Weavings of Complexity of Existence.
Grandly, the white gold brilliance of the Rune of TEMPUS permeated all around as a storm of temporal complexity seethed around it, covering all of the Secondary Infiniverse Megalos Seed!
It looked like a word made from a piece of ancient wood as Noah felt like he truly grasped what it stood for.
As if he was learning the words of a brand new language for the first time.
He looked at the terrifying temporal storm that was rising due to this single Rune as the Piece of a Core Trace of the Wheel in his hands slowly stopped burning!
The feedback from it stopped as it had achieved the usage based on what Noah communicated with it.
At this moment, the usual prompts stemming from his system of Existence flowed as his eyes grasped every single ounce of change occurring here.

|Complexity stemming from severed weavings of existence have tremendously altered the flow of time that was already innately disorganized between the Frequencies on opposite sides of the Frequency Gateway.|
An alteration of an already existing state of disorder!
Time already moved in slowed or accelerated motions, and the True Rune of Existence forged went on to further alter this distortion of time...towards Noah's favor!

|The altered distortion of time has been established to be a rate of 1:100. Every passing day on this side of the Frequency Gateway is equivalent to 100 days on the other side of the Frequency Gateway.|
WAA!

A clear distinction was made as the TEMPUS True Constellation Rune of Existence hung in the space above the Frequency Gateway, its light spreading even into the established channel as it achieved what Noah and the Infiniverse Megalos Seed were seeking to do this whole time...in an instant.
|It's marvelous...|
The Secondary Infiniverse Megalos Body flickered beside Noah as she looked at the object in his hand that blazed with a silent complexity akin to holding a burning sun.
It was the closest thing they had gotten in relation to the Wheel of Existence!
Noah looked at it thoughtfully as his body split in two, one beginning to float towards the Frequency Gateway while the other stood still.
"A Piece of the Core Trace of the Wheel..."
It was a Piece.
Meaning there were other Pieces.
And with this Piece alone, he was able to forge a True Rune of Existence- one of a Constellation tier at that!
He was sure there was a lot more to understand regarding this unique tool as he grasped it while sending more waves of complexity into it.
"Where are the other Pieces of the Core Trace of the Wheel?"
WAA!
He asked a daring question.
And the tracing within his hands flickered dimly as it sent a feedback that...a tremendous amount of Complexity would be required to even portray anything related to this!

|The Grade [A] of Purity and Complexity of your Weavings of Existence are high enough to cause a slight resonance between the Pieces of the Core Trace of the Wheel, but the moment you do, the Holder of another Piece will also sense that same resonance. If the Piece has no Holder, this is of no consequence.|
A feedback that made him stop from pumping waves of mana into the treasure in his hands bloomed.
He had many things to do currently, and after he was prepared, he could proceed with this.
He turned the object around as he spoke towards the Infiniverse.
"The Grades of Purity and Complexity- the distinction is being made along the descending order of A, B, C, D?"
The ranking of the purity and complexity of existence!
The Infiniverse Megalos Body nodded as her eyes flickered with a flow of information.

|The Runic Language seemed to fall back on more basal and simpler forms of communication. As you continue Severing your Ordinances more, their Purity and Complexity may theoretically be placed into the [S] Grade or [SS] Grade. Or this may be entirely wrong, and the runic language could have another distinction entirely by the time we get there.|
The musings of the Infiniverse Megalos Body flowed as Noah nodded and looked down to see the other body he had just released sink into the Frequency Gateway.
A brilliant gray light flashed as he only felt a slight pull with the body he left behind, but...
HUUM!
His Severed Weavings buzzed as he withstood this pull and remained right where he was!
He could send another part of himself into Hell Terra Firma...without being affected by its pull!
He was able to escape it.
He could enter and leave it freely.
And now, there was only conquest left upon it as it was a sandbox of hidden treasures from Matter, Dark Matter, and Anti-Matter all clustered within waiting for him!
So long as a day passed here, a hundred would have passed on the other side.
The progression and gains that would be made were bound to be heavy.
And then...there was understanding exactly what the extent of the Change that was occurring because of his actions of leaving Hell Terra Firma were.
And for this...he could already sense many things.
As someone who had truly Severed his weavings, he sensed many things differently.
His interactions with the weavings of other people were also severed.
Not in a way where they were cut off, nor something along the lines of him severing the attachments or emotions with other Existences that he interacted with.
Because even these weavings were severed, he could more clearly see the intricacies of his interactions with the weavings of others akin to many strings that rose from him and extended out.
He floated at the center, and there were countless strings shooting out from him like a spider web!
If he so wanted, he could cut these strings. If he so wanted, he could study these strings.

He raised his hands to feel these invisible strings as many led to Hell Terra Firma, and there were those leading towards the Expanse, the Megalos Beyond, other points of the Megalos Ynnere, and even Megalos Nihilos!

chapters.title: Chapter 3478 Are You Free? II
paragraphs: He looked at the string leading to Megalos Nihilos as the image of the Great Usurper flashed in his mind.
This severed string was tout strong as he didn't need to worry about this unique friend of his, but...
He stared at the Strings leading to areas in the Megalos Ynnere that were dimming one after another.
Simians of the Commonwealth he had met before.
The Sword of the Commonwealth.
Ordinance Amalgamation and Ordinance of Existence Entities met in the Tresorverse Sacred Domain of the Omnifather.
One after another, they had dimmed or were dimming as it seemed like something, or someone...was killing off the most powerful entities within the Megalos Ynnere!
But Noah didn't even have to sit around and wonder.
In his Severed state of existence, he could do many things as currently...his intuition told him that he could do and see far more with these strings that represented his causality with others!
There would be a level of difficulty when it came to those with tremendous complexity, or those with higher complexity than him, but if it was anyone else lower or even someone who had perished...
"Show me."
He spoke commandingly towards the string that showed the causality between him and the Sword of the Commonwealth.
Faint.
Barely discernible.
But it was there.
At this moment, this dead string began to light up as musings of the Sword of the Commonwealth began to flow!
What he experienced right before his weavings collapsed...
As Noah did this, the body of Ozymandias close by flickered and disappeared- seas of Outerversal Authority wrapping around his body as he returned to the Megalos Beyond!
In the Expanse.
Near the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse.
Mirror-like cracks could be observed throughout as, at this moment, there was a deafening silence all around.
No roars of Pioneers of Existence or Existence Severing entities could be heard.

Even in the Blancverse of the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse that held the Sacred Guard and his people showed gazes of doubts with numbness in their eyes as the radiant space of the Expanse before them that was filled with terrifying complexities of Existences they had heard names of or been knowledgeable of across different Palaces of the Expanse... had all perished.
Golden Titans- perished!
Outerversal Great Ones- Perished!
Ents- gone!
Any of the myriad lineages of entities that were here had all been eradicated by the magisterial scene they all just witnessed.

A single entity pulled back a bowstring, and from that bowstring came terrifying devastation. A heavy complexity that seemed to surpass any type of Severing they had seen before erupted as it shredded apart other severed weavings of existence and the paths of the Pioneers- and quite literally devoured their complexity where they stood as surrounding the body of the Instrument of the Beyonder...were streams of rivers of crimson gold Globules of blood that all entered into his fold.

Nobody within the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse spoke. What they had just witnessed, paired with the unfathomable changes occurring across the Expanse, made them all send messages to the strongest backers they knew- depicting everything that happened here while seeking to understand the changes around them!
At such a moment.
HUUM!

The area surrounding the Instrument of the Beyonder flickered with a unique brilliance as the shattered mirrors of reality that were spread out all around gathered together- a wall forming on all sides as his visage became enclosed, no longer visible to their eyes even if they sent their weavings forward!
But would anyone even dare to send their weavings forward after what they had just witnessed? Inside of the enclosed weaving of space.

The weavings of the Expanse were brought together in this manner by a terrifying Source, Ozymandias opening his eyes as he swallowed multiple Drops of Blood of Pioneers and directed them to sever different parts of himself.
When his eyes opened, he saw the visage of an entity with a smooth round head without a shred of hair and a humanoid appearance underneath a white robe!
His head seemed to be flashing with a mixture of white, gold, and black radiance at this moment as if his skin couldn't decide what color to take on.
It was someone he had met before with another body.
The one who gave him access to a Blancverse after arriving in the Expanse.
Bob!
He looked towards Ozymandias as he let out a sigh, gazing at the shattered weavings of existence around them as he began to speak!
"I thrive on chaos. I get stronger, and have been getting stronger with every passing eon and increase of chaos. My Path is that of Khaos. A more ancient, older form of disorder."

"Over the years, I've come to find that Chaos is necessary for a long period of Order. That there was never just Order...without a period of Chaos. So I was preparing for the Change that I knew was coming. For periods of chaos and wars as in these past eons, things had been far too peaceful. I found entities that could either be those who contributed to order or chaos and sought to help them. Some in different Frequencies. Others in this Frequency."
As he stated this, his gaze lingered on Ozymandias before he continued.

"I did this because of what I came to understand over the eons. Chaos was necessary for change, yes, but not the unpredictable and utterly disastrous chaos. It had to be controlled chaos. Controlled disorder. Paradoxical, is it not?"
He seemed to want to talk.

Since he wanted to talk, Ozymandias would listen as even though this being was unfathomable, Ozymandias did not fear him. So he continued to listen as in the swirling singularities of Bob's eyes, light flashed as he continued deeply.

"Sometimes...I think of letting go. Let the other parties aside from me do whatever they wish regarding the Wheel of Existence. Let chaos unfold without any control or direction. But every time I think this, I am always pulled back in to intervene. I can't seem to sit still. So I eventually came to ask myself...am I doing that out of my own free will? Am I bound and controlled by the Wheel in a manner I do not know? A slave to existence even though I have severed it long ago? Am I free to choose what I want to do as every time, I choose the same? Am I free? Are you...free?"
HUUUM!

His head seemed to be flashing with a mixture of white, gold, and black radiance at this moment as if his skin couldn't decide what color to take on.
It was someone he had met before with another body.
The one who gave him access to a Blancverse after arriving in the Expanse.
Bob!
He looked towards Ozymandias as he let out a sigh, gazing at the shattered weavings of existence around them as he began to speak!
"I thrive on chaos.
I get stronger, and have been getting stronger with every passing eon and increase of chaos.
My Path is that of Khaos.
A more ancient, older form of disorder."
"Over the years, I've come to find that Chaos is necessary for a long period of Order.
That there was never just Order...without a period of Chaos.
So I was preparing for the Change that I knew was coming.
For periods of chaos and wars as in these past eons, things had been far too peaceful.
I found entities that could either be those who contributed to order or chaos and sought to help them.
Some in different Frequencies.
Others in this Frequency."
As he stated this, his gaze lingered on Ozymandias before he continued.
"I did this because of what I came to understand over the eons.
Chaos was necessary for change, yes, but not the unpredictable and utterly disastrous chaos.
It had to be controlled chaos.
Controlled disorder.
Paradoxical, is it not?"
He seemed to want to talk.
Since he wanted to talk, Ozymandias would listen as even though this being was unfathomable, Ozymandias did not fear him.
So he continued to listen as in the swirling singularities of Bob's eyes, light flashed as he continued deeply.
"Sometimes...I think of letting go.
Let the other parties aside from me do whatever they wish regarding the Wheel of Existence.
Let chaos unfold without any control or direction.
But every time I think this, I am always pulled back in to intervene.
I can't seem to sit still.
So I eventually came to ask myself...am I doing that out of my own free will?
Am I bound and controlled by the Wheel in a manner I do not know?
A slave to existence even though I have severed it long ago?
Am I free to choose what I want to do as every time, I choose the same?
Am I free?
Are you...free?"
HUUUM!

chapters.title: Chapter 3479 Are You Free? III
paragraphs: The question was a simple and yet unfathomably complex one.
Was he free?
The choices that he made. The distortions of causality.
His entrance into the Purgatory Lands and his subsequent exit seemed to be part of a chain of reactions that caused all the things occurring right now. He thought of Vitalis and Vacuous.
He came from a place that could be considered a farm for Fruits of Existence- built upon the labor and weavings of others.
And even those who used to be mysterious entities that lived far above...were crushed under his heel in time.
He thought of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed and Ruination.
He thought of many things in this short span of time as...
Was he free?
"I am free."
WAA!
He replied succinctly.
The choices that he had made were his own. There was nobody whispering in his ear telling him to take this step or that step. There was nobody forcing him to do anything.
But even while saying all of this, there was no denying that there could be an influence.
He made his choices, yes, but that was after he was put in certain situations. This was the influence and the complexity of interactions of others.

In all of existence, he was not alone. There were others with their own weavings resonating with him and countless more, and it was only through this unfathomable web of weaving that everything existed!
Interactions. Causality.

He felt it more and more at this moment, with him being truly severed from existence as he saw that his control over his interactions and lines of causality connecting him from one person to another could be modified or cut off in a way he could not do before.
So even with all of this considered, he still knew that he was free.
And yet this unfathomable being before him asked him such a question as he himself wondered whether he was free.
He was more advanced in complexity than he was. He had lived for more years than he had. He was even closer to the Wheel of Existence than he was. And even he questioned!
After he answered, the visage of Bob looked at him for a few seconds, staring deeply into his eyes as if he could peer through and understand the thought processes that led him here.
After a brief silence, Bob waved his hands and sighed as an illusory screen appeared in between them.
"This could be considered not too long ago in the variation of time depending on your complexity, or it could be considered days or months ago."

"Right after The Change began, I left this frequency to go to one that is dominated by a group called the Logos of the Wheel. A band of creatures that formed many Cycles ago who made it their intent to intervene in many Frequencies of the Wheel. To appoint the right people in control for the sake of Order. To eliminate those who would impose chaos into certain Frequencies. It was all for the sake of the wheel of existence or so they said. But of course, behind every purpose, there is an uneven truer purpose. For many of them, it was to elevate the Complexity of their Existence. To exceed their paths of Pioneers and attain a Source, and experience even grander complexities across the Frequencies of the Wheel as only in this manner can one truly get close to the Wheel of Existence."
WAA!

"One frequency could have a resource or an item that was helpful in elevating one's complexity, and if one remained in a single Natal Frequency, they may never be able to advance. So the Logos of the Wheel formed to serve themselves and others. They had been at odds for most points over the Cycles with another group intent on keeping the flow of the Wheel as it should be...the Watchers of the Wheelomachy"
The Logos of the Wheel!
The Watches of the Wheelomachy!
Noah's weavings heard these terms not for the first time as he remained placid- with him having gotten some answers out of Barbatos in Hell Terra Firma after she let go of her reservations!
He had to pry them out of her, but he had his means that even caused her to tap out in the end.
So he continued listening calmly as the illusory screen conjured up between them showed a scene of Bob crossing untold complexities to arrive above a sea that held a single man.

The intricacies of this illusory screen were so unique that Noah didn't feel like he was just watching it, but it was radiating a light of weaving that allowed him to feel as if he was right there. As if he was in Bob's place in that incandescent sea.
The scene was paused as Bob looked at it while continuing to speak.

"As a watcher, I have lived many cycles ensuring that people jumping between Frequencies or those coming where they should not, or doing what they should not- are returned to their rightful places. This fixes chaotic events or simply aligns things before the Wheel of Existence itself fully straightens out how things should be."

"I and many others knew of a coming Change, and I even sought out unique individuals and sought to help them as this Change came. But the way this change occurred felt...filthy. Dirty. As if yes, it was supposed to occur, but this was not the way nor the time that it should have bloomed. And so, I sought answers from those responsible. The ones involved in the Point of Origin where many of these things unraveled. And so I went to another Frequency to ask questions and likely start a War."
HUUM!

The scene between them finally began to play out as the brilliance of the weavings pulsating from it made Noah's eyes feel like he was involved within the scene itself. He felt the waters below his feet as he looked towards the distant figure of a man who turned towards him, towards Bob, with a complicated expression. And in the scene, Bob waves his hands to show images of two entities.

One was someone that Noah was extremely familiar with, having been exploring every inch of her body recently. The other was a man with a cold expression on his face. It was the two beings that held his Blancverse in place while he was swallowed by the light of Hell Terra Firma!
